books.summary: Once there was a ghost who loved to scare someone every day. One day, he decided to look for something easy to scare… like a mouse! Will the mouse be as frightened as everyone else?

books.title: A Stitch in Time
books.summary: First, a ripped shirt and then, a faulty iron box. The day has just begun for Shyam. With everything going wrong one after the other, Shrisha takes him to a Repair Mela where you can fix almost anything.

books.title: Shoecat Thoocat
books.summary: Kamala’s new shoecat attacks whoever it meets! Tomatoes, thathas, friends, teachers, goats… everyone hates it. What will they do now?

books.title: It's Play Time
books.summary:
Rahi and her classmates are getting ready for their school play. Everyone is excited and nervous
about their performance. Will everything go as planned?

books.title: Tall and Short
books.summary: Can you tell which family members are tall and which are short? This book demonstrates the concept of opposites— tall and short— through the members of a child’s family.

books.title: Beauty Is Missing
books.summary: Tessamma’s beloved buffalo is missing! No one knows what happened to her but constable Jincy is determined to find out. She goes all over the village, questioning people and looking for clues. Will Jincy be able to find Beauty the buffalo? The game is afoot in this mystery about a music-loving buffalo.

books.title: The Sound of Water
books.summary: Varsha and her Appa live near the forest. It has been a hot summer and Varsha is feeling the heat. One day she hears a strange noise and decides to investigate. Only she can hear the sound and wonders what it is. What will Varsha find and will Appa believe her?

books.title: Uma Versus Upma
books.summary: Uma never eats her breakfast. Instead, she just plays with it. Can anything be done to stop her from playing with her food?

books.title: Who is Afraid of the Rakshas Sweetie-Man?
categories: Who is Afraid of the Rakshas Sweetie-Man?
books.summary: Samar and Nivya are terrified of the Rakshas Sweetie-Man. He looks scary, and oh, does he eat little puppies? When their six puppies run into the Rakshas Sweetie-Man’s shop, the twins must rescue them. But then they get the biggest surprise ever!

books.title: More or Less? Need to Guess!
categories: More or Less? Need to Guess!
books.summary: So many mithai boxes to count, so little time! Can Ranjita and Vikram do it? Yes, using a cool math trick called 'Approximately More-or-Less'! Read this fun wedding story to learn the trick yourself!

books.title: Gul in Space
books.summary: What would you like to do on your birthday? How about taking a walk in OUTER SPACE! Here’s a story that will make you jump with joy… and if there’s no gravity under you, you might just stay exactly where you are! Get ready to explore the space with Astronaut Gul.

books.title: Picnic on Grass
books.summary: Grass can be of different kinds. It can be soft, it can be rough, you can smell it and even taste it.  Best of all is that you can picnic on grass.

books.title: The Birthday Menu
books.summary: It is Kanchi’s birthday and she can’t go out to her favourite restaurant. Knowing that baingan bharta is all she has to look forward to, she is really upset. But her neighbours in Sunrise Society know that the best way to turn things around is with a feast! A story about community, compassion, and the food we eat.

books.title: How Pintu Found Pi
books.summary: Pintu is lonely in his new school. Whenever he approaches his classmates, they form a closed circle. Then Pintu finds pi.

books.title: Teaching Pa
books.summary: Diya’s Pa has never gone to school. So she decides to teach him herself. Pa listens to her most of the time, but Maths Days are difficult. How does Diya manage?

books.title: Let's Play Cricket
books.summary: Rohan and Seema have to quickly build a cricket team. If they add all their friends, can they get 11?

books.title: The Right Way School
books.summary: The Right Way School has only the right way of doing things and that’s how Mrs Gambhir teaches as well. Until one day a girl with wild hair and endless curiosity joins the school and stumps everyone with her questions, her merry voice, and her behaviour. What will happen next?

books.title: A Whistling Good Idea
books.summary: Ma wants Nivi to turn off the pressure cooker after three whistles. But Nivi wants to read  her new book instead! Find out how she cleverly does both.

books.title: Let's Play
books.summary: Ready, set, go...Learn the science behind play.

books.title: I Can Dress Myself!
books.summary: Mum is sleeping, so this independent little girl decides to dress herself.

books.title: Walking Together
books.summary: A walk to the clinic doesn’t have to be dull, when there are so many wonderful things to see on the way.

books.title: What happened to the shawl?
books.summary: This ancient story from the life of the great sage, Gautama Buddha, carries a deep lesson about conservation. A disciple finds out that getting the Buddha to sanction a new shawl for him is no easy matter!

books.title: Bath time for Chunnu and Munnu
categories: Bath time for Chunnu and Munnu
books.summary: Join Chunnu and Munnu as they splash about while having a bath. A fun read-aloud and a great way to say goodnight.

books.title: What Does Anu See?
books.summary: Anu sees many lovely things around her. Do you see them too?

books.title: Gurru and Peechu's Day Out
books.summary: Gurru and Peechu have nowhere to play! Join them as they go scouting for new spaces in their city.

books.title: Shiro's Friends Save the Day
books.summary: Shiro stuffs himself with too many gulab jamuns. Now it’s up to his friends, the different parts of his digestive system, to save the day.

books.title: Rainbow Sambar
books.summary: What should Bhavya and Paati eat today? Bhavya's favorite dish, of course – rainbow sambar! Join Paati and Bhavya for some colourful and delicious lunchtime fun.

books.title: Chunu & Munu: The Corn Is Yummy!
books.summary: Chunu and Munu help their father grow corn. Will they get to eat some, too?

books.title: Unni's Wish
books.summary: Unni wants to sleep under a fan, drink cold lime juice, and watch cartoons on TV. What’s stopping him? Read this story to find out.

books.title: The Other Way
books.summary: You don’t have to go too far to discover nature’s wonderful secrets—they are all there in your neighbourhood park. Learn about opposites in nature.

books.title: Mango Lick!
books.summary: In this wordless story, an adventurous mango goes off to travel the world. Guess where it ultimately ends up!

books.title: Sniffles
books.summary: It’s the day of the Famous Football Cup and poor Divya has the sniffles! Will she be able to play? Read this story to find out what happens to Divya, and also learn about how best to avoid the sniffles.

books.title: Farida Plans a Feast
books.summary: Join Farida as she fills her tiffin box with different items of food, and meet the animal friends she makes along the way.

books.title: Young or Old?
books.summary: A little boy is old enough to tie his shoes, but too young to help his father paint the house. He is old enough to feed himself, but too young to help his mother cook. Is he too young, or too old?

books.title: Paint Day, Plant Day
books.summary: Avi enjoys plant day, music day and paint day, and being busy throughout the week. Join in as Avi potters about the house, in this book about noticing and recognising patterns.

books.title: The Magical Glasses
books.summary: Mirium and Tejas have magic glasses. Join them as they use the glasses to look at seven animals and birds that are found only in certain parts of the world.

books.title: Haru
books.summary:
Meet Haru, who loves to eat, run and
play. Even though there are nights when
it’s hard to find a warm place to sleep, or
days when there isn’t enough food to eat,
Haru is always certain that tomorrow will
be better. After all, as long as there is love
and joy, it’s not a bad life!

books.title: Janice Goes to Chinatown
books.summary:
Janice sets off to Kolkata’s Chinatown along with her Grandma. Join her as she discovers this heritage
district.

books.title: Pranav the Pattern Detective
books.summary: It is an ordinary day for Pranav until he spots something special in a tree. This discovery sets him on a journey that changes the way he views the world around him. Shapes will never look the same again.

books.title: Annual Haircut Day- ONCE AGAIN!
books.summary: Sringeri Srinivas is back! It is  Annual Haircut Day, once again. But there is a lockdown in his village due to the Coronavirus pandemic. The barbershop is closed. What will the lovable banana farmer do this time?

books.title: Ammu's Puppy
books.summary: Ammu does not have a puppy. But she tells her friends that she does! Her puppy's name is Shankar, she says. Shankar loves bananas, she says. She tells them so much about Shankar that her friends want to come home and meet him. Now what will Ammu do?

books.title: Gorillas Go to the Beach
books.summary: Jump, dance, play! The gorillas are at the beach today. What else do they do there? This book introduces simple verbs in a pop of colour.

books.title: Bow Meow Wow
books.summary: A dog, a cat and a hilarious encounter await in this action-packed book about colours.

books.title: Rain, Rain
books.summary: Roll along with the cloud as it brings rain and joy!

books.title: Behind the Lie
books.summary: Valli and Ramesh live under a cloud of fear because of their father, who has a frightening temper. Will things ever change for them? A story about domestic violence, grit and hope.

books.title: Kabuliwala
books.summary:
Five-year-old Mini can't stay without talking. She talks all the time to her parents. She talks with Rahmat, the Kabuliwala. Rahmat gives her cashews and kishmish. A beautiful relationship develops between them based on the airy hills of Afghanistan and his own daughter who he had to leave behind at home. But circumstances force Rehmat to end up in jail!
Years later, it’s Mini’s wedding day and Rehmat walks out with his freedom into a world that has moved on without him.

books.title: Little Sock and the Tiny Creatures
categories: Little Sock and the Tiny Creatures
books.summary: It’s wash day for the Socks, but where has Little Sock gone?

books.title: I Love Me
books.summary: Rubina has just moved to a new home and doesn’t know anyone there. No one wants to play with her. Can Rubina find a friend of her own?

books.title: Billy to the Rescue
books.summary: Putting out fires makes Billy the fire engine dirty. Will he still do his work?

books.title: Wailers Three - A Folktale From China
categories: Wailers Three - A Folktale From China
books.summary: Mrs. Chang gets a letter from her son one day. She asks Warrior Wen to read it out to her. One look at the letter and Warrior Wen bursts into tears. Very soon, Mrs.Chang starts bawling. Next, Peddlar Peng, who is passing, by joins the sobbing duo. What has happened to Mrs. Chang's son? Find out for yourself in this delightful folktale from China?

books.title: All Jumbled Up
books.summary: Ammu is ready to go on stage, but she can’t remember her lines. A lot of fun follows as she jumbles up her lines.

books.title: An Umbrella for Druvi
books.summary: Druvi needs an umbrella to protect her wings from the rain. Join the dragonfly as she searches for the perfect leaf-umbrella.

books.title: We Are All Animals
books.summary: A nice interaction between animals and children and our capabilities!

books.title: In My Garden
books.summary: It’s time to water the plants. The garden is full of colour and, if you look closely, many intricate patterns. A book about the simple joys of the outdoors world.

books.title: This is How You Count Eggs
categories: This is How You Count Eggs
books.summary: Raghu keeps making mistakes while counting eggs. Kavya knows a simple way to help him count.

books.title: Come Stay With Me
books.summary: Tendai Turtle’s Granny has hurt her shell and Mum and Dad have to go to help her. “Come stay with me,”says Tendai’s best friend Busi Bunny, and the fun begins.

books.title: Bulli and the Tiger
books.summary: Bulli is a little girl growing up in Assam, in a basket-weavers’ community. When the bamboo suppliers threaten to raise the rates and put their whole village in jeopardy, Bulli knows she has to find other ways of finding bamboo, even if it means facing the legendary tiger!  Shalini Reys’s adventure-filled story is illustrated by Nankusiya Shyam in the Gond style.

books.title: The Little Plant
books.summary: Look closely at the plants around you, there is so much to see, so many creatures to meet, and so much to learn!

books.title: Hello, Sun!
books.summary: Say hello to wonder. Say hello to millipedes, frogs, barbets and everyone under the sun who calls Earth their home. And that includes you.

books.title: Amma, How Do You Make Ghee?
categories: Amma How Do You Make Ghee?
Aai Taje Taje Toop Yete Kuthun?
books.summary: Teena loves ghee, especially on her favourite Puran Poli. But where does ghee come from?

books.title: Chunu & Munu: Let Us Play Now
books.summary: A delightful little poem about finding different friends and games to play.

books.title: Haathibhai
books.summary: Haathibhai is a much-loved Gujarati rhyme. Children have been singing this sweet song for many years. This illustrated version of the rhyme about an elephant is sure to bring joy to little ones.

books.title: Chuskit Goes to School!
books.summary: Nine year old Chuskit longed to go to school, to make friends, learn math and play games. But she could not... until Abdul decided to do something about it.

books.title: Ape and Crocodile
books.summary: Do the Ape and the Crocodile have a happy friendship story?

books.title: Chhuk-Chhuk-Chhak
books.summary: Get on to little Nanhi's train as it chuffs away. Chhuk-Chhuk-Chhak-Chhak!

books.title: Hakeem's Hiccups
books.summary: It’s Ramzan and Hakeem sahib has a case of the hiccups — so he can’t drink water to make it go away. What will hic-hic-hiccuping Hakeem sahib do, and can his patients help their beloved doctor?

books.title: How Does the Toothpaste Get into the Tube?
categories: How does the toothpaste get into the tube?
books.summary: Squeezing out the toothpaste from the tube every morning is simple. But do you know how it got into the tube? Let's tell you how.

books.title: The Golden Bird
books.summary: When the king finds out there is a golden bird that can make him emperor of the universe, he goes on a mission to catch it! But his daughter has other ideas, and must muster her courage to stand up for her kingdom.

books.title: The Bubble Mystery
books.summary: Toot-Toot is afraid of the water until she notices some funny bubbles. When she finally bathes in the pond, she sees lots of bubbles that go blop, blop, blop! Where do they come from? No one will answer when she asks. Can Toot-Toot solve the bubble mystery?

books.title: Savio Finds the Right Angle
books.summary: Fatima wants to finish her homework on angles. But her brother Savio drags her out to the beach. Will an afternoon outdoors help Fatima with her homework?

books.title: How I Feel
books.summary: How do you feel when Nani comes to visit?  How do you feel when you spoil a library book? Read this book and see how you feel today.

books.title: So Does Cheeku
books.summary: Join Cheeku as he goes about his very busy day.

books.title: Plants Are Everywhere
books.summary: Plants grow everywhere — on high mountains, on arid lands, and even under the sea. Explore different types of plants in this book.

books.title: Susheela's Kolams
books.summary: You must have seen kolams on doorsteps at home and even in school, but have you ever seen a kolam in the sky? Read on to find out how Susheela made that!

books.title: Pishi and Me
books.summary: Chutku returns from his walks with his aunt, his pocket full of treasures and stories. Narrated from a child’s point of view, this is the story of the heartwarming relationship between an aunt and her nephew.

books.title: Lassi, Ice-cream or Falooda?
books.summary: Is mango panna better in taste than lassi or is falooda better than both of these? Well, the only way to find out is to enjoy these and that is what Meenu is doing! What else can you do in summer?

books.title: Kalpana's Cycle
books.summary: Kalpana is learning to cycle, but it isn’t easy at all! She falls over and over again, even hurting herself. Does she finally learn to cycle? Does she give up? A heartwarming story about the importance of trying.

books.title: Hide and Seek
books.summary: Dodo plays Hide-and-seek with mum, what can Dodo find?

books.title: Dog's Day
books.summary: What does a dog do all day? This wordless book gives us a glimpse into the life of a human's best friend.

books.title: The Best Thing Ever
books.summary: Muzi loves to build with his toys. But when he leaves them behind to travel to uGogo’s house, he discovers something very special about the world. And he learns something new about himself.

books.title: Making Friends with Snakes (But from a Distance)
categories: Making Friends with Snakes (But from a Distance)
books.summary: Naagin and Dhaman are here to make friends with you, but from a distance. After all, they are snakes. Find out everything you wanted to know about these beautiful reptiles and also learn how to stay safe and let snakes slither to safety!

books.title: Water Dance
books.summary: Guddu can dance to anything. Today he has found music in water and can’t stop doing a jig as he makes his way down a stream. A story that introduces water bodies and celebrates the joy of water.

books.title: Who Made the Tomato Chutney?
books.summary:
Tara and Ravi go to the market to buy fruits and vegetables. But each time one fruit gets squashed! The concept of sorting is introduced through heavy and light objects. 
The illustrations in the book were made using bits of paper, old magazines and paper bags that were collected - not squished - under mattresses.

books.title: Biju Spins Some Magic
books.summary: Biju and his family are weavers in rural Odisha. They create beautiful fabrics to sell in the cities of India and abroad. This is the tale of Biju’s adventures when he accompanies his father to Delhi to sell the saris, and in the process impresses a city boy with his skill. Jaya Jaitly’s fun-filled story is illustrated by Bhramara Nayak in the patachitra style.

books.title: Have You Ever Climbed a Tree?
categories: Have You Ever Climbed a Tree
books.summary: Have you ever climbed a tree? Riniki dreams of climbing trees all over the country. Join her as she scrambles, crawls and clambers on the jackfruit, the chinar, the khejri and other trees.

books.title: The Tree
books.summary: The tale of how a tree grows from a tiny seed.

books.title: Marching to Freedom
books.summary: Mahatma Gandhi and his followers have decided to march to Dandi to protest against the unfair salt tax imposed by the British. 9-year-old Dhani who lives at the Sabarmati Ashram wants to go too. This tale captures the spirit behind the momentous event that inspired millions of Indians to join the struggle for Independence.

books.title: How Do Aeroplanes Fly?
books.summary: Sarla wished she could fly high like an eagle or like an aeroplane. Of course you can fly, said her new teacher. Here, Sarla shares all that she has learnt about flight and aeroplanes.

books.title: Three for Free - A Folktale from Taiwan
categories: Three for Free - A Folktale from Taiwan
books.summary: Once upon a time, in a little village by a mountain, an old man came to sell his dumplings. He sold one for one cent, two for two cents and three for free! As the villagers started gobbling up the dumplings three at a time, strange things started happening around them. Read this tantalising tale from Taiwan to see what happened in this village by the Ban Pin Shan Mountain!

books.title: The Best House of All
books.summary: Big, small, round, square, heavy, light... homes can be of many kinds! Find out why each home is different, and build your own home. Our little architect shows you how!

books.title: I Feel
books.summary: What are the emotions you feel?

books.title: Our Beautiful World
books.summary: Humans have been around for 2,00,000 years. But in the last 250 years, we have created a monster: climate change. This monster is making the planet hotter, and threatening the lives of those we share the planet with. How did we get here? And what comes next? This non-fiction book tells us why we should be hot under the collar about the climate crisis.

books.title: Naughty Dog
books.summary: If you had a tail, you would wag it after reading this book. This book is one of the four books in the 'Animals Around Us' series.

books.title: Why Does A Poori Puff Up?
categories: Why Does a Poori Puff Up?
books.summary: Round, fat pooris are a treat in most Indian homes. Why do they puff? There is a whole lot of science behind this simple question.

books.title: Maaloo, Kaaloo ...and who?
books.summary: Maaloo and Kaaloo are back! This time they are playing detective at Grandma’s house in the hills.

books.title: My Family
books.summary: Come and meet my big family.

books.title: Keya's Day at the Beach
books.summary: Join Keya the Soldier Crab as she explores the beach with her Ma, and meets many different crabs.

books.title: Many Mangoes to Share
books.summary: Four friends plant mango saplings on their first day in kindergarten. When they complete Class 4, the trees have borne hundreds of fruits. What do they do with it? Count them, and distribute them using arithmetic!

books.title: Friends
books.summary: Simo will tell you what her friends like to do best! What do Your friends like?

books.title: Let's Go Seed Collecting!
books.summary: Join Tooka, Poi, and their best friend Inji the dog, as they go around collecting seeds. The adventure begins when the three friends meet Pacha the tamarind tree.

books.title: Clean Cat
books.summary: You take a bath and cats do not. Yet, why do we call them clean? This book is one of the four books in the 'Animals Around Us' series.

books.title: Goplu's Train Ride
books.summary: Goplu is excited to ride on the train with Thammi, who has lots of friends and a smile for every one. Maybe today Goplu can make a friend too.

books.title: One, Three, Five, HELP!
books.summary: A coconut beetle loves to count. He loves to spot patterns of odd numbers and even numbers. One day, he falls on his back. How many friends come to help him? An odd number of friends or an even number of friends?

books.title: The Auto That Flew
books.summary: Caught in the mad traffic of Delhi, an auto feels a touch of magic. Take a ride with the driver and the passenger, and feel the feather touch of a little stardust.

books.title: Plek Plok, the Lucky Little Fish
books.summary: Mommy and Plek Plok, her little son are swimming in shallow waters in the sea. Plek Plok sees bigger fish playing happily in the deep waters and wants to join them. Mommy warns he is too young to explore the deep waters, but Plek Plok goes anyway. What happens to him?

books.title: City of Stories
books.summary: Nobody in the city has time to tell a story, until Didi and a little girl start a tidal wave of stories, that washes over everybody. Read this fascinating fable of transformation of a city into the City of Stories.

books.title: Chhutti
books.summary: Holidays are precious! A celebration of endless summer vacations in verse.

books.title: Snails in a Spiral
books.summary: The natural world is full of patterns — lines, dots, spirals. Look closely around you, and you will notice patterns everywhere!

books.title: How Far is Far?
books.summary: If you thought your friend's house on the other side of town was far away, you have clearly not read this book. Climb the Magic Math Ladder to get from where you are to the top of Mount Everest, to Kashmir, to the moon, the Sun, and ultimately, to the edge of the Universe, which is very, very, VERY far away indeed. Ready, steady, go!

books.title: The Magic Letter
books.summary: Ijas receives a letter from his best friend Vikram. He can't wait to read it! But when he opens the letter, he is in for a surprise.

books.title: How to Catch the Wind
books.summary: What do wings, kites and a wind turbine’s blades all have in common? Each one’s motion is powered by the wind.

books.title: The Royal Toothache
books.summary: Even the king of the jungle must keep his teeth clean. Read this sweet story about who taught him this important lesson.

books.title: The Lion Runs and the Cow Walks
books.summary: What are they doing, how do they move around?

books.title: Round and Round (Tell me now series)
categories: Round and Round (Tell me now series)
books.summary: Learn through interesting questions and answers.

books.title: My Street
books.summary: Running past familiar faces, watching the street go by in a flash of colours — it's just another day in this neighbourhood. A wordless story about community spirit in a neighbourhood, and the people that make it special.

books.title: My City, My Dogs
books.summary:
Meet the street dogs of Mumbai. The roads are their playground and they have made
the city and the people their own.

The pictures in this book have been created using a combination of illustrations and photographs. The illustrations have been made by Sumedha Sah. The photographs have been taken by Hashim Badani.

books.title: Tiger's Delicious Treats
books.summary: Tiger loves baking. Every day he bakes many delicious treats, but none of the other animals in the forest want to buy from him. One day, Tiger decides to investigate.

books.title: Clever Pig
books.summary:
Pig loves to play!
One day, Pig is gone.
Will Pig come back?

books.title: What Are These For?
books.summary: This charming tale with vibrant illustrations and visual clues showcases an innovative blend of learning and laughter. The kitchen is a mess! Who did this? Things are on the floor. What are these objects for?

books.title: The Bone Puzzle
books.summary: Zoya and Armaan have made a mess at Ma’s clinic. They will be in BIG trouble if she finds out. Can they put aside their differences and work as a team?

books.title: Colours of Nature
books.summary: An eminent artist plays with the colours of nature. A lovely offering for early readers.

books.title: Button Box
books.summary: Whatever you wear, a button knows. After all, that’s the way a button rolls. A story as cute as a button.

books.title: Book of Bhoots
books.summary: Who whispers your name in the wind on this moonless night? Maybe nothing. Maybe something. Turn the pages of this book, and maybe you’ll hear it. And if you do, there’s no going back.

books.title: My First Book of Indian Dinosaurs
categories: My First Book of Indian Dinosaurs
books.summary: Once, dinosaurs roamed this Earth. But do you know what they were called? Let's meet a delightful herd of dinosaurs.

books.title: A Kulfi for Free!
books.summary: Childhood, hot summers and the narrow lanes of Jodhpur are uniquely connected to mouth-watering kulfi! How many kulfis should Bhanwari buy?

books.title: Rainbow Girls
books.summary: Are all girls alike? Do they like the same things, should they all dress similarly? Let's think about it.

books.title: The Time-Travelling River
books.summary:
Imagine all the stories rivers could tell us about the past, present and future!
Rivers were there when humans wanted to grow food. They were there when humans started to build cities. They are still here, providing water, food and livelihoods. But they are also being treated like rubbish bins. Rivers know how to take care of us, but if we want a future with them, maybe it is time for humans to take care of our precious water bodies.

books.title: Who is Faster?
books.summary: Which animal is fast and which is slow? This book tells young readers which animals are faster than others.

books.title: Wet or Dry
books.summary: What do you do with your waste? Do you have separate bins for the wet and the dry? Read this fun poem and give it a try.

books.title: Chunu and Munu Read
books.summary: Chunu and Munu discover the joys of reading!

books.title: Sringeri Srinivas's Cow Must Moo!
books.summary: Sringeri Srinivas is back with a new problem. His cow has stopped mooing and he is very angry. The farmer frowns at her. His children feed her sweets. But the cow does not moo. Join this lovable farmer's family and his new cat Manuli, in this tale with a twist.

books.title: Home
books.summary: Hasina and her family live happily in their rainy village. Until one day the tides turn, and Amma and young Hasina are swept away by fear. They join a river of escaping people. They become refugees in a new country, away from everything that is familiar. A story that explores the meaning of home.

books.title: Let's Count Legs
books.summary: Whose legs are these? Let's count them!

books.title: I Spy a Lake!
books.summary: Manju and Hamid are playing a game of I Spy by the lake. But why is the game making Hamid sad? And what can they do about it? A story about pollution and the declining state of water bodies.

books.title: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai
categories: A Tiny Seed: The Story of Wangari Maathai
books.summary: In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. She worried as she saw the big forests disappearing, but she knew the power of a tiny seed.

books.title: Handmade in India
books.summary:
Olivia Fraser has travelled around India painting for the past many years. This book has arisen from her observations of the vast colourful array of people she has come across 
during her travels.

books.title: The Birthday Cake
books.summary:
Azad, Haniya, Charulata and Piyush love to play in front of their house — as long as they avoid the grumpy old woman at the end of the street. One day, when they find out that it's her birthday, the four friends decide to bake her a cake. After all, no one should spend their birthday alone. 
A charming story about fraternity and empathy.

books.title: How Many?
books.summary: Some animals and birds want to meet you! All they are asking you to do is count some things for them. Will you?

books.title: Bobo and the Worms
books.summary: Worms are chewing up plants. Bobo is on a mission to stop them. Can she manage it?

books.title: Gudugu Thadugu
books.summary: Muni the mason has to break a shed and make a new clinic. He goes up the hill asking various people to help him. But sometimes help takes on an unexpected form!

books.title: Vira and Tilli
books.summary:
Vira has been looking after Tilli, and now it’s harvest time. Has Tilli grown into a healthy onion? When the time comes, will he be able to
let go of Tilli? A heartwarming story about a boy and his onion plant, and how our food is grown.

books.title: Nin Wants to Get Dressed
books.summary: It's Nin's first day of school. She wants to get dressed in her uniform for school but everyone is too busy to help her! Can Nin get dressed all by herself?

books.title: Every Rupee Counts
books.summary: Banko has saved some money. He wants to donate the money to people who rescue animals. Daee helps him convert paise to rupees and teaches him how to count the value of money.

books.title: Why are Bubbles Round?
books.summary: Maya and Manu want to see if they can make bubbles of different shapes. Like them, you too can learn about bubbles and their shapes.

books.title: The Power of One
books.summary: The children of Class 6 want to visit the amusement park, but will they be able to save enough money for the tickets?

books.title: Tiger, Tiger, Where Are You?
books.summary: A tiger researcher is out looking for tiger hair and poop as part of his study. He finds plenty of signs of the tiger, but where is the big cat? After all, there are so many  ways to see a tiger without seeing a tiger.

books.title: Kaushik, the Kind Detective
books.summary: With his new torch and magnifying glass, Kaushik feels like a true detective. Join him as he explores the forest and makes exciting new discoveries.

books.title: Now I've Got You!
books.summary: One day, Frog catches Wasp. “Now I've got you!" Frog says. But Wasp sees that Frog is in trouble, too! In a humorous chain of events, each animal is caught and nearly eaten by another, until Wasp comes up with a clever solution to save them all!

books.title: Thato's Birthday Surprise
books.summary: It is one week until Thato’s Birthday. His mama tells him he will have a big surprise. What will it be?

books.title: I Love My Mom
books.summary: The girl in this story learns from her mother every day. Now she knows many things. Which of these can YOU do?

books.title: A Little Monkey and a Fish
books.summary: A Little Monkey and a Fish is a story about a young, playful, and clever monkey who learns to make his way in the world by mimicking his mother. Along his journey, he must decide whether or not to take some risks. What do you think he will do?

books.title: Where is My Mother?
books.summary: A small baby bird is separated from its mother. The baby bird searches and searches for its mother but can’t find her. What will happen?

books.title: New Pussy Cat
books.summary: Prosy wants a cat, but she must find one that's the perfect size for everyone in her family!

books.title: A Camel for Kelam
books.summary: Pabu’s niece Kelam wants a camel for her birthday. So he sets out from Rajasthan for Lanka to look for one. Find out where this journey takes him.

books.title: Smart Sona
books.summary: Sona’s father made her a lovely toy. Read this charming story about how they helped each other.

books.title: Such a Sweet Smell!
books.summary: Appu is relaxing one lazy afternoon, when he catches a whiff of… he doesn’t know what. He decides to follow his nose to the source of the smell. Wouldn’t you like to tag along? This story about smells takes you to the charming city of Kolkata.

books.title: Pehelwaan Ji
books.summary: Pehelwaan Ji was a bit of a bully. But Gappu soon took care of that. Read this amusing story about their bout of wrestling!

books.title: Dipa Karmakar - In Perfect Balance
books.summary:
Dipa Karmakar was the first Indian female
gymnast to compete in the Olympic Games.
In 2016, she finished fourth at the event held in Rio. She grew up in Tripura and began learning gymnastics at the age of five. Read about her journey from Agartala to Rio.

books.title: Pehelwaan ji Plays Cricket
books.summary: The children of the village were scared of the big man, Pehelwaan ji. So when he wanted to play with them, they just had to let him play.

books.title: The Little Red String
books.summary:
Nani has just finished knitting a cap for a special visitor. Moni and Viru find that the
leftover red string is the most useful thing in the house. A wordless book about families and
play.

books.title: At Least I'm Okay!
books.summary: Una, a mountain goat, lives on top of a mountain in beautiful Sakuland. The animals love their home but one day, the climate begins to change and the animals are forced to leave Sakuland. A story about climate change and how it affects animals and the natural world.

books.title: Playtime
books.summary: Golu and Chhotu sure make a funny pair. Read about their antics in this funny story.

books.title: I Can Smell...
books.summary: On a winter afternoon in Shantiniketan, Mini smells something delicious and decides to follow her nose. Follow Mini and find out what surprise awaits her.

books.title: Avani and the Pea Plant
books.summary: Who did it? Avani does not know. Her mother does not know. But you will know who did it when you read this book about a pea plant.

books.title: Paati's Gold
books.summary: Paati and Appa are worried because of the failing rice crops. But Paati has an answer hidden in a wooden box, a secret more precious than gold. Savi and Selvan watch Paati unlock the power of indigenous seeds and knowledge in this book about farming.

books.title: Toto Imitates Grandpa
books.summary: What does Toto learn from her Grandpa?

books.title: Bounthy's Singing Birds
books.summary: Bounthy’s father captures birds and puts them in cages. Bounthy likes listening to the birds singing, but one day the birds stop singing. Will Bounthy be able to make the birds sing again?

books.title: Sudipta Sengupta - The Rock Reader
books.summary: Sudipta loves climbing mountains, and she can read rocks like books. As the first Indian female geologist in Antarctica, she scales the Schirmacher Hills to find out what stories the rocks have to tell.

books.title: Happy and Sad (Tell me now series)
categories: Happy and Sad (Tell me now series)
books.summary: Often, an inquisitive child asks his parents an endless set of questions. The 'Tell me ... now!' Series describes how interesting the questions and answers turn out. This one is about feelings and emotions.

books.title: Kaka and Munni: A Folktale from Punjab
categories: Kaka and Munni: A Folktale from Punjab
books.summary: Kaka, the wicked crow, wants to eat Munni's eggs. But Munni is a very clever sparrow. And so are all the characters in this popular folktale from Punjab.

books.title: Lost Toy
books.summary: A child has lost their favorite toy. They are so sad. Will some kind strangers help?

books.title: Counting Animals
books.summary: All the animals in the jungle are so thirsty!  Join them while they all  go to drink some water.

books.title: Come back, Cat!
books.summary: A delightful tale about an independent cat.

books.title: Wheel's Big Problem
books.summary: Wheel does not like rolling on hot or bumpy roads under Car, so he decides to look for a new vehicle. But Truck is too heavy and he does not fit Bicycle. Then, Wheel meets a boy who is looking for a friend. Can Wheel help the boy?

books.title: I Want to Ride a Motorbike
categories: I Want to Ride a Motorbike
books.summary: Diya’s fascinated by motorbikes. She can’t wait to turn sixteen and ride one. Especially after Diya finds out that her aunt is a biker! A story about identity and the freedom to choose.

books.title: Shruthi Floats an Idea
books.summary: Shruthi has to grow a plant. But she doesn’t want to grow it in soil. Is there any other way?

books.title: Topsy Turvy
books.summary:
Everything is turning upside down in a little boy’s house.
What could be the reason for this?

books.title: Mukhil's Bloody Adventure
books.summary: When Mukhil gets a fever, her mother takes her to a clinic. Give Mukhil company as she goes through her very first blood test.

books.title: The Pottering Pig
books.summary:
Lalita is the pet pig of Mini Singh the potter. She is a naughty pig and is always in trouble. One
day, Mini finds all his beautiful pots broken, and blames Lalita. Find out what happens next in
this story inspired from a real-life pig called Lalita. She lives in Pune with a real-life potter.

books.title: When We Are Home
books.summary: Home is the sights, the sounds, the smells and the touch of every room. In this book, Moromi remembers her home that was displaced by a flood.

books.title: Brave Rima
books.summary: Rima is excited to visit the Boishakhi fair with her uncle. But while she is busy looking at all the wonderful things around her, she realizes her uncle is gone. Rima is lost! Will Rima be able to find her uncle in such a huge crowd?

books.title: Houses
books.summary: People live in such different kinds of houses all around you. Let's take a look!

books.title: Sizing Things Up
books.summary: The world is made up of many things — big, small and middling. A small book with a big message.

books.title: My Little Garden
books.summary: A little boy and his dad find a plot full of litter. Can they turn it into something wonderful?

books.title: The Peacock's Dance
books.summary: Hina went to the farm with her father one day. She saw a peacock dancing and started to dance as well. How did the peacock react? Read more to find out.

books.title: Tumi Goes to the Park
books.summary: It’s Tumi’s first visit to the park. She’s so excited, there are many adventures. She might even make a new friend.

books.title: Why Can't We Glow Like Fireflies?
categories: why can't we glow like fireflies?
books.summary: Did you know that fireflies are also called lightning bugs? And did you know that baby fireflies use their glow to chase away predators? Jump right into this book if you want to find out more about these creatures that light up the dark.

books.title: Chuchu Manthu's Jar of Toffees
books.summary: Chuchu Manthu is the most loving person Preet knows. After his death, Preet wonders if his kindness has disappeared with him. Based on a true story about loss and grief, and compassion in everyday actions.

books.title: Anaya's Thumb
books.summary: Anaya loves her thumb. When she visits the zoo, she finds out what baby animals seem to like.

books.title: Sona's Very Smart Nose
books.summary: Sona loves to help everyone. In the first book, she helped her father. In the second book, she helped her mother. Now, Sona visits her uncle who makes ice-candies. What will she do there?

books.title: The Theatre of Ghosts
books.summary: Junali and Rimjhim are off to see Bhaona, the traditional drama on the river island of Majuli. But shadows loom everywhere! A mischievous story that celebrates this wonderful folk practice of Assam.

books.title: Uh-oh
books.summary: What happens when you get too close to some animals and plants? They use all sorts of tricks to protect themselves from danger. Find out in this hilarious book.

books.title: Body
books.summary: Do you know all your body parts? Find out!

books.title: Aiman's School Bag
books.summary: After you read this story, you may wonder what your school bag feels about you. Aiman and her bag make quite a pair!

books.title: Where is Thabo?
books.summary: Thabo’s family is getting ready for the day and making a big mess as they hurry to get things done. But where is Thabo?

books.title: Whoopee... Hyperloop!
books.summary:
Vishnu loves to see new places. But he hates long journeys. Why can’t we have a faster mass transport system, he wonders. So when he reads about the hyperloop, he is blown away… whoopee! 
What’s this futuristic mass transport system?

books.title: Binti Knows Her Mind
books.summary: You can try telling Binti that she can’t do something, but she knows best!

books.title: The Story of Stories
books.summary: In a happy, happy, happy forest lives Journalist Bear who is sad because he can't find a 'BREAKING NEWS' story. A Journalist Bear without a 'BREAKING NEWS' story, can you imagine! Then along comes Singing Sardarji who helps Bear see who he really is. Read this story which celebrates the power and magic of stories, and the people who weave them into being.

books.title: The Sun and The Moon
books.summary: A day in the life of the sun and the moon!

books.title: Hot Tea and Warm Rugs
books.summary: Meenu's smart winter uniforms are out and the air is filled with the aroma of roasted nuts. Not to forget a cloud of mist in front of her mouth while she speaks! Let us find out what is happening this winter.

books.title: The Fascinating Fibonaccis
books.summary: Almost a thousand years ago, an Indian scholar called Hemachandra discovered a fascinating number sequence. A century later, the same sequence caught the attention of Italian mathematician Fibonacci, who wrote about it. The Fibonacci sequence, as it began to be called, was straightforward enough - what made it fascinating was that this particular set of numbers was repeated many, many times in nature - in flowers, seashells, eggs, seeds, stars... Find out more inside this book!

books.title: Who's on  Divya's Map?
books.summary: Divya is excited that her cousin Ravi is going to come to Gajapur soon. But she is not sure how he will find her house. Would a map help?

books.title: Rat and Goat
books.summary: Rat loves to play hopscotch but he has no one to play with. His neighbour, Goat, is at home but he prefers to be alone. Can Rat persuade Goat to play with him?

books.title: A Girl Called Cheeku
books.summary: It's just an ordinary day for Cheeku and her friends. But then something extraordinary happens. Will Cheeku save the day? A story that celebrates individuality and reminds us that each one of us is special.

books.title: The Big Book of Boochandis
books.summary: Beware! Boochandis can be anywhere and can give you a bit of a fright. Beloved bogeymen of Tamil Nadu, boochandis are summoned to get unwilling children to do as they are told. In this book are boochandis of all shapes and sizes, boochandis who growl and prowl. Watch out!

books.title: Why Don't Birds Comb Their Hair?
categories: Why Don't Birds Comb Their Hair?
books.summary: Some birds have hair that sticks out in funny ways. What would you do if you had hair like that? Read this book to meet some fascinating birds.

books.title: Why Do Sunflowers Love the Sun?
categories: Why Do Sunflowers Love the Sun?
books.summary: All Viveka wants to do is paint the perfect picture of the sunflower field next to her house. But why won’t the flowers stay still?

books.title: Friends Under the Summer Sun
books.summary: Summer is almost over and Nimmi is stuck running errands for her mother. The latest – delivering eggs to Akka, her neighbour. But this dull task may turn out to be a great way to spend the day.

books.title: Where Is Your School?
books.summary: Schools are not just for kids! On his way to school, Pintoo finds some interesting schools! Do you want to see them? Look inside!

books.title: Megan and the Bridge of Life
categories: Megan and the Bridge of Life
books.summary: In the final instalment of The Home of Clouds series, Megan, Frits and Princess Elavuarasi find themselves in a strange land where roots form bridges and weird twig men are hard at work. Will Megan and Frits ever get back home?

books.title: Mini's First Vote
books.summary: Mini is in Standard 6, old enough to vote in the school elections. Soon, she has to help choose the school captain. Whom should she vote for?

books.title: Telephones - Bell to Cell
books.summary: When Alexander Graham Bell first invented the phone, there were only two in the entire town! Now, nearly everyone has a cell phone. Flip through this book and find out how the telephone evolved – from Bell to cell.

books.title: Ritu's Letter Gets Longer!
books.summary: Little Ritu is very eager to see her cousin. So she posts him a very special letter.

books.title: Smart Sona Helps Her Mother
books.summary: Sona is smarter than ever. You may have read how she helped her father. This time she finds her mother’s work very interesting!

books.title: Circles in the Park
books.summary:
Golu and Tama go to the park to play. What do they see all around them?
This wordless book introduces circles, semi-circles and quarter-circles.

books.title: Mother, Call that Bird!
books.summary: A little child asks her mother to help her adopt a bird.

books.title: The Special Painter
books.summary: Teo is missing the fingers on his right hand, but he loves painting and hopes to become a painter. Do you think Teo will be able to live out his dream in art class?

books.title: Aunty Jui's Baby
books.summary:
Anu and her mother visit Aunty Jui to see her new baby. 
Aai and Aunty fuss over her but Anu thinks the baby is really silly.

books.title: Razia Learns to Swim
books.summary: Razia must learn to swim. But she’s terrified of water! Join Razia in the lagoon as she kicks, wiggles and floats.

books.title: Tommy and Tingu
books.summary: Tommy is a small puppy and Tingu is an angry cat.  Read more about them in this short story!

books.title: Springloaded
books.summary: Neo’s father is an inventor. When he invents a helicopter hat and flies away, Neo decides to make an invention of her own.

books.title: Beloved Daughter
books.summary: Natabo has run away from her home! Do you know why?

books.title: Manikantan Has Enough
books.summary: Manikantan’s Amulet can tell when he’s happy or sad, sick or well. It can tell him when to eat and when to sleep, help with his homework and let Amma know if he’s not feeling well. Is it magic or is it science? Find out what happens when Manikantan and his mother move to the Smart City from their village.

books.title: The Day the Vegetables Came to School
categories: The Day the Vegetables Came to School
books.summary: Raju cannot believe his eyes. On his way to school, he sees vegetables of all shapes and sizes also headed there, carrying their schoolbags and water bottles! What’s more, no one else, including his teacher, seems surprised to see them. Whatever is going on?

books.title: A Friend for Little Goat
books.summary: Little Goat does not really like going to school. The school is so big, and Little Goat is so little. But he discovers that friends make school a happier place.

books.title: Slip and Slide
books.summary: The hills are covered with snow. Seven sisters are excited to go out and play. Join them on their adventure!

books.title: The Doll That Bommakka Made
books.summary: This charming cumulative tale celebrates the tradition of hand-crafted dolls, inspired by the South Indian Thanjavur Thalai Atti Bommai. Starting with a little ball of clay, we see the fine dancing doll grow before our eyes. The rhythmic descriptive words, stacked in a delightfully repetitive way, invite children to chant along. The vibrant illustrations complete the vivid imagery.

books.title: Little Monkey's Lost Bananas
books.summary: Little Monkey’s home is always messy. One day, Little Monkey feels hungry but his house is so messy that he cannot find his bananas to eat! He asks the other animals in the forest if they've seen his bananas. Do you think the other animals can help Little Monkey find his lost bananas?

books.title: An Adventure with a Water-Snake
books.summary: Khan catches a water snake! In this underwater adventure, Khan meets strange creatures, makes new friends and even manages to save the day.

books.title: Tara's Treetop Adventure
books.summary: A tall tale about a girl’s incredible adventure with laughing leaves, squeaky squirrels, and purple planes.

books.title: A Library Story
books.summary: Seema’s school will finally have a library. But they still need 40% more money to buy books. Join Seema and her classmates as they raise funds for the library and learn the concept of percentages.

books.title: Mr. Anand has an Adventure
books.summary: Mr. Anand loves to go walking in new places. Every outing is an adventure to him. This time he thinks he has learnt a new language. Do you also think so?

books.title: Simple Counting
contributors: San srei nou ch nou ch
books.summary: 1 ... 2 ... 3 Let's count the number of animals! Is 1, 2, or 3?

books.title: Rose and Rocky Go Green
books.summary: Rose has a recipe to turn waste into plant food. Join Rose and Rocky in their adventures in this book about composting.

books.title: With You, Ma
books.summary: Aadya refuses to do anything without her Ma - whether it’s packing a bag for their holiday to Assam or it’s playing in the river. Will this trip make Aadya more self-reliant?

books.title: A Day at the Carnival
books.summary: The three mice brothers can’t wait to visit the carnival. They ride toy cars, go on the Ferris wheel, and visit the balloon shop. After some time, they realize their youngest brother is missing! Where can he be?

books.title: Our Friends in the Wild
books.summary: Throughout time, people have shared a strong relationship with animals in nature. This non-fiction poem explores the many ways that animals help humans.

books.title: How Heavy Is Heavy?
books.summary: A stone is heavier than a feather and lighter than a rock. So is the stone heavy, or is it light? Can we know for sure how heavy (or light) a stone is? Find answers to these and other fascinating questions in this fun book about weight.

books.title: Gola Gola
books.summary: Everyone wants a different-coloured gola from the mela! If only there were an easier way for Mariyu to remember all of their choices? A story that introduces the concept of Venn diagrams.

books.title: How to Solve a Problem like Himani
categories: How to Solve a Problem Like Himani
books.summary:
In a tiny school in the Uttarakhand hills,
Himani and her classmates learn how to
solve real-life problems. The story takes
you through her diary entries as she learns
the steps to solve problems, big and small.

books.title: North, South, East, West
books.summary: Shaana is travelling the length and breadth of the country with her parents, exploring the many landscapes and peoplescapes of India. She documents her travels in letters that she writes to her friends back at school. A book that explores directions.

books.title: Manu Mixes Clay and Sunshine
books.summary: Manu’s father and grandfather are potters, and Manu is learning the craft. This lively story depicts both the simple joys and the hardships of a potter’s life, from gathering clay and making pots to selling them in the city markets. Bulbul Sharma’s enchanting story is illustrated by Shanti Devi in the Madhubani style.

books.title: Every Minute Counts
books.summary: Adil has a full hour to get ready and walk to school. But he is late every day! Where is he losing time? His friend Paro decides to help him account for every minute of the hour.

books.title: Listen to My Body
books.summary: Each of us has a wonderful body. But have you ever listened to what it tells you?

books.title: The Very Shocking Report Card
books.summary:
What would happen if report cards were not all about studying and writing exams? What
marks would you get then?

books.title: Daddy's Mo
books.summary: What does Anu like the most about her dad? His Mo! Do you know what a Mo is? Actually, Anu likes everyone with a Mo. So much so that when she sees a Mo, she gets funny ideas!

books.title: I Am Not Afraid!
books.summary: A little girl goes out alone in the dark. What does she find? This book is one of the four books in the 'Growing Up' series.

books.title: No!
books.summary:
A certain little girl is in the habit of saying ‘No’.
She says it a lot. In fact, all of the time.
One day though, she is faced with a very tempting
question and can’t help but say ‘YES!’
Perhaps saying ‘Yes’ isn’t so bad after all.

books.title: The Balloon Man
books.summary: Chiku buys a balloon and also asks her friends to buy some. But her friends could not buy the balloons because…read more to find out!

books.title: Rainbow Boys
books.summary: Are all boys alike? Do they like the same things, should they dress similarly? Let's think about it.

books.title: The Cat in the Ghat!
books.summary: This is a book that takes you deep into the jungles of the Western Ghats. A wildlife photographer sets out to find an elusive wild cat and meets a menagerie of fascinating creatures. Quirky illustrations pepper a funny narrative inspired by real-life adventure. What better way to invite you to join his quest!

books.title: Londi: The Dreaming Girl
books.summary: Londi loves to dream all day. But where will her dreams take her?

books.title: Think Before You Act
books.summary: A man takes advice from his friend without thinking twice about it himself. Where do you think this will lead him?

books.title: Samira's Awful Lunch
books.summary: Samira doesn't like the lunch her mother has packed in her tiffin box. All her animal friends feel bad for her and offer her their lunch. Read all about Samira's lunchtime adventure...

books.title: Piku's Little World
books.summary:
Piku loves long summer afternoons, and
dislikes dark summer evenings. But his
afternoons become darker when, all of
a sudden, there is no one to read Piku a
story. Will Piku’s books remain unread?

books.title: Hungry on the Steps
books.summary: Pranav is hungry. As he climbs up the steps to his house slowly, many others join the line behind him. Who can make him run up the steps?

books.title: The Peacock Who Wished to Fly
books.summary: Peacock is sad. He wants to be able to fly like the other birds. What happens when he starts collecting feathers?

books.title: The Girl Who Thinks in Numbers: Data Warrior  Prukalpa Sankar
categories: The Girl Who Thinks in Numbers: Data Warrior Prukalpa Sankar
books.summary: Prukalpa Sankar loves numbers. They help her see patterns and solve community problems. How does she do this?

books.title: Manasa Collects a Rainbow
books.summary: Manasa is on the hunt for a different kind of rainbow. Can she do it? Let’s find out. Join Manasa on her adventure.

books.title: Amma, There is a Bat in My Sambar!
categories: there is a bat in my sambar!
books.summary:
Suppi is not at all happy to see a bat flying about in his house. In fact, he is quite scared of the bat.
How can Suppi and Amma get the bat back to her family?

books.title: A Tree's Heart
books.summary: Did you know trees are storytellers? Listen carefully and you can hear them whisper many stories — of forest fires and rain, of summer and winter, of our past and future. Look carefully around a tree’s heartwood and you will discover many tales, like the one in this book.

books.title: The Tino, the Rhear and the Biger
categories: The Tino the Rhear and the Biger
books.summary: Tingu Tiger is not happy with his furry orange skin, so he exchanges it with Ranga Rhino. But when he wants his skin back, Ranga has already given it to Bubloo Bear! Will the tino, rhear and biger go back to being tiger, rhino and bear? Find out in this fun story about muddled up animals.

books.title: A Tea Garden Party
books.summary: Abha is going to the cool hills of Darjeeling. On the way she stops at a tea factory. She has so many questions! Is tea a leaf? Where does it grow? What makes it taste so good? Go on a tour of a tea garden and factory and find the answers to these questions with Abha.

books.title: Peepre in the Postbox
books.summary: Peepre the ant finds herself in a postbox! Share her journey to discover how mail travels from one place to another.

books.title: Suppamma Loves to Craft
books.summary: Suppamma loves to build things out of recycled waste. But she doesn’t like paying attention in school, or doing homework. Can Suppamma become successful by following her passions?

books.title: Apu's Giant Earthquake
books.summary: Did Apu’s singing cause the earth to tremble and shake? Or was it an earthquake? Find out more in this humorous and fascinating story about earthquakes.

books.title: Sports Day
books.summary: Lace up your shoes, drink some water, and get ready for Sports Day. Happy, sad, nervous, excited - the students of KV School are feeling so many emotions. Aska-lakadi-gala-galoo, cheer them, won’t you?

books.title: My Inside Weather
books.summary: Sometimes our feelings are hard to talk about, but everyone knows how to talk about the weather.

books.title: One Big Cake
books.summary: Domdom has one big cake, what is he going to do with the cake?

books.title: Achchachi's Bagbrella
books.summary: Sahyadri lost her umbrella at school, again. Amma is going to be very angry. Luckily for Sahyadri, Achchachi is going to help her make a new umbrella. A story that introduces the concept of pie charts.

books.title: Why Do Bees Buzz?
books.summary: Why can't bees work quietly? They buzz because there are some very good reasons to do so. Learn about the humble bees in this book.

books.title: Posto, Please Clean Your Desk!
books.summary: Posto’s desk is messy. Crayons, pencils, paintbrushes and books are scattered all over. Ma wants him to clean it up. Read this delightful picture book to find out whether Posto cleans and sorts his desk.

books.title: Up World, Down World
books.summary: In a canopy forest in India, the Up World and Down World have always been suspicious of each other. But it all changes when Gopa the dormouse drops her book by accident on Fatima’s head. A story about the biodiversity of the canopy forests and friendship.

books.title: Let's Fly a Plane!
books.summary: Have you ever dreamed of being a pilot? Open this book, step into the cockpit and let’s fly an aeroplane!

books.title: A Dancer's Tale
books.summary: Phyllis Spira was dancing by the age of four. That was just the beginning of her journey towards becoming one of South Africa’s Prima Ballerinas.

books.title: Wildlife in a City Pond
books.summary:
Wetlands in any city are seen mostly as wasteland, waiting 
to be built over. It takes a tireless environmentalist to show us what city ponds really are – magically rich ecosystems worth preserving. Based on a real-life experience, here is a story that introduces us to the delightful fauna and flora in the urban landscape.

books.title: The Missing Bat
books.summary: There was a cricket bat missing from Rehman Chacha's warehouse, and he suspected that young Ahmed had stolen it. A funny tale from Kashmir, the land of the willow trees.

books.title: Colourful Birds
books.summary: Once upon a time, all the birds in the world were white. Only Grandfather Magic could change their colours. What did he create?

books.title: Every Drop Counts
books.summary: Samir is on a mission to save all the water he can. His mission takes him to several houses where he learns new and exciting ways to make every drop count! Can he, with the help of his Mina Chachi, make a difference?

books.title: A House for Mouse
books.summary: Mouse is looking for a new house. Friendly animals offer to share their homes with him. But nothing is right until he finds his own little spot, warm and cosy.

books.title: Sahana Makes Music
books.summary: Sahana’s home is too quiet. How can Sahana liven it up? She starts creating some music of her own. Listen in.

books.title: The Quirquincho and the Fox - A Folktale from Argentina
categories: The Quirquincho and the Fox - A Folktale from Argentina
books.summary: A quirquincho and a fox are very good friends and spend all their time together having fun. But one sunny morning, the quirquincho decides to start working, while his friend, the fox, has other plans... Find out this what happens to them in this vibrant land of Argentina.

books.title: Goldfish Genius
books.summary: Neo’s new goldfish is a genius. But when Neo goes outside to play, the goldfish tries to follow her and ends up going on an incredible adventure.

books.title: My Brother's Wheeeeelchair
books.summary: Meet Durva and Dhrubo. And Dhrubo's wheeeeelchair. Join the brother and sister as they explore parks, markets, and many other places and have lots of fun together, just like siblings do.

books.title: The Grass Seeker
books.summary: As the weather turns warm, Room Singh takes his flock of goats and sheep and scales the Himalayas for fresh grass. With global warming a reality, this photo book traces the journey that a Gaddi shepherd has been making for the last 40 years.

books.title: The Adventures of Akara and Linio
categories: The Adventures of Akara and Linio
books.summary: Akara is a standing line. Linio is a sleeping line. The two friends go out to play with their other line friends. What do you think happens?

books.title: Dots
books.summary: Dots, dots and dots. So many different types of dots. Big and small. Colourful, black and white. Do you want to see them?

books.title: The New Road
books.summary: Chapansi is worried about inswa when the new road is built. But the inswa have a plan.

books.title: Jungle Brew
books.summary: Bulbuli had heard so much about the mysterious place in the jungle that everybody talked about but nobody had visited. Was she actually going to have the biggest adventure of her life with only Totaram for company?

books.title: Peacocks and Pakodas!
books.summary: From listening to a melodious Kajari to watching tiny waterfalls, and from the lovely scent of moist soil to the smell of Amma's pakodas, Meenu loves every bit of the monsoon.

books.title: Hugs in the City
books.summary: This is Jilly. Today, she hugged most of the cats in town!

books.title: The Snail's Wonderful Journey
books.summary: Cheta the Snail wants to take a bus journey. He tries many times to catch the bus, but it is not as easy as he hoped! Will his dream ever come true?

books.title: A Suitable Shell
books.summary: Mili the hermit crab has lost her shell. She combs the beach for a suitable shell, but all she meets is litter, people, and angry snails. Will Mili find a shell before it gets too hot?

books.title: Emotions Come and Go
books.summary: Look out for the emotions you feel and why!

books.title: Raza Meets the King
books.summary: Raza's father Rahmat Khan is the royal tailor to none other than the great Mughal emperor Akbar. When they go to the palace to deliver the Emperor's new summer clothes, Raza realizes that the emperor is not completely satisfied with his father's designs. Raza wants desperately to help his father. But what can a little boy do?

books.title: Busy Mother Hen
books.summary: Mother Hen sits patiently waiting for her eggs to hatch. How long will it take? Is she going to miss the fair?

books.title: Inside the World Wide Web
books.summary: Know how to send an email? Of COURSE! Then you know what the internet is, don't you? Umm... sort of. And you know what www means, right? Wellll... kind of. You are feeling a little silly right now, aren't you? Mmmm. Never fear, Nettikutti is here! Gather round to listen as our bright little friend unravels the magic and mystery of the ginormous digital brain called the world wide web.

books.title: Kick, Start, Go!
books.summary: Have you ever wondered how a motorcycle works? It all begins with a kick!

books.title: It's a Laddoo Party!
books.summary:
Mira and Mihir have a box full of laddoos. Just when they want to eat… DING DONG!
Oh, a guest. They have twelve laddoos.
How many laddoos do they each get?

books.title: That Night
books.summary:
Chaitu wakes up to loud and angry voices. The night is dark but a fire rages in the distance. Chaitu is terrified for her family, friends and home. Why are these voices so angry? What do they want? A story set in a world fed by fear
and intolerance.

books.title: The Grumpus Rumpus
books.summary: Mama Wagtail is worried because her baby Grumpus does not know how to show that he is happy. But how do animals and birds show that they are happy? Find out in this wonderful story about animals and birds.

books.title: It Wasn't Me!
books.summary: Mom is going out for five minutes. What could go wrong?

books.title: Fly By Bye!
books.summary: In this wordless story, let's explore our world from the perspective of a fly.

books.title: Princess Bahati
books.summary: Princess Bahati’s kingdom is facing a big problem, and the young princess has an idea that might help. But will the King and the elders listen to her advice?

books.title: Grandfather Goes on Strike
books.summary:
Most grandfathers are content to lie back
in an armchair and lazily read the day's 
newspaper. Not our tree loving senior citizen.
He goes on strike for his beloved trees
and a series of hilarious events liven up this 
entertaining tale. Read on to find out
who saves the day and who saves the trees!

books.title: I want to...
books.summary:
This little girl loves doing things.
Do you?

books.title: Arun in Ruins
books.summary: Arun and Arunachalam are stuck inside a mysterious old palace. The only way they can get out is by building an electronic circuit. But how will they do it?

books.title: All About Beaks
books.summary: Birds have beaks of all kinds, and they use them in many different ways. Dip in.

books.title: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Road
categories: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Road
books.summary: Nanammal and Kamalathal love to travel. They need to catch a train to get to Goa. Explore different modes of transport with the two friends and find out if they make it in time to the station.

books.title: So Many Leaves
books.summary: Some leaves are tiny, others are not. Some taste sweet, others bitter. There are so many different kinds of leaves around us. Leaf through the leaves of this book about leaves.

books.title: Sweet Memories of Gutar Goo
books.summary: Open this special album to meet Gutar Goo and his rocking family and friends. Join the pigeon as he steps out of his (egg)shell into a wonderful new world where he finds his flock and is embraced with love and joy. A tongue-in-cheek book that celebrates identity and of course, pigeons.

books.title: My Aaji Has a Tail
books.summary: Where is Aaji’s tail? A little girl keeps wondering why everyone can see her grandmother’s tail, except for her! 'My Ajji has a Tail' is a Pratham Books digital book and was one of the winners of the Retell, Remix and Rejoice contest 2017.

books.title: A Very Green Day
books.summary: Greeny has so much energy. She doesn't want to nap! One day, she decides to run away. After playing in the hot sun for a while, Greeny gets tired and wants to go home. But now she's lost! How will she get home to her dad?

books.title: Where is Lulu?
books.summary: Where is Lulu and why is she hiding?

books.title: Every Tree Counts
books.summary: From the stately Deodar and colourful Coral to the majestic Banyan and common Pipal, the book takes children on a journey across varied landscapes as they count trees, and picture the uses of each tree. Look around you to find more trees, and learn what these terrific trees can do.

books.title: Reeti and Mithu
books.summary: Reeti's holidays have begun, but she isn't happy. She doesn't like holidays because she misses being with her friends. One day she gets a pet - Mithu, the talking parrot. Does Mithu become her new best friend? Read this heartwarming story of friendship to find out!

books.title: Angry Akku
books.summary: Akku is having an awful day and it’s making her very, VERY angry. Read this book to find out how Akku's anger melts away, and get ideas on what to do when YOU are very, VERY angry.

books.title: Croak
books.summary: There’s a frog in the classroom, warn the students. A frog is eating up masterji’s lunch. A frog is sitting on masterji’s chair. But masterji isn’t going to fall for his students’ pranks today.

books.title: Puppy Hears a Noise
books.summary: A puppy hears an awful noise that disturbs his sleep at night. He tries to find out who is making the noise. Where do you think the noise is coming from?

books.title: The Cat Ate The Sweet
books.summary: A fat cat wants to eat some sweets. What will the fat cat do to eat sweets?

books.title: A Big Day for the Little Wheels
categories: A Big Day for the Little Wheels
books.summary: The little wheels in Shazia’s new cycle think they are very special. What they don’t know is that wheels are everywhere, even when we can’t see them.

books.title: Tree's Company: a play
books.summary:
Three stories about three special trees. A
wonderful play about the importance of
plants in our lives, with a strong message
of conservation.

books.title: The Body Builders
books.summary: Vava is amazed that his little sister knew how to make her hair, her lungs and her ever-growing legs when she was in Amma’s belly. Join him as he explores how the millions of cells inside us grow and build our bodies.

books.title: Shh! What's That?
books.summary: Tara and Dia are about to go to bed when they see something on the wall. A monster! Will the siblings be able to chase the monster away?

books.title: The Clever Tortoise
books.summary: The tortoise sees the monkeys eating wood apples and wants to taste them. But first, he has to figure out how to crack open the hard shell. Can you help him?

books.title: Everyone Eats
books.summary: Each animal has different food. Let's find out what they eat.

books.title: Where Is My Bat?
categories: Maazee Bat Haravlee Maazee bat Sapadlee
books.summary: Oh no! There is a missing bat, and it just can’t be found. Can you guess where it is?

books.title: Spider, Spider
books.summary: How does a spider spend her time? Join this spider for a midnight walk to find out!

books.title: Silkworm
books.summary: Read about the journey of a silkworm in this beautifully illustrated book!

books.title: What's Cooking?
books.summary:
While Mira’s father goes to the market to buy raisins, the kheer he was cooking disappears. Who
ate up the kheer while he was away?

books.title: First House
books.summary: Long, long ago, when people lived in caves, two brothers in the northeastern part of India, now called Arunachal Pradesh, decided to build their own house. In a folktale that refers to the rich fauna of this region, we learn how the first house was built.

books.title: Kheer on a Full Moon Night
categories: Kheer on a full moon night
books.summary: Meenu wants to play a mrudangam, dham, dham dham, and do you know, Amma wants to learn to ride a scooter? The Dasara holidays promise to be a lot of fun!

books.title: Where is my bat?
categories: Maazee Bat Haravlee Maazee Bat Saapadlee
books.summary:
Now and then you hear a child talking to himself and describing an event. 
And how vivid the sketch is! Where is My Bat? is one such lively account.

books.title: What Shall I Wear Today?
books.summary: On some days, it is so difficult to decide what to wear. The little girl in this story tries on many dresses before she finds the perfect one.

books.title: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike Does Not Like Fruits!
categories: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike does not Like Fruits!
books.summary:
Miss Laya the Games Teacher loves helping people! Join her and her fantastic motorbike as they
vroom off on a fruit-filled adventure. This is the fourth in a series of stories called Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike.

books.title: A Dog Called Shoo
books.summary: “Shoo!” says everyone who sees the little brown dog. She hears the word so often that she begins to think it’s her name. Until a boy taking a shortcut home decides to share his lunch with her...

books.title: The Mighty Tethys Sea
books.summary: A hundred million years ago, the Earth looked very different. Where there are mountains now, there used to be seas. Even the continents had different shapes altogether! But how did it all change into the Earth of today?

books.title: Ahilyabai Holkar
books.summary:
This is the story of Ahilyabai Holkar, a queen who ruled Malwa for 28 years. Read about
this ruler who made history with her deeds.

books.title: Our Encounter with a Snow Leopard
categories: Our Encounter With A Snow Leopard
books.summary: What happens when a girl encounters a snow leopard?  On a summer day in a valley in Ladakh, Lobzang Le and her brother have taken their parents' livestock for grazing. They freeze with fear when they face a snow leopard, eyeing their goats. Read this amazing true story about coming face to face with the elusive big cat of Ladakh and how the children deal with it.

books.title: How Bittu Bottu Got Better
books.summary: Andy’s robot Bittu Bottu did everything for him, from his housework to his homework. But when Bittu Bottu got in trouble, would Andy be there for him?

books.title: Who's That in the Mirror?
books.summary: Who’s that in the mirror? Manasa is going to do what she does best—find out.

books.title: A Beautiful Day
books.summary: It’s a beautiful day for a picnic. Everyone wants to join in the fun.

books.title: King of Birds
books.summary: The birds want a king, but they have difficulty choosing. They decide that the bird that can fly highest will be made king. The African Vulture thinks he has won the contest, but a tiny bird tricks him. Do the birds get their king?

books.title: Manners in the Park - Spot the Difference
books.summary: In the park we go and play, skip, skate, swing, make friends and run around. Sometimes we also litter, fight, trip and push our friends. Spot the differences with your friends, teachers or parents and find out how you would like to play in the park.

books.title: The Book of Stolen Secrets
books.summary: Secrets are meant for sharing only with people you know and trust. But watch out for sneaky people who are trying to steal them!

books.title: Three Friends
books.summary: Three friends decide to cook a chilla…read more to find out what happens!

books.title: Mummy's Glasses
books.summary: Mummy has lost her glasses again! It’s up to Nimu and Mirchi to find them. But what else will they find on the way?

books.title: My Cousin Visits My Village
books.summary: Nouy lives in a village in the countryside. One day, her cousin Ek comes to visit. He is from the city. Nouk shows him everything she loves about her village. Will Ek love her village, too?

books.title: The Big Beach Clean-Up
books.summary: Arzu loves the beach and is determined to restore it. But this is a big problem to solve! With the help of her friends and a little bit of maths, Arzu finds that all problems have their solutions.

books.title: With Love, Gaia
books.summary:
A beautiful leaf flutters from the palm of Gaia, Mother Earth, with a message for Kaya and Kabir. 
What’s the message?
Read on to find out about Kaya and Kabir’s adventure.

books.title: Twice as Tall
books.summary: Muthulakshmi P. is growing very tall. Nobody can tell how tall she will be when she is all grown up. But what if her height doubled? And doubled over and over again?

books.title: The Plant Whisperer
books.summary: Young Jaishree loves nothing more than plants. She wants to understand them, which is why she decides to spend her life studying plants. This biography of ecologist Dr H Jaishree Subrahmaniam is a story of passion and gumption.

books.title: Vegetable Friends
books.summary: Ladyfinger is feeling sad. What can his friends do to help? Read more to find out!

books.title: How the Toad Got Its Skin
categories: How the toad got its skin
books.summary: This tale explains why toads have bumpy backs and can live away from water.

books.title: White Butterfly
books.summary: The White Butterfly wants to go to school like the other butterflies, but he needs some school supplies. Can you help the White Butterfly find them?

books.title: Bounce!
books.summary: Kayal bounces her ball a little too high. Meet different people in the neighbourhood who try to help Kayal catch the ball in this counting book.

books.title: Bonda and Devi
books.summary: Do best friends always have to be alike? Devi and Bonda are best friends, but Devi is a little girl, while Bonda is a… Well, he can lift heavy boxes, he can extend his arms and legs, he never forgets anything he’s told, he can be turned on and off. Can you guess what he is?

books.title: Abebe and the English Boys
books.summary: Abebe was a boy who loved learning languages.

books.title: Going Home
books.summary: Why is the little girl in a hurry to get home? Find out in this sweet story.

books.title: The Water Seed
books.summary: When the rains did not come, the young men of the village went in search of water. One of them brings back a water seed!

books.title: Lion on the loose
books.summary: Do rainy days make you feel that the world is full of possibilities? The lion in the story certainly believes so! Read this story to meet him as he takes a rainy day holiday from the zoo and have as much fun as the children in the story. After all, the author maintains that this story is ‘almost true’!

books.title: P.S. What's up with the climate?
categories: P.S. What's Up With the Climate?
books.summary: It’s too hot. It’s too cold. There’s no rain. There’s too much rain. There’s less snow. There’s too much carbon in the atmosphere. Grizzly bears don’t know whether to sleep, penguins don’t know what to eat. Kangaroos are escaping forest fires, bees are groggy from all the pesticide. In a world overrun by the climate crisis, is it time to panic yet?

books.title: You Won't Believe Me
