books.summary: Here is a boy who likes his school a lot, but is sure that his school does not like him back. His classmates bully him. His teachers shout at him. But there is a pond full of fish — where he discovers that he’s not alone.

books.title: Sitara Grows Up
books.summary: Sitara’s family is going on a trip to see the grand Taj Mahal. But children who suck their thumbs are not allowed on trains! Poor Sitara. Will she miss out on an adventure just because she sucks her thumb?

books.title: Tok Tok
books.summary: The food-loving king of Sonapur could not sleep because of a mysterious sound in his chambers. What could it be?

books.title: How to Be an Otter
books.summary: An otter passes on wisdom to a group of otter pups. Listen in to find out more about these wonderful river creatures.

books.title: Monumental Maths
books.summary:
What do the pyramids, ancient temples
and Jantar Mantar all have in common?
Maths! Innovative architects across the
world have used mathematics to build
wonders that we still marvel at today.

books.title: Train
books.summary: This story is about a day in the life of a train. Read more to explore!

books.title: The Hundred and Thirty-Seventh Leg
books.summary:
A millipede hurts herself. She needs help. 
Now, which is the leg that needs help? 
A delightful picture book from a winner of 
Sahitya Akademi’s Bal Sahitya Puraskar.

books.title: Unnie and Innie
books.summary: When summer comes, Unnie spends all of his time playing with his toys. After a while, he gets bored with his toys and wants something new to do. He notices that his neighbour, Innie, is never bored. Where do you think Innie finds these adventures?

books.title: Two Mice
books.summary: One day, a real mouse met a computer mouse. Suddenly, a cat began to chase the real mouse and tried to catch him. What happened next?

books.title: Our Library
books.summary: Do you like cars, and dinosaurs, and reading about them? Do you have questions and ideas? Do you like to be read to? Or do you like to read alone in a quiet corner? Come in, welcome to our library!

books.title: Ma! Hurry Up!!
books.summary:
The boy in the story is in a real hurry. 
Wouldn’t you like to find out why?

books.title: Chintu
books.summary: Meet Chintu. He is a special dog! There are other dogs in this story too. Would you like to meet them?

books.title: Under the Invisibility Cloak
books.summary: What would you do if you had an invisibility cloak? For one, playing hide-and-seek would be great fun. But is anyone making invisibility cloaks? Or do they exist only in science fiction and fantasy stories? Arnav and Tanisha head to the library to find out. Let’s follow them quietly – they can’t see us, we are invisible in their world.

books.title: Kallu's world 3 - Mangu Mali and the Ambia Bhoot
categories: Kallu's world 3 - Mangu Mali and the Ambia Bhoot
books.summary:
Welcome to Khajuria – a village where young Kallu and his gang run delightful adventurous riots almost everyday. Sometimes they question the village traditions, defy bullies or might just be going about their daily business but Kallu and his gang are up for anything. Join them as they grow wiser and wittier, happily roaming the village finding new things to do, and see what they come up with!
Everybody in Khajuria knew about Munia's temper. Everybody also knew how stingy Mangu Mali was about giving away mangoes from the tree in his orchard. Now, Munia wanted mangoes...really badly and that too from Mangu Mali's orchard. Can you imagine a situation like this? Read on, to find out what happens...

books.title: What Will Happen?
books.summary: What will happen if Sunita presses her belly button? Or if she pulls her ears? A story about the power of imagination which also introduces children to different parts of the body.

books.title: Your Body Is Yours
books.summary: Your body is unique and it belongs only to you. Get to know it, and learn to take good care of it. A book that aims to start open and healthy conversations around our bodies, and our right to say no to anyone who does not respect boundaries.

books.title: An A-maize-ing Story
books.summary: While Bongie’s family is planting maize in the field, she plants a seed of her own. Bongie takes care of the seed everyday – watering it, making sure it has sunlight, protecting from birds and weeds, and even reading to it. Do you think the seed will grow for Bongie?

books.title: May Searches for the Sea
books.summary: May lives in a mountaintop village miles away from the sea. When her teacher tells her class about his own village by the ocean, May is breathless. She is desperate to see this mysterious sea—but how?

books.title: Ah! Football!
books.summary: On their way to buy salt and oil for grandma, two boys start playing football with their friends!

books.title: Discovering Dinosaurs
books.summary: Long before humans evolved, dinosaurs roamed the Earth. Let’s find out more about these amazing reptiles.

books.title: Serious Accident
books.summary: A boy and a girl witness a serious accident while walking down the road

books.title: The Day It Rained Fish
books.summary: Strange things happen at Ballu the bear's birthday party. Follow him and Avanti the zookeeper as they get drenched in a rain of fish.

books.title: Zanele Situ: My Story
books.summary: As a young girl Zanele Situ was told that she would never walk again. Being in a wheelchair did not stop her. She worked and trained hard and became a winning athlete on the world stage. This is her story…

books.title: At Home
books.summary: Ammini misses school, and her brother Unni misses his aunt. Both of them miss playing in the park. But everyone has to stay indoors. Maybe they can go out for a walk today? Ammini hopes so. A day in the life of two children in a time of lockdowns and social distancing.

books.title: Catch a Ride on Raindrops
books.summary: A group of children travel into the skies and go on an adventure after they catch a ride on raindrops.

books.title: What Happens When You Flush?
books.summary: Nozy the pet rat finds himself in the underground sewers. It’s a good thing Cheeky is around to take him on a splashy, smelly adventure!

books.title: How Big Is a Whale Shark?
categories: How Big Is a Whale Shark
books.summary: A whale shark is a big fish. How big is it? Is it bigger than a blue whale? Or smaller than a dolphin? Set in the marine world, this book introduces the concept of comparison.

books.title: Everyday Superheroes
books.summary: Superheroes don’t always wear capes, or carry weapons. They don’t always fly. Some superheroes wear masks and protective suits. Some carry stethoscopes and thermometers. And some look through microscopes and examine lab reports. A book on everyday heroes in the time of a pandemic.

books.title: Uncle Owl
books.summary: Rats are everywhere in the village! They are destroying rice paddies, wheat fields and chewing clothes and books to bits. The villagers request Uncle Owl to help them scare off the devilish rats.

books.title: Moonlight in the Sea
books.summary: Fatima grows up on an idyllic island in the Lakshadweep, watched over by Nihla, the moon. She falls in love with the underwater world of colourful corals, fascinating fish, mysterious manta rays, grizzled old turtles and dancing dolphins. One day, in a terrible storm, she gets lost at sea. Join Fatima on her incredible adventure on remote islands with wonderful marine creatures.

books.title: 3... 2... 1... Blast-off!
books.summary: This count-down book introduces readers to fascinating celestial objects, to space concepts and to the people involved in the various facets of astronomy. It may just inspire them to take a step towards a career in astronomy. Come, let us go space travelling!

books.title: Ma, Is That You?
books.summary: Who’s that at the door? Is it Ma or a big, scary monster? Bibi, Azeem, Juzer and Thei Thei must make sure that it’s the right person before they let them enter their clubhouse.

books.title: The Mask
books.summary: Naseem made a lovely mask. Feeling grand, he wore it and went for a walk. Did his grand idea work?

books.title: Chiu's Power
books.summary:
Chiu sees exciting things that others cannot – flying rockets and fish swimming on the
blackboard. Ajji takes Chiu to the eye doctor to find out about her magical powers.

books.title: My Car
books.summary: Khaidi has a very special car that takes him to many places. Drooomm... he drives wherever he wants to go. Come, join him on a drive around the world.

books.title: Walking in the Wild
books.summary: Take a walk with Zakhuma, a brave forest guard who lives in Mizoram. As Zakhuma takes us through his forest, we learn about the different animals and what it means to protect the jungle.

books.title: RIA Sorts It Out
books.summary: Abel is worried that his card to Ammachi will get lost because of his bad handwriting. So he visits the post office to find someone to help him sort things out.

books.title: Mona Loves Roti
books.summary: How do you get puffed, hot and delicious Roti? Find it out with Mona!

books.title: ACHOO!
books.summary: Kabir sneezes all the time. Read to find out what fresh troubles his sneezes bring to Kabir and his friends and family!

books.title: Our Swing
books.summary: Anuj loves to play on swings. But there are none nearby. His sister has an idea though…read more to find out!

books.title: The Starlight Adventure
books.summary: Naina and Madhav decide to settle their disagreement in outer space. They end up meeting a host of odd characters – from a unicorn who can't stop eating to a dragon who won't stop crying. But who are these glowy creatures? A space adventure that introduces readers to constellations in the night sky.

books.title: Where Is Number 5?
books.summary: Number 5 is missing! Bulbuli and Maina go searching for her and along the way they meet a bunch of her friends but no one knows where she has disappeared. Are there any surprises in store when they find Number 5?

books.title: Sister, Sister, Where Does the Sun Go at Night?
categories: Sister Sister Where Does the Sun Go at Night?
books.summary: Little Brother's inquisitive mind is always full of questions for Big Sister. He knows Big Sister has all the answers, because she is always reading one big fat book or another. In this book, Little Brother wonders where the sun goes at night. Does he just go to sleep after a long day at work, or does he sink down into the ocean deep to make it daylight for the mermaids who frolic there?

books.title: What's My Mother Tongue?
books.summary: It is Language Day at Zhevili’s school in Nagaland. She has to introduce herself in her mother tongue. But what is her mother tongue? Zhevili isn’t sure. This endearing book tells the story of identity and disappearing languages.

books.title: Cheenu's Gift
books.summary: Cheenu has a lot of fun helping his father. Sometimes, there is a special treat for him too!

books.title: The Conical Hat
books.summary: This is a little poem about a conical hat. It is a hat woven from cane. It is used for many things. Would you like to know more about this delightful little hat?

books.title: Pambaram, the Naughty Top
books.summary: Spin along with Pambaram, the naughty top, which has a mind of its own.

books.title: A Little Like You
books.summary: Rinki can’t remember who she is. An elephant? A deer? Follow Rinki as she finds out.

books.title: Squirrel Goes to School
books.summary: Trang lives in a mountaintop village with her friend Squirrel. One day, she asks Squirrel to come to school. But school sounds like no fun. And school is so far away. Will Squirrel be brave for his best friend?

books.title: Vayu, the Wind
books.summary: A nice story about this silent and always present friend, the wind does a lot of things without anybody's notice!

books.title: Stick Your Tongue Out!
books.summary: Do you think all tongues are soft and pink like yours? Animals have tongues of various shapes, sizes and colours. They use their tongues in many different ways, but not for talking like humans do.

books.title: Suraj and Sher Singh
books.summary: Meet Suraj and Sher Singh as they have fun in the park!

books.title: My Dream in The Drawer
books.summary: I once had a dream, so small and light, I kept it in a box. I kept it hidden, safe and sound, In my drawer of socks.

books.title: Grandpa's Teeth
books.summary: Before sleeping, Grandpa kept his set of teeth in water. But in the morning, it was not there. Where did Grandpa's set of teeth go? Let us find out...

books.title: We Love Our Home
books.summary: Look high and low and you will find animals and birds making their homes around you. Here’s a story about the habitats they live in.

books.title: Cooking
books.summary: I am helping to prepare vegetables for a meal. There is one vegetable I don't like preparing.

books.title: Sharanya Speaks to Robots
books.summary: The new student in school won’t talk to Sharanya, no matter how hard she tries. Why doesn’t he understand her? Can Sharanya find a way to talk to him?

books.title: Why Do Sunbirds Eat All Day?
categories: Why Do Sunbirds Eat All Day?
books.summary: Have you ever seen small colourful birds flying about in your garden? Why do they keep flitting from flower to flower? How do they get the energy to stay up in the air? Follow the two sunbirds, Loten and Lily, to find out.

books.title: My Red T-shirt
books.summary: Aman loves his red T-shirt, because it is so bright and so soft. His Ma hates it, because it is old and has holes in it. She wants to throw it away. He wants to keep it. What is Aman going to do?

books.title: The Dance of  the Flamingo
books.summary: Living like lotus flowers on water, the sight of pink flamingos is one of the most beautiful sights of the natural world. Why are they pink? Do they put on make-up? Do they have even a single bone in their long neck? Here is a book of photographs that answers all the questions about these graceful birds.

books.title: The Adventures of Philautus Frog
books.summary: Philautus, the little tree frog wants to see the wide blue sea, so far away from his home on Big Tree, in the middle of a forest. Take a magnificent trek with Philautus across the Western Ghats teeming with creatures that are funny, fat and fascinating. Seasoned with humour, this lush book reveals the splendours of the wild through a compelling tale.

books.title: Putu and Gutu
books.summary: Putu is a small fish. Gutu is a big fish with big teeth! Oh no! Gutu is coming for Putu? How will Putu escape?

books.title: Sister, Sister, Why don't things fall up?
categories: Sister Sister Why Don’t Things Fall Up?
books.summary: Little Brother's inquisitive mind is always full of questions for Big Sister. He knows Big Sister has all the answers, because she is always reading one big fat book or another. In this book, Little Brother wonders why things don't 'fall up'? At least Mother wouldn't grumble about the mess he was always making on the floor! Of course, Big Sister has the right answer in the end, but before you start reading this fun book to find out, tell us: why do YOU think things fall down?

books.title: Ants
books.summary: Do you know where ants build their homes and what they eat? Read more to find out.

books.title: Jackpot
books.summary: Vikram has high and lofty dreams. He wants to travel the world like a prince and build a library that's unparalleled in its glory. But Vikram can't be bothered with working hard to earn his desires. He looks for the easy way to attain his dreams, and hence proceeds to buy a lottery ticket. Does he win the lottery and finally travel the world? Or does his life begin to crumble due to his thirst and greed for easy money?

books.title: On Mondays I Want to Hide
categories: On Mondays I Want to Hide
books.summary: If the days of the week were people you knew, what would they be like? Your school principal, your sister, or best friend? Would they be happy or difficult, boring or busy?

books.title: My Red Ball
books.summary: A girl kicks a red ball. Where does it go?

books.title: Sani and Suri
books.summary: Sani has a pet cat called Suri. One day, she comes back from school, but cannot find Suri anywhere. While searching all over, she meets different kinds of cats, but none of them are Suri. Will she find her pet? Read and find out!

books.title: Listen
books.summary: Listen to the many sounds that animals and humans make.

books.title: What Does The Firefly Have?
books.summary: As she flies through the forest, a small firefly admires all the animals she passes by. The grasshopper in the green grass, the butterfly spreading out its wings, the weaver-bird swaying in its woven nest, and the spider swinging across the trees. The small firefly is envious. Why can’t she be as beautiful as the other animals? Can you help the firefly discover the beauty she brings to the forest?

books.title: Ox and Donkey
books.summary: A story about a hard-working ox and a clever donkey.

books.title: Paplu, the Giant
books.summary: Paplu was a strange giant who did not like to fight with anyone, nor did he like scaring people. But when his beloved villagers were in danger, he rose to great heights to solve the problem.

books.title: Amma's Toolkit
books.summary: When Mini and Tara’s home is flooded because of a broken pipe in the bathroom, Amma comes to the rescue. What’s in Amma’s tool-kit?

books.title: Veeru Goes to the Circus
books.summary: Veeru comes back from the Jumbo-Mumbo Circus with some very big ideas. Read on to find out more.

books.title: Farm Animals
books.summary: Who are the different farm animals? Find listed in this book!

books.title: Baby Who Cried
books.summary: Baby is unhappy. What will the mother try?

books.title: Who can help me?
books.summary: Find out who helps this child create a book!

books.title: My First Day at School
books.summary: Sesi is six years old and lives with her parents in Turiani. After her first day at school, she comes home and tells them something funny that happened at school. What do you think happened?

books.title: Who Got the Goat?
books.summary: Chinnasura and Cheekasura spot a stray goat. Both want it. The only way out is to have a neer-more drinking contest. Learn fractions and decimals while the asuras drink up.

books.title: The Salt Inspector
books.summary: Munshi Vanshidar lacks the ability to be dishonest or corrupt in spite of being surrounded by greedy people soaked in money. As the salt inspector, he is true to himself and to the integrity of his work. Soon, this leads him to clash with Pandit Alopideen, the most powerful man in their area. What follows is a tale that will always be relevant to our society, portraying the constant war between the lure of money and the need to be moral.

books.title: Counting Cabbages
books.summary: A Maths story about counting and sharing.

books.title: Chulbul's Tail
books.summary: Naughty Chulbul was not happy with her own tail. She decided to try on other tails. Did that help? Find out in this sweet little tale.

books.title: CHEW CHOMP YUM! All that is good for your tum!
categories: CHEW CHOMP YUM! All that is good for your tum!
books.summary: We live because we eat. Do we know what to eat? And do we know how to eat? Food for thought...for a happy tum!

books.title: The Elephant in the Room
books.summary: Lindi finds a very large elephant in her room. But is it really there if no one else believes in it?

books.title: Where Did Your Dimples Go?
books.summary: Langlen has curly hair like Appa and a cleft chin like Imma. It makes her wonder why brothers and sisters, or parents and children look alike. Is she just a collection of traits, then? So many questions, but Imma and Appa have all the answers.

books.title: Roli-Poli
books.summary: Roli-Poli have a lot of fun playing with water! Read more to learn about this fun.

books.title: Flying High
books.summary: Go along with Chandu as he dreams of flying. What do you dream of?

books.title: Fly Safe, Godavan
books.summary: Rania is determined to keep the little godavan chick and her Ma safe. But there are so many threats to the survival of the Great Indian Bustard.

books.title: Rose and Rocky's War On Insects
categories: Rose and Rocky's War On Insects
books.summary: Rose and Rocky hate insects because they bite and sting. What makes them change their mind? Join Rose and Rocky in their adventures in this fun book about insects.

books.title: Where Am I?
books.summary: Insects and reptiles protect themselves by being able to hide in plain sight in their surroundings. A spotting book about camouflage.

books.title: The Lazy Ant
books.summary:
Lazy ant is very lazy. He lets the other
ants do all the work. Will he ever stop
being lazy?

books.title: Rama Goes to Town
books.summary: ‘Rama Goes to Town’ tells the story of a young girl who leaves her village for the first time on a visit to the town with her father. She learns about all the different forms of transportation and motor vehicles.

books.title: I want to!
books.summary: This cute little baby knows exactly what she wants. She wants to eat, she wants to play, and she wants to read a book with Mama!

books.title: Girisha from the Hills
books.summary: When a wild elephant turns up in Girisha’s village, people are afraid, but not Girisha. She is brave. What do you think she will do to calm the elephant?

books.title: How the Myna Ate the Sun
categories: How the Myna Ate the Sun
books.summary: A very hungry myna wants to eat her favourite food, the sun! But is it possible to eat the sun? Find out in this beautiful book about food chains.

books.title: The Timid Train
books.summary: Loco, the new train felt rather scared of going anywhere. But every time it let out an "Ooo!" in fright, it came out as a strong whistle and everybody said Loco was a fine train. Come take a ride with Loco as it chugs merrily across the country.

books.title: A Sweet Apple
books.summary: Rajani loves to draw using her imagination. However, her mother always wonders why Rajani’s drawings aren’t more realistic. How can Rajani show her mother that there’s not just one right way to draw?

books.title: Art Is Everywhere - Here, There and in Everyday Objects
categories: Art Is Everywhere - Here There and in Everyday Objects
books.summary: Art is around us, not only in drawings and paintings. In this sequel of the Art is Everywhere series, the reader joins the artist in looking for forms and shapes in daily objects. Coupled with irreverent rhymes, this book series hopes to give wings to the reader’s imagination.

books.title: Muthu and Kappu
books.summary: Muthanna of Kottageri does not like black cats. They bring bad luck, he is sure. What happens when Gangu and Raja bring home the blackest of kittens?

books.title: The Tale of the Water Hyacinth
categories: The Tale of the Water Hyacinth
books.summary: Millions of water hyacinth plants live in the canals along the Mekong Delta near Nep’s village. Nep thought that she knew everything there was to know about the plant. But when she sees her mother drying and weaving the stems of the plant, she becomes curious.

books.title: Feelings
books.summary: Read this short story to see how many things we feel in just ONE day!

books.title: The Birthday Present
books.summary: Maya the Tortoise tries everyday to get to school in time, but ends up being late. She needs a bicycle. But where ever will she find a bicycle for a tortoise? Read on to see what she receives as a birthday present.

books.title: Neelumbera on a Full Moon Night
categories: Neelumbera on a Full Moon Night
books.summary: Young Baku loves counting and watching birds. One day, he wanders into a magical forest with colourful trees. There is trouble here that can only be solved by the mystical Neelumbera flower. Could Baku’s love for maths come in handy?

books.title: Thembi and the Singing Tree
books.summary: Thembi's favourite place is under the big tree behind their house where she sits alone, listening to the singing of the tree. Thembi’s grandmother worries about her and decides to find out why she is lonely.

books.title: The Mundu Magicians
books.summary: Unni wants to be a mundu magician, just like his Ammumma. What can he make with Ammumma’s old mundus?

books.title: The Great Cake Contest
books.summary: Who will win the Great Cake Contest? A sweet story about a little boy who wants to make the best cake.

books.title: Cracking the Code: Women Who Have Changed the Way We Look at Computers
categories: Cracking the Code: Women Who Have Changed the Way We Look at Computers
books.summary: What do 19th Century English mathematician Ada Lovelace, new-age fashion designer Anouk Wipprecht, and the current Digital Minister of Taiwan Audrey Tang have in common? They’ve all impacted the way we look at computers and coding. This book introduces some inspiring women from the world of technology, from across a century.

books.title: Greed
books.summary: Vusi is greedy and eats up all the fruits. What happens next?

books.title: Fly in Space
books.summary: Two fruit flies are born on Earth and raised in space.

books.title: The Bounce
books.summary: Black Dog is unhappy. He is lonely and everyone seems to be having more fun. So, he bounced … and bounced … and bounced …

books.title: Saru and her Little Secret
books.summary: Mai does not approve of indiscipline and Saru finds it hard to always walk the straight and narrow path. Saru often gets into trouble with Mai. What has she done this time? What will happen when Mai finds out? Read on to find out more.

books.title: The Sun takes a Bath
books.summary: The lonely sun has no one to play with up in the sky. He wants to join the fish swimming in the river. But they say he makes them too hot! Is there any way the sun can make friends with the creatures on the earth below?

books.title: Suma
books.summary: Suma is alone and bored. Read to know what all she does to have some fun!

books.title: Noisy Crows
books.summary: Caw! Caw! The crow in this book is calling out to young readers to read this book. This book is one of the four books in the 'Animals Around Us' series.

books.title: A Friend for Poochi
books.summary: Making friends isn’t easy, especially if you’re a hairy, scary Poochi. But one day Poochi ventures out of his hiding place to make a friend. Join him, won’t you?

books.title: Gadbad Das in 'No water for you!'
categories: Gadbad Das in 'No water for you!'
books.summary: Gadbad Das is the son of the famous singer, Gardhab Das. He lives in a small town in India. Like his father, Gadbad is a very bad singer. Everybody knows this, except him! He does various odd jobs to survive and solves his problems musically mostly. Like this one, where there is no water for his puncture shop. Off goes Gadbad Das to find some water, but it’s not as easy as you’d think.

books.title: Dadi, Dadi, What Colour Do You See?
categories: Dadi Dadi What Colour Do You See?
books.summary:
When Guddu, Golu and Dadi go to the mela and try on magic glasses, they discover a whole new world of colours.
A simple book on how primary colours interact
to form secondary colours.

books.title: Yellow Earth, Brown Earth
books.summary: Avi is an explorer. A cloud-watcher, a seed-sorter and a puddle-splasher. Travel to Avi’s favourite place — the Earth — in this book about noticing and recognising patterns.

books.title: Shikari's Cycling Adventure
books.summary: When Shikari finds his life come to a pause, he decides to go on a thrilling adventure - cycling all the way from Bangalore to Delhi to watch the Asian Games. Click, clack, he pedals away.

books.title: The Lost Ball
books.summary: Jami wants to play with his friends. But he can't find the ball in his messy room! How long are his friends willing to wait?

books.title: A Perfect Match
books.summary: When the Halwas and the Jalebis were playing against each other, it was more than just a hockey match. It was a game full of delectable thrills where talent, team work and team management were on full display. Add a dash of the unexpected and you have what can only be called a perfect match!

books.title: I Know
contributors: San srei nou ch nou ch
books.summary: I go to School, I know a lot.

books.title: The Adventures of Chaddi Head
books.summary:
Junaid’s the best superhero in the universe - Chaddi Head! Off he goes on many
adventures to find the perfect sidekick.

books.title: When Amma Went to School
books.summary: Meera's mother went to her school one day but everyone was missing - Meera, her friends, the teachers, even the Principal. Where had they all disappeared?

books.title: Where is Nandini?
books.summary: The farm has cows of different sizes. Malini has to take them to graze in the field. While she watches them, her little cousin Nandini goes missing! So she sets out to track Nandini down. Will she find her? The story introduces the concept of sorting.

books.title: I Love Grey
books.summary: Tokato loves all colours. But the colour he loves most reminds him of cosy nights by the campfire with his dad. Discover Tokato’s colourful world in this heartwarming picture book.

books.title: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Air
categories: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Air
books.summary: Nanammal and Kamalathal love to travel. In fact, they are on a vacation in Manali to celebrate Kamalathal’s birthday now. But will she get to fly a hot-air balloon? Explore different modes of air transport with the two friends.

books.title: Jalebi
books.summary: Muniya wanted to eat some jalebis. Did her wish come true? Read more to find out.

books.title: Why is Nita Upside Down?
books.summary: Nita’s hanging upside down. Can she turn the right way round?

books.title: I Know My Rights
books.summary: The United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child lists out the basic rights that children have. It doesn’t matter where you come from, what colour your skin is, whether you practice a religion or not, what language you speak, whether you are a boy or a girl or haven’t decided yet – you have the right to these rights! This poster books lists out some of the rights of the child.

books.title: Garden of Medicines
books.summary: This book describes how the vegetables that grow in our garden keep us fit and healthy. How do green vegetables help us do just that? Read on to find out!

books.title: Ammu and the Sparrows
books.summary: Ammu spends his days with Ammamma. He feeds the birds and waits to see if Amma and Accha sparrow will come visit.

books.title: The Lonely Whale Shark
books.summary:
A big little whale shark is sad and lonely on his reef. But when he meets a group of whale sharks,
he realises all he needs to do is look around him.

books.title: What Will Shanu Eat?
books.summary: Shanu does not want to eat his food. What are the sparrows, goats and others eating? What food will he finally eat?

books.title: The Kitten
books.summary: A kitten hurt her leg. Will anyone help the hurt kitten? Read more to find out!

books.title: Hide and Seek
books.summary: Shy Rhino is invited to play hide-and-seek with Gecko and the other animals. Follow her to join the fun!

books.title: Sir M. Visvesvaraya: The Builder of Dams, Bridges and a Nation
categories: Sir M Visvesvaraya: The Builder of Dams Bridges and a Nation
books.summary: As a child, Vishwa walked a long way to get to school. As a college student, he tutored two children to make ends meet. And as an engineer, he built dams, bridges and institutions, and the foundation for a modern India. Read this book to know how Sir M. Visvesvaraya observed the world around him, learnt from it, made bold decisions and never shied away from hard work.

books.title: Something's Stuck Around the Duck
books.summary:
When Nandini and Kavitha go to the park, they find a lot of garbage lying around.
A duck has tried to eat a piece of plastic but now it is stuck around her beak.
Can the girls help save the duck and clean up the park for good?

Read on to find out!

books.title: The Crying Deer
books.summary: While playing in the forest, a baby deer got hurt. It wouldn't stop crying until someone special came along. Can you guess who? Look at the story to find out.

books.title: My Big Family
books.summary: Sometimes it can be tiring and frustrating to have a big family. Would being alone be easier?

books.title: What is your name?
books.summary: Meet a little boy whose name is Kiyan. But he has many other names too. How many names do you have?

books.title: The Ladybird
books.summary: Two children discover a ladybird while walking back from school. What kind of insect is it?

books.title: Chop Chop Sizzle
books.summary: Avi loves cooking day, and helping everyone in the family. Join in as Avi explores the kitchen in this book about noticing and recognising patterns.

books.title: The Red Fairy
books.summary: Little Meeto dreams about cars and knows everything about them. One day she meets Red Fairy, a car that can do things that no other car can.

books.title: A Noble Return Gift
books.summary: Lily is very excited! It is her birthday in two weeks and all her friends are going to come celebrate it with her. Lily has a 'colourful' idea about what to give them as a return gift! What is it? Read the story to find out.

books.title: Colours Everywhere
books.summary: Have you ever mixed colours? Read more to find out what happens when you do!

books.title: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike Carries a Big Box
categories: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike carries a Big Box
books.summary: Miss Laya the Games Teacher loves helping people! Join her and her fantastic motorbike as they vroom off with a mysterious box this time around. This is the third in a series of stories called Miss Laya'sFantastic Motorbike.

books.title: The Boink Mystery
books.summary:
BOINK BOINK BOINK...  Aman could hear it. What was 'it'? 
Read on to solve this great mystery set in Jantar Mantar in 
Jaipur. You are sure to have a lot of good clean fun!

books.title: Are You a Fish?
books.summary: There are some strange fish swimming in the sea. They are made of metal, foam and gel, and they hunt for smugglers and pirates. Would you like to see them?

books.title: Tortoise Finds His Home
books.summary: Tortoise sets off in search of his house. Along the way, he meets new friends to help him. But the sky is darkening, and lightning flashes in the distance. Will Tortoise find his house in time?

books.title: Brave Bora
books.summary: Going to the doctor can be scary! Can Bora overcome his fears, with a little help from Baba and Jojo?

books.title: Pick It Up
books.summary: A story that takes a stance against bullying and emphasizes on doing the right thing.

books.title: Cicada's Song
books.summary: Cicada loves to sing. She wants to learn new songs. She decides to visit birds and insects to learn from them. Will Cicada have the chance to sing new songs?

books.title: Mina and the Birthday Dress
books.summary:
Mina finds it hard to choose a dress for her special day. After giving Mum a tough time,
Mina finally makes a choice.

books.title: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Sea
categories: Nanammal and Kamalathal Travel by Sea
books.summary: Nanammal and Kamalathal love to travel. In fact, they are birdwatching along the Kerala backwaters now. Can they spot the willow warbler? Explore different modes of transport with the two friends.

books.title: Black Ant
books.summary: Black Ant is a courageous ant who likes to go on adventures in the bush, meet other animals and learn new things. What do you think will happen on her next adventure?

books.title: What's That Sound?
books.summary: It’s late at night and Reena is lying in bed. Suddenly, she starts to hear a strange noise coming from somewhere in the house…

books.title: Little Goat
books.summary: Little Goat wanders off to look for the sweet grass and doesn’t realise how far she is from Mother Goat.

books.title: Miss Bandicota Bengalensis Digs Up the Seashore
categories: Miss Bandicota Bengalensis Digs Up the Seashore
books.summary:
Miss Bandicota Bengalensis was not just any little Indian mole rat. She had
magical eyes like no other mole rat and she wanted to see everything. Every
night, she packed her explorer's kit: her sunglasses, binoculars, magnifying
glass and of course, her favourite – a strip of sticker bandages. “An explorer is
always prepared,” she said. Every time she dug in a new direction and returned
through a new burrow!
This time our unlikely explorer has surfaced near the sea. Enjoy a walk along
the beach with her as she befriends a host of strange creatures.

books.title: Art is Everywhere - Here, There and in Food
categories: Art is Everywhere - Here There and in Food
books.summary:
Art can happen anywhere, using almost
anything. In this title of the Art is Everywhere
series, the reader joins the artists in looking for
forms and shapes in food. Filled with irreverent
rhymes, these books will give the reader’s
imagination wings.

books.title: The Birthday Chocolate
books.summary: Tutul wants to give her friend some chocolate for her birthday. But nobody in her family is ready to help her! Tutul needs a new plan! Can her clever idea convince the shopkeeper to give her some birthday chocolate?

books.title: Who Drives the Driverless Car?
books.summary: Story time! Paati is here for the summer and Suvi wants to make the most of it. As her grandma starts describing the Pushpaka Vimana, Suvi wonders if it’s like a driverless car, which drives you safely to any destination you name. Buckle up, enjoy the ride!

books.title: What did Priya eat?
books.summary: Priya, the cow, is sick. Her tummy hurts. Read this book to find out why she was unwell, and how her friends helped her.

books.title: Rathna and the Ring of Fire
categories: Rathna and the Ring of Fire
books.summary: For one full minute, the sun will disappear behind the moon, and a ring of fire will be seen instead. Astronomer Rathna is very excited. Watch her day unfold at the planetarium.

books.title: Frog's Bright Idea
books.summary: Frog is hungry! But he can’t catch any insects or moths. Frog has a bright idea, and he is never hungry again. Guess what he did?

books.title: Roy's Noisy Secret
books.summary: Nobody must find out that Roy is wearing his grandmother’s tinkling anklet. But keeping a secret is harder than Roy imagined and he feels weighed down by guilt. How did Roy get himself into this mess and how will he find a way out?

books.title: The Koel with the Sore Throat
categories: The Koel with the Sore Throat
books.summary: It is monsoon, and there's a koel cooing somewhere in the school. But it seems to have a sore throat! Parvez and Stella have never seen or heard a bird with a bad throat before, so they go looking for it.

books.title: Sani, the Beautiful Little Girl
books.summary: Little Sani wants to go out and she has to look beautiful. She decides to put on her mother's makeup. Will she look beautiful in the end? Read on to find out.

books.title: A Cup of Cha
books.summary:
When Meera peers into a teacup, she discovers
a whole new world of science.

books.title: World of Music
books.summary: Vivaan is going for a classical music concert with his mother. A whole world of musical instruments awaits.

books.title: The One and Only Human Body
categories: The one and only human body
books.summary: The human body is amazing! From the smallest muscle to the biggest organ—let’s explore how our bodies work.

books.title: Flowers for My Hair
books.summary: Flowers are on trees and in gardens. They can be in auto rickshaws too. But my favourite type of flower is the one I can wear in my hair. What is your favourite flower?

books.title: The Blue Fairy
books.summary: The Blue Fairy is a tale about two young girls who befriend a fairy and play with her.

books.title: Knight Times
books.summary:
Why do dragons always have to ruin everything?
Now Lilly and Thinama need to chase down this
troublesome reptile and restore the magical ruby to its rightful place.

books.title: Grandpa Fish and the Radio
books.summary: The fish family had a grand old radio in their living room, but the young ones never let poor Grandpa Fish ever get near it it, so busy were they listening to it themselves. Until one day, Grandpa Fish insisted on hearing the news, and heard a very important announcement indeed…

books.title: Little by Little
books.summary: What do two brave little rabbits do when the wolf asks for shelter? Find out in this fun book... little by little.

books.title: Ming-Ming, Fat Little Bear
books.summary: Ming-Ming, fat little bear, wakes up with a standing-up hair! The bear family comes to the rescue to save this from becoming a hair-raising tale.

books.title: The Art Gallery on Princess Street
categories: The Art Gallery on Princess Street
books.summary:
Kekoo and Khorshed Gandhy gave modern
Indian art a window to make a mark around
the world. Bombay’s Gallery Chemould was a
home away from home for the art community.

books.title: Asha's Voice
books.summary: Asha is too small to do many things. But she is big enough to do some things. A story about how you are never too small to have big ideas.

books.title: Hatchu! Ha-aaa-tchu!
books.summary: There is something that Hatchuram does that makes the whole town go topsy-turvy. Would you like to find out what it is?

books.title: How I Like My Rain
books.summary: The world has come to a standstill, and the water is telling many tales. Won't you open this book and listen to the singing rain?

books.title: The Soil
books.summary: This book for early readers describes the uses and importance of soil.

books.title: The Case of the New Planet
categories: The Case of the New Planet
books.summary: Anvi is fascinated by the space and spends her evenings glued to her new telescope. She wants to find out if aliens exist. One night, when she meets aliens on a different planet, she learns there are planets beyond our Solar System and the Milky Way. Read to find out more about these exoplanets.

books.title: My Sister and Me
books.summary:
Anu fights with her sister sometimes. But Anu
also helps her learn new things. A story about
two sisters who love each other.

books.title: Where Do the Groceries Go?
books.summary: Aarav is helping his mother put away the groceries. Will the eggs fit in the tray? Which is the right jar for the rice? How many carrots can he put in one bag? A story about mathematical thinking in our everyday lives.

books.title: Mina Makes a Dash
books.summary: Mina has to take part in the 400-metre dash for Sports Day. She knows she has to practise. First she runs 100 metres, then 200 metres, but can she make it to 400 metres? Learn to measure distance as Mina trains.

books.title: The Lost Doll
books.summary: Abi loves her doll very much, but one day it goes missing. What will she do?

books.title: How is Bimla's Cake So Spongy?
categories: How is Bimla's Cake So Spongy?
books.summary: Chinni and her father bake a cake for her friend in their bakery. Why are cakes so spongy? What makes them rise? Come, let's find out.

books.title: A Hairy Problem
books.summary: Manasa doesn’t like her hair. Why can’t she have hair like her friend Titus? Where did these curls come from anyway? Join Manasa as she finds out!

books.title: Miss Bandicota Bengalensis Discovers the Old Caves
categories: Miss Bandicota Bengalensis Discovers the Old Caves
books.summary:
Miss Bandicota Bengalensis was no ordinary Indian mole rat. She was quite the adventurer. Every evening, she set out with her explorer's kit – sunglasses, binoculars, magnifying glass and a strip of sticker bandages.
“An explorer is always prepared,” she said. Through the night, she dug in a new direction, to a new sea, up a new hill...
Now, join Miss Bandicota and her new friend in exploring one of the oldest hills and caves of India.

books.title: Toast
books.summary: A picnic in a beautiful garden leads to adventure. Who will get the piece of toast? And will they be able to keep it?

books.title: So Much to See
books.summary: There is so much to see in a house — all the little things, the animals and people who make a house a home. Crawl along and watch the world with little Uma.

books.title: Around You: States of Matter
books.summary: Imagine you are at the local market. What do you see around you? Do you think all these things have something in common? A book that introduces readers to matter, and the properties of solids, liquids and gases.

books.title: Junuka and the Rice Rakshasas
books.summary: Growing rice is hard work, and Junuka can’t do it all by herself. Who will help her?

books.title: The Power of Ten
books.summary: A counting book that takes readers to the edge of the universe and back.

books.title: The Rainbow Cover-Up
books.summary: Bhanwari is in trouble. School reopens tomorrow but she has forgotten to cover her books. Bhanwari and Bablu come up with a plan to solve her problem. This time around, it’s maths to the rescue!

books.title: Shongololo's Shoes
books.summary: Shongololo has lost his shoes, and the other animals are NOT being very helpful. Will he ever find them?

books.title: A Pebble in My Shoe
books.summary: Where did the pebble in Ronu’s shoe come from? Did a giant throw it from the sky above? Or did a sea monster bring the pebble in its jaw? If only Ronu knew!

books.title: Treasure Box
books.summary: Rohan wants 13 marbles, and he asks his sister Seema for them. He offers her seeds, balloons, pebbles and beads. Count how many things he gives her in exchange.

books.title: I Like
books.summary: A wordless story about everything a little girl likes.

books.title: Botse-Botse Wants to Get Married
books.summary: After hearing wedding music in the village, Botse-Botse decides that she wants to get married too.

books.title: Just the Way I Am
books.summary: Matko is too wide to fit through the yard-gate. Her friends suggest different exercises to help her slim down, but nothing works. Finally, Matko comes up with her own way to fit in.

books.title: Are You an Insect?
books.summary: Insects are amazing creatures. They can fly, leap, crawl and swim. Scientists are making machines that mimic insects. Would you like to know them?

books.title: Panipuri inside a Spaceship
books.summary:
Chikki is fussy about food. She dislikes mooli paratha because she thinks it smells. She wants to explore space. But she wonders if she will get pizza, panipuri and ice cream in a spaceship. 
Join Chikki and Ninu for lunch as they discuss what astronauts eat while on a mission and why.

books.title: The Louse's New House
books.summary:
A head louse is fed up of its smelly home. Hop, hop, hop it goes, in search of the
perfect new home. Hop along to find out what happens next.

books.title: A New Storybook
books.summary: A boy found an interesting story book. Do you want to know what is it about?

books.title: My Mother's Child
books.summary: My Mother’s Child is the story of Neo, a young boy who becomes a big brother. After being an only child all his life, how will Neo react to his new baby sister? Will his parents treat him differently? Neo is afraid he will become the outcast of the family. Read on to find out what happens!

books.title: Gappu Gola
books.summary: As Gappu Gola pops out of the box, madness tumbles out in this nonsense verse.

books.title: Let's have an Inside Day!
books.summary: Who says a rainy day can’t turn into an exciting inside day?

books.title: The Woodcutter of Gura - A Folktale from Ethiopia
categories: The Woodcutter of Gura - A Folktale from Ethiopia
books.summary: The woodcutter of Gura set out to chop-chop-chop wood one day. He climbed up a tree, perched himself on a branch and began cutting. The village priest who was passing by warned him that if he cut the very branch he was sitting on, he would surely fall down and die. Find out what the woodcutter did in this hilarious tale from enchanting Ethiopia.

books.title: The World of Money
books.summary: The Rupaiya Paisa Series brings out many useful facts about money that will help children to use money wisely as they grow up in an ever-changing world. What were early coins made of? How do people earn, save and use money? Can the family buy a fridge even if it does not have the money for it today? Find out all this and more in The World of Money, Book 1 in the Rupaiya Paisa Series.

books.title: The Dog's Eggs
books.summary: A mama bird lays four eggs. One day, when she leaves the nest to search for food, she comes back to find that someone has taken her place!

books.title: Just Like Me
books.summary: It’s Rahah’s birthday party. Mum wants to know who she will invite. Will they all fit in?

books.title: Goal!
books.summary: Every Sunday, Heena watches a group of girls playing football from her window. She wants to join them. But convincing Ammi and Abbu is not going to be easy. Will she be able to join the team? Run, kick and score goals and experience freedom like never before?

books.title: Asamo, is that you?
books.summary: The lights are out, and Yumum is looking for Asamo. But what if she isn’t the only one wandering about in the dark?

books.title: The Travelling Bug
books.summary:
Ow! Binita Beetle gets bitten by the travel
bug and so what does she do? She packs
her bags and has a grand adventure. As
she travels to different lands, Binita sheds
her old skin, becoming part of the new
spaces and embracing new experiences,
as she discovers the magic of music,
travel, and friendship.

books.title: The World That Mai Built
books.summary: Mai lives in a beautiful colony she designed and built. Prema and Gopi play hide-and-seek and discover different hiding spaces.

books.title: The Trouble with Trouble
books.summary: Trouble’s missing! Who Trouble? Only the naughtiest dog you’ve ever met. Help Abhi look for her?

books.title: Where is Gogo?
books.summary: When Toto spotted Gogo's empty cage, he knew he was in trouble. Would you like to help Toto find Gogo?

books.title: The Right Tools
books.summary: Isha’s house is being built from scratch by a lot of people. Join her as she discovers all the tools they use to build it.

books.title: Navy and Bora
books.summary: Bora can do as much as Navy can. They both can do the same things.

books.title: A Bunch of Flowers
books.summary: What is happening to Peri’s mother? His mother is always sleeping, her room is always dark like a thick forest of tall trees. In this wordless book for early readers, Peri thinks of ways to bring the outdoors and sunshine back into their home and into his mother’s eyes.

books.title: Pipsqueak Hears Echoes
books.summary: Pipsqueak is an insect bat. He loves to eat mosquitoes for dinner. Sometimes, he and his friends have contests to see who will catch the most. Because it’s fun. And easy. What makes bats like him such great insect hunters? Echolocation, says Doctor Ella. She’s telling young Pip all about it. Let’s listen in, shall we?

books.title: This and That
books.summary: Bekku and the little girl like different things. But there is one thing they both love. What do you think it is?

books.title: The School is on Fire!
books.summary: One weekend, Teddy Bear, Ducky, and Fish go to the hill behind their school to roast some sweet potatoes. But suddenly, a strong wind comes and their fire spreads to the bushes. Soon, their school is on fire! What will the three friends do?

books.title: Counting on Moru
books.summary: In Moru's world, numbers danced, digits waved out and long division looked ike a graceful tail. But one day, this world came crumbling down in school. Moru then became the local bully. Then, someone helped him discover the joy of learning again. Read all about it in this heartwarming story.

books.title: Old Woman in a Bottle
books.summary: A greedy, lonely old woman is tired of living inside a bottle. One day, a fairy pays her a visit. Find out what happens to her!

books.title: How Zebra got his stripes
books.summary: Brave Zebra saves the day.

books.title: My Elder Brother
books.summary: The elder brother is found with books and formulas. The younger brother is found with butterflies and lost kites. The elder brother keeps studying everyday and barely does anything else. The younger brother plays in gardens and enjoys doing what he likes. The elder brother takes every chance to criticize his younger brother for not studying. The younger brother still keeps playing outdoors. What follows is a timeless tale of following one's own heart despite those that only ridicule and demotivate.

books.title: A rainbow tale
books.summary: Yana looks around, picks colours to reach the end of rainbow. Find out more about her quest in this book.

books.title: Who Am I?
books.summary: An animal who has a pocket on its stomach and can jump really far! Can you guess its name?

books.title: Four Lambs and a Fox
books.summary: One should be careful telling others a secret.

books.title: I like to read
books.summary: A story about reading.

books.title: Polygon Family
books.summary: The family of Polygons come together in an attempt to know each other! Do you want to know them?

books.title: The Blue Fruit
books.summary: Kasnee was surprised to see a blue fruit on a tree and ran to her mother...read more to find out what happens next!

books.title: The Jungle School
books.summary: The animals in the jungle rush to the new school with great enthusiasm. What do you think happened after that?

books.title: The Owl King's Night
books.summary: Night falls and the owl king starts his gathering. Read more to find out about his night ahead!

books.title: Naughty or Not (Tell me now series)
categories: Naughty or Not (Tell me now series)
books.summary: Often, an inquisitive child asks his parents an endless set of questions. The 'Tell me ... now!' Series describes how interesting the questions and answers turn out. This one is about behaviour.

books.title: A Scary Pit
books.summary: Samira loves to cycle! But suddenly she stops when she hears a goat bleating…

books.title: Mumtaz Embroiders Her Dreams
books.summary: Young Mumtaz has come from her village to Lucknow to learn new stitches for the chikankari that she and the other women in her village do. Thanks to her friend Munnu, Mumtaz learns even more than she had imagined!  Jolly Rohtagi’s sensitive story is illustrated by Ram Soni through sanjhi, the art of paper cutting.

books.title: Where Do My Thoughts Go?
books.summary: A girl is thinking about her thoughts! What do they do all day? Where do they go? Have you seen them anywhere?

books.title: Are You the Woodpecker?
books.summary: Oh no! Killi and Killan the parakeets have lost their home. They set out in search of the woodpecker who can make them a tree hole nest. The birds discover many other nests, but will they find a new home?

books.title: Dugga
books.summary:
Dugga’s days are full of exciting things to see and incredible things to sniff. She sleeps, eats and plays as only a happy dog can. Until, one
day, her life is turned upside down. With no warning at all, Dugga is thrown into a very different, terribly bewildering world. This is the story of how, with the help of humour, empathy and care — her own as well as that of other kind souls, Dugga finds her way back to love, cheer and compassion.

books.title: The Secrets of Rocks
books.summary:
Rocks are everywhere — under the ground,
above the ground, and even at the bottom of
our oceans. But where do rocks come from?
What are they made of? If rocks could talk,
they would share many secrets.

books.title: The Happy Train
books.summary: The Happy Train is a story about the journey of train that ventures far from home into a dark, scary forest and becomes frightened. How do you think the train will overcome her fears?

books.title: We call her Ba - A Biography of Kasturba Gandhi
categories: We call her Ba - A Biography of Kasturba Gandhi
books.summary:
Kasturba Gandhi was no ordinary woman. She had a strong identity, courage and tremendous willpower and she sacrificed a lot for her country. She was a friend and trusted companion of the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi. Gandhiji’s biographer, Louis Fischer wrote about her, “Being herself and being at the same time a shadow of the Mahatma made her a remarkable woman.”
Read about this amazing woman who walked shoulder to shoulder with one of the most prominent leaders of the world during the most turbulent times of this peninsula.

books.title: The Sparrow and The Fruit
books.summary: When her plump juicy guava falls into a clump of thorns, Gubbi uses every trick she knows, and gets the fruit back. But is it right to use mean tricks to get what you want? Find out by reading this book!

books.title: The Amazing Adventure
books.summary: Tito and Rika fight over a mobile phone when, by accidentally pressing a button, they summon a UFO. An alien appears at the door and asks them to come aboard. Accompanied by a puppy and firefly, they go on a grand adventure in the spaceship. But next morning they wonder… Was it all a dream?

books.title: Socks
books.summary: Anu loves socks and uses her imagination to find many uses for them.  Anu's mother asks if she can use some of Anu's old socks to make a mop. Do you think Anu will be able to part with her cherished socks?

books.title: Nima's First Day of School
books.summary: It's her first day of school. Nima gets new shoes, a new bag, and a new pen, but she still does not feel happy. What could help Nima feel happy again?

books.title: Kallu's World 1 - In Big Trouble Again!
categories: Kallu's World 1 - In Big Trouble Again!
books.summary: Kallu is late for school again. Where did he make his goat run away this time? Or who was sick? He needs to find a story badly... a convincing one. Welcome to Khajuria - a village where young Kallu and his gang run delightful adventurous riots almost everyday. Sometimes they question village traditions, defy bullies or just go about their daily business, but Kallu and his gang are up for anything. Join them as they grow wiser and wittier, as they happily roam the village finding new things to do, and see what they come up with!

books.title: Weather Book
books.summary: Explore different types of weather and we feel about the weather.

books.title: The Monkey and The Drum
books.summary: A drum was hanging on a tree. A monkey pulled it down. What will happen next? Read more to find out.

books.title: Guess The Sound
books.summary: While they are all called birds, they all have different features and produce unique sounds!

books.title: The Lion's Feast
books.summary: The lion organized a feast and invited all the animals. But he forgot to invite the elephant! What happens next? Read more to find out.

books.title: Rat-Cat
books.summary: A fat cat saw a small rat and ran after it. How will the rat save its life?

books.title: Urmila's Umbrella
books.summary: Urmila loves to draw. But today something goes wrong…how will she respond? Read more to find out!

books.title: Different Abilities
books.summary: We all have different abilities, but find out what we have in common.

books.title: It's Harvest Time
books.summary:
Harvest time is here and it begins with
Reireidaar’s big day. Will she cut the first sheaf
of the harvest or will her imagination get in
the way?

books.title: The Dream Pillow
books.summary: Pirate, Tree and Bear are making it difficult to sleep. By day they are great friends, but when night comes, everything changes. No one can sleep. The Dream Pillow is a story about how to change bad dreams into good ones.

books.title: Ready? Yes! Play!
books.summary: Anu loves cricket and her dream is to play the game. Find out how Anu bowls everyone over when she plays her first match.

books.title: Out in the Garden
books.summary: A man is out in his garden, digging and sowing, when it starts to rain and strange things happen... like fish falling from the sky!

books.title: The Key's Lock
books.summary: Sandeep found a key but he cannot find its lock. Read more to find out what happens.

books.title: Hide and Seek
books.summary: There is a girl hiding in a tree. She will come down only when a special person calls her. Who? Read more to find out.

books.title: Full of Light
books.summary: When it comes to her Amma, Shakthi can’t seem to do anything right. She feels like a disappointment—until she meets a girl who reminds her that all of us have the ability to shine bright.

books.title: Spot!
books.summary: Sharpen your eyes and get ready for a spotting spree!

books.title: Our Constitution, Our People
books.summary: The Constitution of India is a dream, a vision, a set of promises. Step into the pages of Indian history to understand what this important document means for our present and our future, and what it means to be a citizen of this country.

books.title: The Big, Big Matchbox
books.summary: Prem and his friends had a big task with a tiny matchbox. You could also try this big task at home. Hours of fun guaranteed!

books.title: Megan and the Princess of Death
categories: Megan and the Princess of Death
books.summary: After following Frits down a cable car line, Megan finds herself trapped in another strange world, The Hopah Place, with an annoying princess. Megan and Frits must journey through a series of scary-creepy caves to find their way back home, but first she must solve three riddles.

books.title: The Man Who Thought He Was Smarter Than His Wife: A Folktale From Norway
categories: The Man Who Thought He Was Smarter Than His Wife: A Folktale From Norway
books.summary: Long long ago, there lived in Norway a grumpy, grouchy farmer called Gloomy Gus. Gloomy Gus was not just a grouch---he was arrogant too, and believed he was smarter than everybody else, especially his wife. Read this captivating and humourous folktale from Norway to find out just how smart he really was!

books.title: Sister, Sister, Why is the Sky So Blue?
categories: Sister Sister Why is the Sky So Blue?
books.summary: Little Brother's inquisitive mind is always full of questions for Big Sister. He knows Big Sister has all the answers, because she is always reading one big fat book or another. In this book, Little Brother wonders why the sky is blue. When Big Sister asks him why he things it could be so, his imagination runs riot. Could it be a giant blue sari spread out to dry in the sky that makes it blue, or is it something else altogether? Of course, Big Sister has the right answer in the end, but before you start reading this fun book to find out, tell us: why do YOU think the sky is blue?

books.title: A Very Busy Day
books.summary: Today is a very busy day. Come to town with Mama and me!

books.title: Shobhini and Nani
books.summary: Little Shobhini loves trying out new things. She goes to the mela, the jungle and to bathe in the river with her adventurous Nani. They even fly off to the moon once…wonder what happened then. A lovely story about Shobhini and Nani's little adventures.

books.title: Whose Voice is This?
books.summary: What's the voice, and who's it?

books.title: My Yellow Umbrella
books.summary: An umbrella can brighten up a grey and rainy day. But it can also be so many things. Take a walk to find out.

books.title: Happy Maths : Numbers
books.summary: This is a mathematics book with a difference. There are more stories here than problems! So read the stories, absorb the mix of facts and fiction and enjoy teasing your brain.

books.title: Daddy's Hobby
books.summary: Every morning, Daddy puts on his helmet, laces up his sneakers, hops onto his bicycle! But is Daddy’s hobby riding his bicycle or…?

books.title: Jungle Book
books.summary: What happened to make the hippo come out from the jungle onto the road?

books.title: Sniffles, the Crocodile and Punch, the Butterfly
categories: Sniffles the Crocodile and Punch the Butterfly
books.summary: What are friends for, if not to help each other? Even friends like Sniffles, the Crocodile and Punch, the Butterfly. A lovely story about two clever friends.

books.title: Rustle Bustle
books.summary: Oh! Oh! What was that? What moved there? A fun poem on the stubborn little cockroaches!

books.title: Pishi Caught in a Storm
books.summary: Pishi was a huge manta ray fish. Once, when he was caught in a big storm in the Indian Ocean, guess who came to his rescue? Dive into this book for a dramatic story.

books.title: Mission of the Fish
books.summary: A school of fish has a mission: to get rid of garbage in their home. Together they work to convince humans to keep the water clean. Do you think humans will listen to the fish?

books.title: The Baby Elephant Learns To Drink Water
categories: Baby hathi ne paani peena seekha
BABY ELEPHANT LEARNT TO DRINK WATER
books.summary: The baby elephant is trying to drink water...but whatever he tries, it does not work. Until...read more to find out!

books.title: The Generous Crow
books.summary: The crow is not beautiful. He can neither sing as sweetly as a cuckoo nor dance as gracefully as a peacock. But he has one unique quality that we can all learn from. Read the book to find out what it is!

books.title: The Storybook Princess
books.summary: Chamnan likes to listen to stories. But he asks a lot of questions, some of which are difficult for his father to answer. One night he dreams of a character from a storybook — a princess under the spell of a witch. Chamnan asks the princess many questions and breaks the spell. In the morning, he is excited to tell his father the tale of the storybook princess.

books.title: Going to Buy a Book
books.summary: Children always like to share their experience with others. 'Going to Buy a Book' shows how enjoyable these experiences can be. Tag along with these siblings as they pick books in a bookstore.

books.title: The Secret World of Mehlli Gobhai: The Man Who Found Art Everywhere
categories: The Secret World of Mehlli Gobhai: The Man Who Found Art Everywhere
books.summary: The murky waters of a winding stream, stark trees stripped of leaves, a crow messing up a canvas—Mehlli Gobhai saw art in all of this. Follow the journey of this inspiring painter and see how art is all around and can help you see the world anew.

books.title: Aarna and Iris' Big Task
books.summary: Aarna and Iris have a new task! There’s a new student in class, and they have to help him settle in. So they set about introducing Norgay to their school in a novel way — by using their senses.

books.title: My Appa and his Sounds
books.summary: I love the sounds that my Appa makes. I have my favourite—which one is yours?

books.title: Here Comes the Camel and Other Poems
categories: Here comes the camel and other poems
books.summary: Prayag Shukla's poems in Hindi have enchanted young and old alike. This collection of poems translated into English brings the joy of his writing to a new set of readers. Siraj Saxena's innovative artwork adds to the appeal of this classic collection.

books.title: We All Need to Save Water
categories: We All Need to Save Water
books.summary: Baby bear Golu is taken to Rani Ki Vav, a famous stepwell in Gujarat, for a family trip. What does Golu learn from there?

books.title: Miss Laya Starts Her Fantastic Motorbike
categories: Miss Laya starts her Fantastic Motorbike
books.summary:
Miss Laya the Games Teacher loves helping people! Join her and her fantastic
motorbike as they vroom off and have different adventures. This is the first in a series of
stories called Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike.

books.title: Who Just Went By?
books.summary: Whose footprints are these? Who left behind this trail? A book that introduces young readers to animals and their tracks.

books.title: A Cotton Candy Cloud
books.summary: A pink cloud of cotton candy adds a bit of hope and cheer to the streets of Mumbai.

books.title: Table
books.summary: There is a table in the house. Why is it special? Read more to find out.

books.title: The Elephants Who Liked to Dance
categories: The Elephants Who Liked to Dance
books.summary: When Bapi played the dhol, everyone felt like dancing. When the elephants heard the dhol a strange and wonderful thing happened...

books.title: Face
books.summary: Learn the parts of the face, with the help of a whimsically illustrated group of friends.

books.title: When I Grow Up, I'll Have a House
categories: When I Grow Up I'll Have a House
books.summary: A verse book about all the wondrous things that make a house a home.

books.title: Where Did My Call Go?
books.summary: When we make phone calls, our voice is able to travel to places that are far away. Have you ever wondered how cell phones can make a voice travel over long distances?

books.title: The Science Complex
books.summary: Class IV is visiting the science complex today. Join them on their journey through the different science labs. Remember to keep an eye out for the six naughty children!

books.title: Puppy's Birthday Party
books.summary: Xongyee wants to thow a surprise birthday party for her puppy. But when the puppy sneaks away to invite her animal friends, Xongyee is the one who will be surprised.

books.title: My Teacher
books.summary: How much do you love your teacher?

books.title: B. R. Ambedkar: A life in books
categories: B. R. Ambedkar: A life in books
books.summary: This is the story of B. R. Ambedkar, also known as the Father of India’s Constitution. Babasaheb, as he was fondly called, was not only a visionary, an economist and a revolutionary, he was also a lifelong reader. This is the story of his love for learning and how it fuelled his journey.

books.title: The Ocean Dream
books.summary: Coral loves exploring the river. One day, she saves a rainbow fish from the river grass, and together they begin an underwater adventure.

books.title: The Lonely Frog
books.publisher: Readership for Learning and Development -- Soma
books.summary: A frog amongst other frogs was very lonely. No one spoke to her as she was a little different. Will she be able to rescue her fellow frogs at their time of need?

books.title: This is Where We Live
books.summary: An ordinary day unfolds through the eyes of Jugnu and Noorie, two felines in Shantiniketan—early morning rays slant in through the windows, fish and fruit sellers do their rounds, and children leave for school. However, as the hours slip by, and kal baisakhi, the spring storm, sweeps in all of a sudden, can the day be anything but extraordinary? Stop and stare at Jugnu and Noorie’s everyday world, discover the tiny details and peel each layer in this wordless and slow picture book.

books.title: Goloo the Circle
books.summary: Goloo opens your eyes to the circular world around you! Children can play a game too - how many circles can you see? You need no pens, paper or dice - all you have to do is take turns and keep score.

books.title: Earth, Our Home
books.summary: The story of Earth is the story of life. It is also a story of loss, one worsened by climate change. But while the climate crisis can be a story of devastation, the work being done to mitigate it, to adapt to it, brings hope. And reminds us, our future is in our hands. The verses in this book tell these stories, in the voices of the orangutan, the Hasdeo Arand forest, the Gangetic dolphin and the Pondicherry shark.

books.title: A Shade of GREEN
books.summary: The air in the city is grey and polluted. Nayantara and Aliza feel suffocated. They dream of leaves that work day and night to produce oxygen and clean energy. Can they invent a leaf that does all that?

books.title: How Heavy is Air?
books.summary: Balloons are colourful and light. Does the air inside them weigh anything at all, you might have wondered. Lakshmi has. So she and her classmates find out if air has any weight at all. Peek inside the covers to see what they learnt.

books.title: Birds That Sing Their Name
books.summary: How do birds get their names? Sometimes people name them after their colours, size and food they eat. Sometimes, they get their names from the way they call or sing. Come meet some of the birds that sing their names.

books.title: The Guest
books.summary: Tarapodo met zamindar Motilal babu. He was going to his village with his family. Tarapodo with his cooking and serving skill came very close to Motilal babu’s family.  Will Tarapodo stay with the family forever because they love him?

books.title: Father, Son and Donkey
books.summary: A folktale of father, son and donkey!

books.title: Girls Also Want Azadi
books.summary: Now girls also want azadi. Freedom from violence and harassment, the freedom to choose and to exercise their rights. And azadi to be who they want to be.

books.title: The Nose of all Noses
books.summary: Zahra’s Dadima has an unusually large nose. It picks up scents that others cannot even imagine. Zahra wants a super nose too. Find out what happens when Dadima and Zahra take a deep sniff of attar and embark on an adventure to train for a super nose.

books.title: Poon Poon...
books.summary: Smelly or loud - farts find a way to make themselves known. Whether they come as a surprise or as a relief, they do feel good! A terrific poem about farts, a secret that everyone knows.

books.title: Off to See Spiders!
books.summary: Kaveri and Shivi go looking for spiders, along with their friend Shama.

books.title: Megan and the Mystery of the Moving Rock
categories: Megan and the Mystery of the Moving Rock
books.summary: Megan is very busy. She has to solve the mystery of Frits the missing cat. Even if it means chasing a scary rock creature into a strange new world.

books.title: The Dog Who Knew Sadness
books.summary: Sadness follows Feroz like a shadow. But his best friend Noah is always there to chase it away.

books.title: Rimis Red Book
books.summary: Rimi is always on the move! She loves to get into everything. Sometimes she interrupts Jitu when he is reading. Can Rimi and Jitu find a way to enjoy reading together?

books.title: Be Wise with Money
books.summary:
The Rupaiya Paisa Series brings out many useful facts about money that will help children to use money wisely as they grow up in an ever-changing world. Money travels from one person to another, one place to another. Is it stored under a cave in a big bank? What is an ATM? Why do people pay tax? 
 This is Book 4 out of 4 in the Rupiya Paisa series.

books.title: Sailing Home
books.summary: Basava and his sister Sundari live in the port-town of Mamallapuram during the Pallava period. Their father, a sailor, has not returned from his voyage to Kamboja and the children are worried. When they go to the port to find out if anyone there has information about their father's ship, they realise to their dismay that the foreign sailors there don't speak a word of their language! What are they going to do now?

books.title: Khuku and the Catfish
books.summary: Khuku is exploring the sea with a catfish. Suddenly, a crocodile starts to chase them. Do you think the catfish will be able to save Khuku from the crocodile?

books.title: Feathered Friends
books.summary:
The oakum boys go for a walk and
discover strange new things:
lots of different penguins, one special
friend, and a very big change.
Growing up can be the biggest
adventure of all!

books.title: I Don't Want To Sleep!
books.summary: It is midnight and all the animals are fast asleep. But there is someone who is awake...read more to find out who!

books.title: Earth Calling Aru
books.summary: Aru wants to fly, but gravity is keeping her firmly rooted to the ground. What if there was no gravity on Earth for a few minutes? Aru is about to find out.

books.title: The Smart Frog
books.summary: A lonely frog sneaks into the bedroom of a lazy boy. Soon, he finds letters and numbers and learns how to read and do math. What will he do with his new talents?

books.title: Let's Fly
contributors: San srei nou ch nou ch
books.summary: Who can fly and who cannot?

books.title: The Punctuation Marks' Journey
books.summary: The comma, the full stop, the exclamation point and the question mark all live together in a book. Is there enough room for all of them?

books.title: Palm Tree
books.summary: Did you know how important a palm tree is? Read to find out!

books.title: Grace: One engineer's fight to make science education accessible for all
categories: Grace: One engineer's fight to make science education accessible for all
books.summary: Grace had many questions. Why did she have to sit outside her classroom? Why did she have to wear pants instead of a dress? Why could transgender persons not study engineering? She wondered why science and technology education was not accepting of differences in people. And she decided to find answers in the courtroom. This is the story of Grace Banu, who is working towards making science and technology education more accessible for all.

books.title: Ira Investigates the Invisible
books.summary: What do microbiologists do at work all day? Meet Dr Ira and the invisible creatures that she studies.

books.title: Bunty and Mother's Kite
books.summary: Bunty's father bought a kite for him, but the kite got wet. What happens next? Read more to find out.

books.title: Upside-down World
books.summary: The sun decides to stay up long after bedtime, and the world is turned upside-down.

books.title: My Special Hair
books.summary: A story about my special hair. How special it can be. So many types of special hair. Just look around, you’ll see.

books.title: Fox and Rooster
books.summary: Rooster deceives all the other animals, until Fox discovers his secret.

books.title: My Juggling Granny
books.summary: Meet a bright and playful grandmother. She loves to juggle!

books.title: Vuyo
books.summary: In this wordless book we experience a day in the life of happy Baby Vuyo.

books.title: Should I eat it!! Or take It?
categories: SHOULD I EAT!! OR TAKE IT?
books.summary: A rat found a chapati and wanted to take it home. Will the rat be able to take it home? Read more to find out.

books.title: Badshahi Park
books.summary: It was forbidden to go there, and to go at night to hammer a nail at the head of the grave? Ashhar was either a fool, or he was trying to be oh-so-brave. Why else would he accept Zulfi’s challenge? Would Ashhar enter the haunted tomb on a full moon night?

books.title: Flippy the Flowerpecker
books.summary: Flippy the tiny flowerpecker visits a eucalyptus tree to find a meal but a surprise is in store for her!

books.title: The Fox and the Lump of Clay
categories: The Fox and the Lump of Clay
Kale enga Dekeli / Bilua O Mati Dhela
Fox and the Lump of clay
books.summary: A fox was friends with a lump of clay. The lump fell into the water and the fox was very sad. What happened next makes the Kui tribe sing and dance!

books.title: Chomp, Gulp... Burp!
books.summary: Whales swallow their food whole, bees have two stomachs, and cows store food for later. A book about the novel ways in which animals ingest and digest their food.

books.title: Under the Microscope
books.summary: Did you know that there are tiny creatures all around us? Look under a microscope to see them for yourself!

books.title: Fati and the Honey Tree
books.summary:
Every day is a new beginning for Fati, a little girl who tries very hard to do as she is told. In this story, Fati finds that climbing trees can lead to trouble.

Fati and the Honey Tree is based on the real-life adventures of a girl growing up in northern Ghana.

books.title: Ginni
books.summary: Ashu is a quiet and shy child who wants to blend in with everyone else. On a perfect rainy holiday, his teacher spots him playing with dolls. Read this remarkable story to find out what happens next.

books.title: Chunu & Munu: Our School
books.summary: Two twin girls sing a poem to each other about how wonderful and exciting their school is.

books.title: Grandma's Bananas
