books.summary: Where does grandma store all the bananas?

books.title: Joy
books.summary: We can find joy in simple things. Read this story and you will know how.

books.title: Building a Building
books.summary: Meenu and Elango are getting a new school! What goes into building one? Let's find out!

books.title: Neema's Birthday
books.summary: Neema loves her birthday, but it takes too long to come. She thinks her parents are playing a trick on her and decides to find out. What does she discover?

books.title: This...These
books.summary: What's this? What are they doing?

books.title: Butterfly and Hornbill
books.summary: Who is small? Who is big? Who is the smallest? Who is the biggest?

books.title: Inku Chomps, Gobbles and Slurps
books.summary: Flying food, crawling food, hopping food – no food is too crazy for Inku! Join Inku on her food adventures as she meets other creatures of the forest.

books.title: The Lion Who Wouldn't Try
books.summary: All the animals in the jungle are playing, except Lion. Why won’t Lion join in?

books.title: The Clay's Adventure
books.summary: The little lumps of clay in the field are bored with where they live. They want to explore the world. Their friend, Miss Wind, advises them to transform into fine pieces of pottery so they can travel to different lands.  What will happen to them?

books.title: The Green Apple
books.summary: Green Apple is the only green fruit at the market. She wants to be red like all the others. Join her adventure to change her colour.

books.title: Gagan Visits Kamal
books.summary: Join Kamal on a journey home through the city. Along the way, he discovers sounds and sights of the city, which are expressed using simple words in this story for early readers.

books.title: Why is There a Hole in the Wall?
books.summary: “Why is there a hole in the wall?” Lungisa asks. He gets lots of interesting answers… but he keeps on asking.

books.title: Bathtub Safari
books.summary: Jack's bath time takes a wild turn as things in his bathtub start to change, and a group of animals becomes part of his adventurous bathtub safari!

books.title: What House Shall I Build Today?
categories: What House Shall I Build Today
books.summary: Did you know there are sandstone havelis in Jaisalmer, and houses with roofs made of wild grass in Nagaland? Cities have skyscrapers and there are houses powered by solar energy. Join Sulu and build the house you would like to live in.

books.title: Who takes the train?
books.summary: Naledi is taking the train for the first time and wonders what kind of people she will see. The train is full of surprises!

books.title: Whose House is This?
books.summary: This book for early readers tells the story of a curious child who shares his house with many animals — from a cow in the shed to a bird on the roof.

books.title: A Girl Called Norah
books.summary: Norah loves her doll and gets worried one day when she is not able to find it.

books.title: Palm Tree
books.summary: Palm tree wants tp leave its corner and fly away. Explore the power of imagination in this poem.

books.title: Why, Oh Why!
books.summary: Here is a book that will make little readers make faces at each other!

books.title: Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike is Hungry!
categories: Miss Laya starts her Fantastic Motorbike is hungry
books.summary:
Miss Laya the Games Teacher loves helping people, with the help of her fantastic motorbike! This
time around they vroom off in search for the perfect snack for her bike. This is the second in a series of
stories called Miss Laya's Fantastic Motorbike.

books.title: Everything is Ups!de Down
books.summary: Akash has a friend called TikTik. TikTik’s world is very different from yours and mine. It’s upside down, you see!

books.title: Baby Babble
books.summary: Baby’s day is full of babble, whether she’s hungry, searching for her dummy, splashing in the bath or curled up in bed at night.

books.title: There's Amma!
books.summary: Amma sends Appa, Ashok and Baby to the market. But why  is Baby seeing Amma everywhere?

books.title: Paper Play
books.summary: Manju finds a piece of paper. And in the hands of her friends, it becomes so much more than just a piece of paper. Illustrated using bits of paper, so that each page is a collage, imagination is at play in this little story.

books.title: Talking in Twos
books.summary: Computers use a special language called Binary. This has only two symbols—0 and 1. But it manages to pass on the most complex messages.

books.title: Pakhi the Pigeon
books.summary: Pakhi turns into a pigeon and flies onto a roof. Is this magic or…read more to find out!

books.title: Clever Rabbit
books.summary: Clever Rabbit lives inside a hutch but he wants to see the world outside. What can he do to get out of the hutch without putting himself in danger?

books.title: The Calf Calls
books.summary: A little calf is hungry and is waiting for her mother, the cow, to feed her. But someone has to come to unleash the cow first! How long will the calf wait for her breakfast?

books.title: Father's Inheritance
books.summary: A folktale about the wisdom of a father, the insight of a son, and the value of farming.

books.title: The Cat Who Ate The Kheer
books.summary: Kheer was made at home but nobody got to eat it. Read more to find out why!

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Mulu?
books.summary: The schools are closed and Mulu from Africa is scared she would be taken out of school and married off like her sister. Find out what happens to Mulu!

books.title: DOT - The story of a happy little book
categories: DOT - The story of a happy little book
books.summary:
Little Minnie loves Dot. She can’t do without it. But one day she grows up. What happens to little Dot? Jump right in to find out.
This happy, heart warming story about loving books is bound to make every child rush to grab their favourite book.

books.title: Art is Everywhere - Here, There and in Trash
categories: Art is Everywhere - Here There and in Trash
books.summary:
Art can happen anywhere, using almost
anything. In this title of the Art is Everywhere
series, the reader joins the artists in looking
through the trash for reusable forms and shapes.
Filled with irreverent rhymes, these books will
give the reader’s imagination wings.

books.title: The Great Tidy Up
books.summary: When Gogo takes a nap, Khwezi and Mzamo decide to tidy up. What could possibly go wrong?

books.title: A Very Busy Year
books.summary:
There’s something special about every month
of the year. Except the month in which I was
born. When is your birthday? Do you like your
birthday month?

books.title: Child's Play
books.summary: The villagers in Sookhapur have a great problem – the only handpump in their village is running dry. Fights break out every day and nobody has a solution. Wait, there is someone who might! But will the villagers listen to a little girl?

books.title: Moutushi's Song
books.summary: Moutushi is a little sunbird who loves brightly-coloured flowers. Didima has lots of them growing in her flower pots. Moutushi drinks nectar from the flowers, and in return gives Didima a beautiful gift. What could this gift be?

books.title: Tractor Gets Help
books.summary: When the tractor is sick, his friends come to help.

books.title: Barefoot Kanu Dadu
books.summary: Chinar loves football. She wants to win the World Cup when she grows up. One day, when she asks Ma for a new pair of shoes, she hears the story of Kanu dadu, who played against the British barefoot—and won.

books.title: The Green Bean festival
books.summary: One day, while playing in the green bean fields at her grandmother’s house, Nam meets a new friend – a green bean seed. He invites her to meet his family and to join their festival. What new discoveries will she make on her adventure?

books.title: Pussy-cat Mew
books.summary: Pussy cat goes to London to visit the palace. She comes across many sights. Find out what they are!

books.title: Kallu's world 4 - Hero Horoscope Man
books.summary:
Welcome to Khajuria – a village where young Kallu and his gang run delightful adventurous riots almost everyday. Sometimes they question village traditions, defy bullies or just go about their daily business, but Kallu and his gang are up for anything. Join them as they grow wiser and wittier, happily roaming the village finding new things to do, and see what they come up with!
A world renowned 'Astrologer – Palmist – Tantra Expert  – Futurologist – Numerologist...etc' is visiting the village. What could he predict other than the future... class test questions perhaps? Or perform a few magic tricks? What happens when Kallu's gang decides to check out the 'horoscope man'? No need to go to an astrologer to find out. Just read on…

books.title: The Three Doof-Doofs
books.summary: Have you ever wondered what goes doof-doof-doof in the night?  This is a noisy bedtime story for a quiet night’s sleep.

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Kate?
categories: Hope Where are you for Kate
books.summary: The schools are closed and Kate from America is bored and wants the attention of her family. They are busy. What does she do next?

books.title: Egg
books.summary: Crocodile, Tortoise, Penguin and Chicken find an egg. Is it their egg? ‘Our egg,’ say the proud Mum and Dad at the end. Discover whose egg it is.

books.title: Ambi's Little Things
books.summary: Join Chimik and her mother on a heartfelt journey of love, laughter, and tears. When they lose someone dear, they find courage and joy in the smallest things. Together they dance, sing, and celebrate life, even as they say goodbye.

books.title: My Ten Friends
books.summary: This is a story about things that come into daily use in our homes, which help us keep clean and healthy.

books.title: Absent-minded Ajja
books.summary: Ajja is getting ready for his evening walk. But he does not always remember everything he needs. Luckily, Sujju is there to help him out. A book that explores the concept of opposites.

books.title: Playground
books.summary: They want to go to playground. How do they get there?

books.title: Have You Ever Heard a Whale Sing?
categories: Have You Ever Heard a Whale Sing?
books.summary: The underwater world is a noisy place. Read all about some of the strongest, largest and loudest singers under the sea — whales!

books.title: Fati and the Green Snake
books.summary:
Every day is a new beginning for Fati, a little girl who tries very hard to do as she is told. In this story, Fati gets a surprise when she is collecting firewood with her father.
Fati and the Green Snake is based on the real-life adventures of a girl growing up in northern Ghana.

books.title: Sabzpari's Jaltarang
books.summary: The village elders believe she sheds green light and plays the jaltarang to bewitch innocent people near the village pond. Kaasni and Faizan decide to investigate if she even exists because they don't believe in jadugarnis  and paris ! This lively play interweaves fantasy and reality with rib-tickling humour to establish the importance of a clean environment. Read it and get inspired to perform it for hours of fun.

books.title: Two Hungry Boys
books.summary: Two hungry boys.  And ten cupcakes. Chomp chomp chomp!

books.title: Get Me The Bucket!
books.summary: Two brothers decide to go fishing. What kind of fish do you think they will catch? What kind of buckets will they need to hold their fish?

books.title: Imagine
books.summary: Pencils for a present? That’s not fun. But maybe it is – all you have to do is imagine.

books.title: Nomvundla and the Chilli-Eating Contest
books.summary: Nomvundla and Soko are off to the Chilli-Eating Contest. Animals come from far and wide to try to win the amazing prize. Who will win and get to take a friend to the Hamba-Hamba Funfair?

books.title: Rajmohana Keloth: The Bug Finder and Her Big World of Tiny Insects
categories: Rajmohana Keloth: The Bug Finder and Her Big World of Tiny Insects
books.summary: When the rest of her class is napping, Mohana is busy watching an army of ants. When she grows up, she becomes an entomologist. Read about Rajmohana Keloth and her world of tiny insects.

books.title: Who Threw the Shoe?
books.summary:
Someone threw the shoe at Crocodile's head!
But who?

books.title: Disagreement Among Occupations
books.summary: What happens when everyone thinks their work is the most important?

books.title: Kadogoo Changed His Life
books.summary:
Kadogoo is not the best student in his class, but he knows that he can do better. What will Kadogoo do to become the student he knows
he can be?

books.title: The Mighty (Little) Hunter
books.summary: A mighty little hunter is off hunting. Oh no, the mighty little hunter’s a little lost. How will the mighty little hunter find its way home now?

books.title: Miss Tiny Chef
books.summary: Miss Tiny Chef is only eight years old. She does things other little girls wouldn’t do. Armed with a talking mingling stick that shares all its great recipes with her, Kasini stirs up a special surprise meal for mummy.

books.title: Cloud Ice-cream
books.summary: Sarla and her kite are great friends. The kite brings Sarla a lovely gift. Cloud Ice-cream! Read this charming story of their friendship.

books.title: Muna and Milan's Game
books.summary: Muna and Milan have returned home after visiting the zoo. They are enjoying pretending to be the animals that they saw there. What animals do you think they visited?

books.title: Samira Goes Shopping
books.summary: Join Samira and Mouchak on their unusual shopping trip!

books.title: Goat, Dog and Cow
books.summary: Find out why the dog runs towards a car and a goat away from it!

books.title: Eye Can See
books.summary: Chanda, Tinku and Motu visit a laboratory and look through different lenses. They see distant stars as well as miniscule stuff up close. Let’s take a look through these lenses.

books.title: Don't Wake the Baby!
books.summary: Ever since their new baby brother came home, Zu and Zi are not allowed to make noise. But how can they be quiet when playing is so much fun?

books.title: Little and Big
books.summary: A simple book on what is little and what is big.

books.title: On the Metro
books.summary: Zeba and her Abbu are off to see the Qutab Minar. They are taking the Metro. Hop on, and ride with them.

books.title: My Home Holds Us All
books.summary: What are homes made of? Sounds and memories, friends and animals, smells and colours. Join Bela as she welcomes you into her home, which is more than just a house.

books.title: Baby Giraffe and the Sun
books.summary: Mother Giraffe works long days in an orange grove, sweating under the hot sun. Baby Giraffe wants to do something to make her more comfortable. So he comes up with a plan. He will get rid of the sun!

books.title: The Boy and the Drum (A Shorter Version)
books.summary: A folktale about giving and kindness transforms into a lively play! This versatile and adaptable piece can be performed on stage or in the classroom. Hours of fun and learning guaranteed!

books.title: Nangila's Courage
books.summary: Will Nangila succeed where big strong men have failed?

books.title: Magical Rainbow River
books.summary: A mother tells her children oh how rainbows came to be in the sky.

books.title: All the Missing Socks
books.summary:
Striped ones, jangly ones, neon ones —
where do all the socks go? This charming
story in verse will finally solve the mystery
of the missing socks.

books.title: Rainbow Visits the Village
books.summary: A boy spots a rainbow for the first time. Do you think he knows what it is?

books.title: Bhabhloo Bear's Adventure
books.summary:
Bhabhloo Bear’s life is full of twists and turns and he moves forward with leaps and bounds… literally! 
Join him on his thrilling nocturnal adventure and find out many secrets about Himalayan bears.

books.title: Colours (Tell me now series)
books.summary: Often an inquisitive child asks his parents about the colours or shapes that he sees around himself. The 'Tell me ... now!' Series describes how interesting the questions and answers turn out.

books.title: How Money Travels
books.summary:
The Rupaiya Paisa Series brings out many useful facts about money that will help children to use money wisely as they grow up in an ever-changing world. Money travels from one person to another, one place to another. Is it stored under a cave in a big bank? What is an ATM? Why do people pay tax? 
This is Book 2 out of 4 in the Rupiya Paisa series.

books.title: Amma, There is a Bat in My Sambar!
categories: there is a bat in my sambar!
books.summary: Suppi is not at all happy to see a bat flying about in his house. In fact, he is quite scared of the bat. How can Suppi and Amma get the bat back to her family?

books.title: Hello
books.summary: Lolo has many lovely friends. They are Sun and Moon and Star and Bird too. She would love to introduce them to you.

books.title: The Poor Lady
books.publisher: Readership for Learning and Development -- Soma
books.summary: The protagonist wants to fly but cannot afford an aeroplane. She finds a stick on her way home. How will the stick help fulfill her dreams?

books.title: Hauz Khas: A School by the Lake
categories: Hauz Khas: a School by the Lake
books.summary: Would you like to walk a secret trail? This book takes you down one in Hauz Khas in Delhi— through a garden, an old school, a mosque and some tombs.

books.title: Anuradha Dances the Bihu
books.summary: Bihu's just around the corner, and Anuradha cannot wait. But, there's one small problem — it just won't stop raining. Will Anuradha be able to go out and dance the Bihu with her friends?

books.title: Bombay Ducks, Bombay Docks
books.summary: It’s raining and there’s not much one can do outdoors. Come and listen to Aaji’s story about the Kolis, the original inhabitants of Bombay, their favourite fish Bombay Duck and the city’s magnificent docks.

books.title: Happy Maths : Time and Money
books.summary: This is a mathematics book with a difference. There are more stories here than problems! So read the stories, absorb the mix of facts and fiction and enjoy teasing your brain.

books.title: The Biscuit Jar Must Fall
books.summary: Prudence promises Micki and her friends that when they finish cleaning Micki’s room they can have biscuits. But when they are finished, Prudence is nowhere to be found. So Micki and her friends spend the rest of their day finding ways to reach the biscuit jar.

books.title: The coffee legend
books.summary: Tells about the origin of coffee in Ethiopia.

books.title: Toothless Charu
books.summary: This is the story of a little girl named Charu who is scared of pulling her loose tooth out. Read the story to find out how Charu becomes toothless.

books.title: A Dress for Porcupine
books.summary: Kooru the porcupine asks her friend Gethum the spider to make a beautiful new year's dress for her. Gethum tries, but how can she dress an animal with such sharp spikes?

books.title: I See the Sea
books.summary: When Chiku spills paint, Sonu doesn’t see a mess. Instead they find a whale, jellyfish and the whole ocean. Their imaginations soar as they dive in and splatter paint, juice and mud to create a whole new world out of mistakes.

books.title: Tara and the Magic Glass
books.summary: Tara’s best friend is amazing because it shows her the world in a new way. Join them on their larger-than-life adventures.

books.title: I Need to Hide!
books.summary: Piggy-bank is terrified of being broken! His friend, Na, loves him and takes excellent care of him. But one day, Mom suggests that Na break the piggy-bank to buy her New Year’s clothes. What will Na do?

books.title: Good Morning, Good Night
books.summary: Madhav and Yaretzi live on opposite sides of Earth. When it is night-time for Madhav, it is morning for Yaretzi. Why can’t they ever see the stars at the same time? Read this story about time difference to find out.

books.title: Hungry Pod & Healthy Pod in The Big Cake Contest
categories: Hungry Pod & Healthy Pod in The Big Cake Contest
books.summary: Join Hungry Pod and Healthy Pod in the funny story of the Podville Cake Contest. Hungry Pod loves desserts and decides to make a delicious cake to enter into the contest. But uh Oh! Something has gone wrong. Read on to find out more.

books.title: Aaji's Terrace
books.summary: Every holiday we go to our Aaji’s house. Why? Our house in Mumbai has neither a terrace nor our Aaji.

books.title: Chaku's Cycle
books.summary: Chaku really wants a tricycle. How will Chaku find a tricycle as nice as Lila's?

books.title: Gorilla Has a Party
books.summary: Gorilla gets ready for a party. What does a party need? Lots and lots of hats! Place party hats all over the house with Gorilla. A vibrant book about spatial direction and party hats.

books.title: Shambhu and Me
books.summary: Raavi loves Shambhu, the calf. Come, let's see what Raavi and Shambhu do in the cowshed.

books.title: My Balwadi
books.summary: Children always like to share their experience with others. My Balwadi shows how enjoyable the experiences can be.

books.title: Dhyan Singh 'Chand': Hockey's Magician
books.summary: The man who came to be called the Wizard of Hockey, Dhyan Chand, started playing hockey with a branch of a palm tree. What did he like to eat as a child? How did he prove Hitler wrong? Here is the story of a man who might just inspire you to pick up a hockey stick and play.

books.title: Moon Pizza
books.summary: No, Tinu doesn’t want broccoli and peas in his tiffin box. He wants pizza—even a moon pizza will do!

books.title: Water, Water Everywhere, Not a Drop to Drink
books.summary: Gopal suspects the credibility of the line 'Water, Water Everywhere, Not a Drop to Drink'. This story takes both Gopal and the readers on a journey of discovering harsh truths!

books.title: Frog's Starry Wish
books.summary: Frog loves to gaze at the stars. One night he decides he wants to touch them. He climbs a rock, a tall coconut tree, even a hillock! But the stars are always out of reach. Will Frog ever find a way to be near the stars?

books.title: Woof-woof!
books.summary: Doggy wants to play, but Baby is scared.

books.title: Pig Leads the Way!
books.summary: All the animals are hungry and the farmer hasn’t come yet to feed them. They decide to feed themselves. And that’s when things get wild!

books.title: Moo Moo Brown Cow, Have You Any Milk?
categories: Moo Moo Brown Cow Have You Any Milk?
books.summary:
Does milk come out of a packet or out of a cow? When city boy Raju visits his Ajji’s farm in the village,
he watches Ajji milking her cows. Raju loves the sight of the fresh milk frothing in the bucket,
but there is something he enjoys even more. What do you think it is?

books.title: Super Mummy and Super Super!
books.summary: An adorable tale of a super family!

books.title: What is it?
books.summary: What is it? It isn’t like me. Do you think it’s dangerous?

books.title: The Worst Best Friends
books.summary: Lila and her cat are up to no good. They are the best at being the worst together, after all. A story about a girl and her cat, and the mischief they get up to.

books.title: Zanele Sees Numbers
books.summary: There are numbers everywhere, but Zanele can’t see them.

books.title: Senzo and the Sun
books.summary: The morning sun creeps over the horizon and peeps through the leaves, waking Senzo. Gogo’s rooster shakes his wings, stretches his neck and crows. Koek-a-loek-a-loo! Join Senzo and the sun as they journey through the day.

books.title: Crackers in a Pot
books.summary: It is Ramapada’s birthday, Dashu’s greatest rival in school. Ramapada walks in with a pot filled with delicious sweets and shares them with everyone but Dashu. Dashu isn’t known to be crazy for no reason! What prank does Dashu come up with in return this time?

books.title: The King's Crown
books.summary: When King Anawrahta looked up to admire the tall pagoda, his crown fell down. Read this story set in present-day Myanmar to see if the crown stayed on his head.

books.title: The Snake
books.summary: Do you know about all the things a snake does? Read more to find out!

books.title: Where Is the Moon?
books.summary: Where does the moon go during the day? Come, let’s find out.

books.title: Sharing
books.summary: Rani and Bala are so hungry! But they don't like the food they get. What do they do?

books.title: An Amazing World
books.summary: Turbans are synonymous with cultural tradition of India. The story is an informational narrative about different kinds of turbans which are commonly worn in India. The turbans have been personified to introduce themselves one by one in an interesting poetic form. Vibrant, striking and colorful illustrations add life to the story.

books.title: Curious Baby Elephant
books.summary: Did you know that an elephant's trunk was really short? But then how did it become so long?

books.title: Rumniya
books.summary: Rumniya and Nani are a cheerful pair because they know most things turn out right in the end. Read this sweet story about resourceful Rumniya!

books.title: Champi and the Fig Tree
books.summary:
Champi loves fruits. Her favourite is juicy figs.
But she’s not the only one who loves them.
Who are the others?

books.title: The Runaway Pig
books.summary: Lalita, the pet pig of Mini Singh, clicks her heels and runs away! And lands right into an adventure where she meets unfriendly donkeys, big buffaloes, and snarly dogs. But nothing can stop her from having fun. After all, isn’t that what adventures are all about?

books.title: The Postmaster
books.summary: The postmaster and Ratan, hailing from different worlds, build their cosy home on compassion and empathy. However, the postmaster has applied to leave the village. Read this poignant story by Tagore that explores a relationship without a name and leaves your heart aching for Ratan.

books.title: Who Will Win?
books.summary: A family of shapes is excited about the lantern competition. But they realize that if they want to win the competition, they will have to work together.

books.title: You! Yes You!
books.summary: Hi! I’m fighting a monster, and I need you to help me. Yes, you!

books.title: What's in the Pot?
books.summary: Sam can’t wait for supper. What’s in the pot? Wait and see.

books.title: The Fish that Couldn't Swim
books.summary: Have you ever heard of a fish that can’t swim?

books.title: Honest Girl
books.summary: Can an honest girl be tempted to steal?

books.title: The Village of Five Poles
books.summary: After the Electricity Department installs five electricity poles in their village, the villagers are excited. But when the Electricity Department doesn't return to finish the work, the village is left with five empty poles. What will they do?

books.title: Kites
books.summary: A group of colourful kites fly high into the sky!

books.title: Lucky Time
books.summary: Two mice are determined to taste some jaggery kept on a stand. They try their best to snatch a piece of the sugary treat. Do you think the mice will ever get to taste the jaggery?

books.title: Happy Maths : Measurements
books.summary:
This is a mathematics book with a difference. There are more stories here than problems! So read the stories, absorb the mix of facts and
fiction and enjoy teasing your brain.

books.title: An Unexpected Adventure
books.summary: A boring afternoon turns into an exciting adventure when a little boy opens a book.

books.title: Phani's Funny Chappals
books.summary: Read this funny story about Phani's funny chappals!

books.title: It's Not Fair
books.summary: Aisha and Maria are best friends. Until, one day, their classteacher praises Maria for her singing. Then Maria gets the part of a butterfly in a play, and Aisha does not. Aisha’s heart hurts so much that she thinks it could burst. A story about envy and the confusion that comes along with it.

books.title: Story Chikkappa
books.summary: Whether children or adults, everyone loves a good story. If we think about our life, we can think of it as a story too. Now, can you imagine a ‘land without stories?’ How would life be different if there were no stories? What would you miss the most? Story Chikkappa is a heartwarming tale with whimsical situations and memorable characters that take you through the journey of how the land without stories transformed into a land filled with story treasures.

books.title: Fati and the Soup Pot
books.summary:
Fati has always been a fast runner, and proves this once again at her school's Sports Day. When she returns home from school, she helps her mother prepare okro soup. The soup smells delicious and Fati is tempted!
Fati and the Soup Pot is based on the real-life adventures of a girl growing up in northern Ghana.

books.title: Rhyming Grandpa
books.summary: Grandpa makes a rhyme about everything he sees and everywhere he goes. He makes everyone laugh: baby elephants, pet owls, and children all over the world. He never stays in one place and is always on a go. Read what he sings about in this book full of rhymes and laughter.

books.title: Exam Fever
books.summary: Exams are round the corner. And Ma is down with a fever. Everyone is fussing over her, trying to make her feel better. Will her fever go away before the exams?

books.title: The Happy Plant
books.summary: I have a little plant. It dances in the wind and smiles in the sunshine. It is happy, just like me!

books.title: Zeba's First Letter
books.summary: Zeba is going to write her first letter. To whom is she writing her first letter? Read the story to find out.

books.title: The Evil Forest
books.summary: Three sisters go to the forest in search of firewood, but only two of them return home. What happens to the third sister.

books.title: Decision
books.summary: A village takes a decision together to change their lives for the better.

books.title: And Also!
books.summary: Thabo’s make-believe world has no room for his little sister, Keitu. But she has other ideas!

books.title: Chunu & Munu: Draw
books.summary: Chunu and Munu explore the world of art by drawing, painting and mixing all sorts of colours!

books.title: What the Dark Sounds Like
books.summary: What do feelings feel like? What does love smell like? What is magic? Step into the overlooked world of the everyday. Look closer, listen deeper, and celebrate the wonder in everything.

books.title: A Very Important Tree
books.summary: Busi loves the big, beautiful tree outside her house. But her brother wants to cut it down. How will she stop him?

books.title: A Royal Procession
books.summary:
Parvati and her brother Laxman live in Pataliputra in the time of Emperor Ashoka, but have never set eyes on their king. One day, they meet a man who works in the palace, and wish they could see the king as often as he does. The children don’t know it, but their wish is going to come true sooner 
than they think. And when it does, what a royal surprise they are going to have!

books.title: There's an alien in my house!
categories: There’s An Alien In My House
books.summary: What do you do when there’s an alien in your house? Fight a foe or find a friend?

books.title: Once upon a Coin
books.summary: Banko discovers the beauty of coins when he sees his grandmother’s collection. Join Banko to find out the images that can be spotted on Indian coins.

books.title: Sister, Sister, Where Does Thunder Come From?
categories: Sister Sister Where Does Thunder Come From?
books.summary: Little Brother's inquisitive mind is always full of questions for Big Sister. He knows Big Sister has all the answers, because she is always reading one big fat book or another. In this book, Little Brother wonders where thunder comes from. Is it the roaring of the angry giant who lives in the sky that causes the heavens to rumble, or is it just the wild biker gang up in the clouds that makes all that noise? Of course, Big Sister has the right answer in the end, but before you start reading this fun book to find out, tell us: where do YOU think thunder comes from?

books.title: So Much Work!
books.summary: Chotu says that he has to do all the chores at home. Does he really do all the work, or does he just make a mess?

books.title: Gyalmo, the Queen of the Mountains
categories: Gyalmo the Queen of the Mountains
books.summary: Koyna is in Spiti Valley trying to spot a snow leopard with her friend Lobzang. Gyalmo, the snow leopard, watches from a distance as they try their best to spot her.

books.title: Line
books.summary: Lines are around us everywhere. In our homes, and in nature. On land and in the skies and in the water too.

books.title: Ms Phone
books.summary: Ms Phone is quite a character! Can you imagine having five phones, for communicating with different people?

books.title: I Love My Planet
books.summary: Loving the planet also means taking care of it. Read to find out how these children do their bit to take care of the planet they love.

books.title: A Walk Among Trees
books.summary: Trees have been growing on our planet well before human beings appeared on it. Without their comforting shade and tasty fruit, our earth would be quite a barren place. Take a walk among trees in the King's orchard to savour the taste, the smell and the legends associated with bountiful fruit trees in India. You will feel refreshed by all that you learn!

books.title: Queen of Soweto
books.summary: Basetsana Kumalo is a beauty queen, but she’s also so much more. She teaches us that true beauty is about having a heart filled with love and generosity. Her story shows us that if you have courage and determination, you can achieve your dreams – whatever they may be.

books.title: Turtle Dove
books.summary: Learn what Turtle Dove can and cannot do!

books.title: Grandpa Farouk's Garden
books.summary: Amir loves Grandpa Farouk’s garden. But it’s dying. What can Amir do to help?

books.title: Jealous Anansi
books.summary: Where does Anansi's jealousy lead him?

books.title: I Don't Want to go to Sleep!
books.summary: Nandi doesn’t want to go to sleep. No way! She wants to go on an adventure. Join Nandi as she lets her imagination run wild and free.

books.title: Circles
books.summary: Mother Vulture takes Little Vulture on his first flight. On their journey, they see a dying gemsbok. She shows her son that the end of one animal’s life is also the beginning of a new cycle for other creatures.

books.title: The Dordles Find Fuel (Book 1)
books.summary: Three creatures go in search of fuel in order to get home, but it’s easier said than done. The first in a series of three books about the adventures of The Dordles, who find themselves stuck in a world where resources are scarce.

books.title: The Tortoise and The Rabbit
books.summary: The rabbit and the tortoise decide to race. On the way, the rabbit fell asleep and the tortoise ran ahead. But then the tortoise saw a lion. What will happen now? Read more to find out.

books.title: Raju and Muniya
books.summary: What are Raju and Muniya up to today? Read more to find out!

books.title: The Winter Night
books.summary: Halku and his wife, Munni are rural farmers who find themselves crushed under the weight of poverty. Having lost their hard-earned money to repay a debt, they have also lost all the means to buy a blanket for the coming winter month. Halku is faced with the circumstance of sleeping out in his field with nothing to protect him from the harsh, biting cold. Having no choice and desperate for warmth, Halku and his dog set out on a cold winter night to guard the fields.

books.title: Anansi gives people stories
books.summary: Long ago, the sky kept all stories locked up in a wooden box. People asked clever Anansi to ask the sky god for the stories. The sky god agreed, but only if Anansi performed three seemingly impossible tasks.

books.title: The Fountain
books.summary: The street outside Ramesh’s house is all dug up. Ramesh finds a water pipe peeping out of the mud. And then…such fun!

books.title: The Porcupine and Elephant
books.summary: On a warm day, an elephant and a porcupine are locked in a silly showdown, each claiming to be the strongest and the mightiest. As they quarrel, an unsuspecting third party can’t help but chuckle at their antics. How will this squabble end?

books.title: When the Sun Sets
books.summary: The Sun has set. But what does she do after a long day? Let’s find out, because the Sun has invited us to her home.

books.title: Curly and Straight
books.summary: Do you like curly tails or straight tails? There are some things we like whether straight or curly!

books.title: Kuwomba the Anxious Cloud
books.summary: Kuwomba gets an order for a thousand sweets. She should be happy, but instead she cannot stop worrying. Will Kuwomba be able to make the sweets in time for the party?

books.title: Bravo Burli!
books.summary: The wise people of the Kondh tribe live close to the forest. They know each zigzag path, each large sal and mohua tree, each pug mark of the mongoose and the tiger, and so much more! Young Burli is beginning to read the signs of nature, but is she ready to face the most dangerous ordeal of her life?

books.title: Nichchumani Helps Out
books.summary: Nichchumani wants to help Pichhu, a lost and injured duckling. She takes her home, but she only finds more trouble there!

books.title: Going to a Wedding
books.summary: Children always like to share their experience with others. Going to a wedding shows how enjoyable the experiences can be.

books.title: Fruits of Freedom
books.summary: A grandmother tells her grandchildren stories that they can takeaway from!

books.title: Bon and Butter
books.summary: It’s summer break, and Bon is bored. Nobody will play with him! Bon decides to throw a party. But whose party is it?

books.title: Maria's Family
books.summary: Get introduced to Maria's Family!

books.title: When a Forest Wakes Up
books.summary: As a roaring sun jumps out, the forest wakes up to a brand new day, putting on a new show. What will the forest be today? A story inspired from animism, an age-old belief of the Gond tribe, where everything from the sun to the rocks are as living as we are.

books.title: The Freedom Sisters
books.summary:
Payoshni wants to do something big, spectacular, amazing and fabulous for the Independence Day celebrations in Godavari Colony. But there’s not enough time and Bandmaster Totoji is not being helpful, either. A story about finding and
pursuing one’s passion.

books.title: Lost in the Dark
books.summary: Three friends go to fetch some firewood. On their way back they start playing and get lost. How will they get home?

books.title: From Pillars to Palaces
books.summary: Dheera loves buildings. When Ma and Baba build her a little plane, she flies out to explore what buildings are made of.

books.title: When I Grow Up
books.summary: I don’t know what I want to be when I grow up. Can you help me choose?

books.title: The Walking Mountain
books.summary: One day, a camel gets buried in a sandstorm. Only his humps can be seen. Two tortoises climb on the humps, thinking they are mountains. But when the ‘mountain’ starts to walk, the tortoises call him a ‘walking mountain’! After the camel is mistaken for a mountain several times, he goes in search of a real mountain. Does he find one?

books.title: A Rock, A Dog
books.summary:
Avi loves pretend-play. Join in as Avi turns into 
a rock, a koel and many other things in this book about noticing and recognising patterns.

books.title: Lions are Always Brave
books.summary: This little lion wants you to know that lions are strong, fast, and most of all, brave. But what is that storm cloud on the horizon? A story about who we are and who we think we should be.

books.title: Afo and I
books.summary: Everything is changing for Vinoka — his village, the mountains, the climate. And now his sister is leaving. How will he come to terms with these big changes? A story about migration in the face of climate change, and what home and family mean in a world that’s changing, faster than ever.

books.title: Animals of Uganda
books.summary: Which are the animals that abound Uganda? How do they look?

books.title: The Man in the Moon
books.summary: There's a man in the moon who wonders what life on earth with companions would be like! What happens when he ventures to find out?

books.title: Thambu's Kite
books.summary: Thambu loves flying his kite. One day, the string breaks while Thambu is flying it. What will Thambu do?

books.title: Porridge
books.summary: Mom is away and Dad is making the morning porridge.

books.title: Bus
books.summary: Beep! Beep! A day in the life of a bus.

books.title: Frog and Snake
books.summary: Some friendships always have their limits. Find out how?

books.title: Tig's World
books.summary: If the world is round, why don’t the people on the bottom fall off? Tig’s mom has one answer, and her dad has another. Who’s telling the truth?

books.title: The Great Rifasa
books.summary: Nothing seemed right in the Kabini forest — the monsoon hadn’t come and the human tourists in their safari jeeps seemed to have disappeared as well. The animals of Kabini get together to begin their own safari. A fun story, from a unique perspective, about the far-reaching impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic.

books.title: Animals Run Away
books.summary: Four animals run away from their ungrateful owners to find a place to live on their own.

books.title: A Little Help for Cumulo
books.summary: Cumulo is embarrassed. Her ears are hot. Her cheeks are flushed. Can she ever go back to the park again?

books.title: A Tale of Two Oxen
books.summary: Meet Hira and Moti, two handsome oxen, happy and content with their loving owner, Jhuri. Hira and Moti work hard everyday, are clever, kind and best friends to each other. They stay together during times of woe and harmony. Their days are filled with work, love and juicy oilseed cakes. Until one day, when they are forcibly dragged away from home and put to work under harsh and inhuman conditions. Will Hira and Moti surmount all the troubles that come along their way and finally go back home?

books.title: The Maldhok in the Desert
books.summary: Chaitan’s family seldom has guests. One day, a guest arrives. Why does his visit trouble not only Chaitan, but also his dearest friend Gagan? This is a tale of turmoil in the life of a young boy and a near-extinct bird, set in a remote part of Rajasthan.

books.title: Kottavi Raja and His Sleepy Kingdom (images only)
books.summary: Kottavi Raja had trouble sleeping. Only at night. During the day, when his ministers discussed complex problems, he’d find himself nodding of f. He asked everyone for remedies. Nothing seemed to work. Until... Travel to Kottavi Raja’s land through this book and see what happened next.

books.title: Sing to Me
books.summary: Mama loves to sing all day, especially to Baby.

books.title: Spot and Spike
books.summary: Meet Spot and Spike. Spike thinks Spot is boring and ordinary. Little does he know about Spot's clever little plan.

books.title: Big Blue Bus
books.summary: Ebei and his mother are waiting for the big blue bus. Where is it?

books.title: Behind You
books.summary: May has so much work to do but all her cleaning tools keep disappearing. What is happening, she wonders, and her siblings are not of much help. A hilarious story of mischief, and family love.

books.title: Cow with one horn
books.summary: Find out about an unique cow.

books.title: Shanti's Friend
books.summary: Do trees speak? That is what Shanti believes. Read this story of an unusual friendship ...

books.title: Lion's shoes
books.summary: Mischief most hurts the ones who cause it.

books.title: I am a Puppet
books.summary: Who am I? Sometimes I look like an alien. Sometimes I look like a clown. I can dance and I can move. I can live in a glove and in a sock. I have a large family. Come meet me.

books.title: Going to the City
books.summary: A boy is visiting the City for the first time. How do you think his sights on the way will be?

books.title: Sleepy Mr. Sloth
books.summary: He’s quite good at climbing. He knows how to swing. But sleeping’s his favourite, favourite thing!

books.title: Together We're Strong: The Story of Albertina Sisulu
categories: Together We’re Strong The Story of Albertina Sisulu
books.summary: From the day she was born to the day she died, Albertina Sisulu lived a life of love and sacrifice. A brave girl who rode a horse, she was a blessing to her family, to her community and to South Africa. This story of a unique and powerful woman, who stood up for her beliefs no matter what, will inspire and enchant.

books.title: The Lost Duckling
books.summary: Tharul wants to help a lost and injured duckling. He takes the duckling home but they only find more trouble there!

books.title: The Rat in the Cat
books.summary: The cat chased the rat. Up and down, inside and outside, everywhere they could fit. Did the cat catch the rat?

books.title: Cheep Cheep Drip Drip
books.summary: The baby in this book hears so many interesting sounds around her. Can you hear them too?

books.title: An egg for bride wealth
books.summary: A young man is given en egg that is to lead him to his bride. He loses it on his way. Find out what happens next.

books.title: Rolling
books.summary: Who can roll and who can not roll. Do they all roll together?

books.title: Gundu Fish and Kutti Fish
books.summary: Gundu Fish and Kutti Fish are playing together when they're trapped in a net. Kutti Fish escapes but Gundu Fish is still stuck! What to do now?

books.title: Mama, What's for Lunch?
books.summary: Join Thabo and his sister Tumi for magical lunches with Mama!

books.title: Shunti the Sunshine Cat
books.summary: Shunti the cat loves the sun. Dadaji does too! What is so special about the sun? Let’s find out!

books.title: Pinku and Pankhu
books.summary: Pinku and Pankhu do so much work all day that they are tired by the end of it. What do you think they do all day?

books.title: Mr Mkhize's Quarters
books.summary: A story about quarters and lunch.

books.title: Joongedai's Things
books.summary: Joongedai does not keep his room clean. His belongings are scattered all over the place. All his things are angry with him for not keeping them in the right places. They feel unwanted and neglected. How will they convince Joongedai to keep his room more neat?

books.title: Who Can Fly without Wings?
books.summary: Tithi, Anu and Kushum don't need wings to fly like birds or dragonflies or butterflies. Through the power of play and imaginary wings, they soar as high as a kite or a cluster of clouds.

books.title: Zera and Jojo
books.summary: Zera wants to invite Jojo to his birthday party. Will Jojo come to the party? Read more to find out.

books.title: No Fear...Come Here!
books.summary: A rhyme bordering on fun and scare, the elements of emotion most relatable to a child, Sukumar Ray's nonsense verses should be read by one and all!

books.title: In the Land Where Beetles Rule
categories: In the Land Where Beetles Rule
books.summary:
What would happen if the beetles were in charge? Or if fish ruled the world? This
fantastical poem offers a powerful glimpse into worlds where nature comes first.

books.title: Seasons
books.summary: Summer, monsoon, winter, spring — a poster about what seasons are like in different parts of India.

books.title: When Will the Power Come Back?
categories: When Will the Power Come Back?
books.summary: The children are not able to study because of the constant powercuts. They encourage Salim Bhai, the village electrician to do something about it. Salim Bhai has an idea. Will this idea solve their problem?

books.title: To The Top!
books.summary: Climb the mountain with us! Look out for many tiny creatures… and BIG views. If we help each other, we can get to the top!

books.title: My Tree-Friend
books.summary:
We all know trees are our friends. But can friends be trees too? Just like the fruits in
Ammoomma’s trees, friends can be sweet, sour, or both!

books.title: Ears
books.summary: I have two ears. Everyone has ears…Don’t they? How many ears do you have?

books.title: We Hope: Children on Climate Change
categories: We Hope: Children on Climate Change
books.summary: Earth is home. But the wonderful world we love is altered because of the climate crisis. Children across India share their feelings about climate change and how it is impacting their immediate surroundings and lives. Interpreted by fourteen illustrators, these powerful messages are a reminder to listen to the voices of the young.

books.title: Flower blind
books.summary: How does Chat, who was born blind, see a flower?

books.title: Sizwe's Smile
books.summary: Today Sizwe learns that a smile is something you can give away without losing it.

books.title: Ajay of Agumbe and the Signal Snake
categories: Ajay of Agumbe and the Signal Snake
books.summary: Ajay is off to work. His office is in Agumbe. His job is to find the king cobra. We can see the antenna he carries, but where on earth is the radio that transmits to it? Walk with Ajay as he follows the king of snakes.

books.title: Scared Tumi
books.summary: “What if there’s a monster under my bed?” Tumi is scared. Mama tries to show him that everything is okay.

books.title: Cyborg Dadu
books.summary: Aiman tells Dadu that the science of bionics could make it possible for many of our body parts to be replaced by machines. Find out how.

books.title: How the Whale got his throat
books.summary: The fish tells the Whale about a man 'of infinite-resource-and-sagacity.’ What happens when the Whale goes searching for him?

books.title: Clever Cat
books.summary: Safi is a clever cat! Find out more!

books.title: Did You Steal My Chestnuts?
books.summary: Early in the spring, Squirrel finds an empty tree trunk that is perfect for storing chestnuts! Squirrel adds chestnuts each day to prepare for the upcoming winter. But one day, Squirrel discovers the chestnuts are missing! Do you think he will discover who took them?

books.title: The Money Managers
books.summary:
The Rupaiya Paisa Series brings out many useful facts about money that will help children to use money wisely as they grow up in an ever-changing world. 
Meet Team Kuber, Team Dhanadhan and Team Chanakya in this book. They help you save money; they lend you money when you need it and they help you increase your wealth. How do people with very little money start a business?

books.title: Bear Goes Fishing!
books.summary: Bear would like to have a fishbowl full of fish in his house. He decides to go fishing at the pond. But, the clever fish do not want to be caught. Bear gets so frustrated that he dives in to teach the fish a lesson. Will it be Bear who gets a lesson in the end?

books.title: Forgetful Dida
books.summary: Dida has a forgetting illness. She almost went to the grocery store wearing just one sandal, instead of both, and she forgot the numbers between three and ten. What will Dida forget next? A tender story of memory told by a young girl about her grandmother.

books.title: A Very Tall Man
books.summary: A man is so tall that everything around him is too short or small. How does he resolves things?

books.title: A World of Books
books.summary: Four friends spend the days walking around and picking up old bits and pieces. Until one day a woman notices them and…read more to find out!

books.title: Spit, Spit and Spit!
books.summary: In the bushes, on the roads, while playing, while fighting -- humans love to go thoo thoo thoo. This hilarious rhyme explores the length and breadth of our spitting abilities.

books.title: Lazy Anansi
books.summary: The reason why spiders have long thin legs.

books.title: Small Bird's Big Adventure
books.summary: Small Bird loves the Giant. But where is the Giant? Small Bird goes on an adventure to find her.

books.title: My Aunt the Dyer
books.summary: My aunt the dyer dyes so many clothes. Read the story and find out about all the clothes she dyes!

books.title: Smarty Pod & Curious Pod in The Case of the Missing Diary
categories: Smarty Pod & Curious Pod in The Case of the Missing Diary
books.summary: Join your friends, Smarty Pod and Curious Pod in the search for Curious Pod’s lost diary. Curious Pod loves his diary, and cannot figure out where he has lost it! He looks for it everywhere, but he just cannot find it. Until Smarty Pod comes along, puts on his detective hat and helps him look. Smarty Pod solves the mystery and finds the diary in the strangest of places!

books.title: The Street Song
books.summary:
Step into the streets and listen to the orchestra that’s made up of so many melodies, as vendors sell string hoppers and kolam powders as well as fish and coffee, while children snack on semiya ice and murukus. Listen carefully. 
Do you hear that sound?

books.title: Dumroo
books.summary: Once there was a big village. In the village was a school, where a game was being played. Everyone joined in except Mimi. How will Didi get her to join the fun?

books.title: Let's Eat
books.summary: Rotting leaves, fresh lice, or even their own poop! Animals eat all kinds of things to suit their habitat and diet. Read about the interesting ways in which animals eat in order to get nutrients and remain strong.

books.title: Drop By Drop Makes the Ocean
categories: Drop By Drop Makes the Ocean
books.summary: A pond in the village gradually get polluted. How does granny help the kids revive the health of the pond?

books.title: The Braveheart
books.summary: A little boy's fantasy of saving his mother from dacoits, this poem takes you on a brilliant fantastical journey!

books.title: The Fish and Chicken's Wedding
books.summary:
There once lived a chicken, called Cikizwa,
who was an orphan. What happens in the chicken's life?

books.title: The Parrot with a Broken Beak
categories: The parrot with a broken beak
books.summary: Her father's pen calls out to Kasni. Should she, or should she not pick it up? After she uses it, she finds an angry father and an angry parrot. A tale with charming colours to make any child happy!

books.title: Rafiki's Style
books.summary: Rafiki’s style is all his own, but when the Cool Cat Crew struts by, he starts to wonder if it’s good enough.

books.title: The Ant and the Green Mung Bean
categories: The Ant and Green Mung Bean
books.summary: A tiny ant finds a big green mung bean. She wants to carry it home. There are many problems on the way! Will she be able to do it? Follow this ant to find out.

books.title: Happy Maths : Shapes and Data
books.summary: This is a mathematics book with a difference. There are more stories here than problems! So read the stories, absorb the mix of facts and fiction and enjoy teasing your brain.

books.title: Drawing My Cat
books.summary: Lida loves to draw! One day, her father comes home with a lot of vegetables. Guess how Lida brings the veggies together to make something very special!

books.title: Life of Shoes
books.summary: A story from the perspective of shoes. (This story was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: All About Teeth
books.summary: Animals have all sorts of teeth, and they use them in different ways. Sink your teeth in.

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Nikau?
books.summary: The schools are closed and Nikau from Oceania has just shifted to a new neighbourhood and feels lonely. How do you think he triumphs his loneliness?

books.title: What if...?
books.summary: Nandi is wondering all sorts of strange things about the world. And it begins with a simple question: What if…?

books.title: Anansi, the Crows, and the Crocodiles
books.summary: Greedy Anansi tries his friends the crows into giving him more than his share of figs. The crows uncover his tricks and abandon him on an island. He tries to fly, but lands in the river among hungry crocodiles. This seems like the end for Anansi.Will he find a way out?

books.title: The Lion and the Rabbit
books.summary: How does the rabbit trick the lion and keep himself alive?

books.title: The Picnic
books.summary: Five friends went to a forest. What will they do there? Let us read more to find out!

books.title: Bhabho the Buffalo
books.summary:
Bhabho the Buffalo had beautiful horns. One day, her horns got wet in the
rain. Dirt blew in her direction and stuck to her wet horns. The next day, a bird
flying by dropped a seed that fell on Bhabho’s horn. Soon the seed sprouted into
a tree. What will Bhabho do with a tree growing on her horns?

books.title: A Miaow and A Roar
books.summary: Vedika and Karan share a real adventure as they sit in Grandfather’s chair. Meet their friends, the lion and the cat in this fun story.

books.title: Our Little River
books.summary: Tagore’s poem is on a little river in a village. Lots of activities happen around that river. Children bathe, catch fish, women wash clothes. Flowering Kaash shrubs line the banks, foxes bark, mynahs whistle. While in summer there is knee- deep water, monsoon months make it swell.

books.title: The Hare and the Tortoise (Again!)
books.summary: Remember how the slow and steady tortoise beat the arrogant hare in that great race long ago? Now the two are back together again, and they have a task to complete. Each knows that he cannot do it without the other, but can these two big rivals work together?

books.title: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee Finds Adventure
books.summary: Ann-Nem-Oh-Nee is stuck on her rock all alone. She’s looking for adventure and wants to see the world! But how?

books.title: Squirrel
books.summary: A day in the life of a squirrel.

books.title: Tara Finds Her Stars
books.summary: Do you like sleeping under the stars? Tara does! Join her as she makes an exciting journey.

books.title: An Adventure for Puchku
books.summary: Puchku, Boltu and Dodla are stuck because their red car went PHRRP! in the middle of the road. How will they get home in the rain now? Join (BPD)2 — the Brilliant Plans Department — as they team up with firefighter Pakoda Didi to fix their problem.

books.title: Little Green Animal-eaters
books.summary: The reader follows the wise ant as she talks about carnivorous plants, how they catch prey and why they do what they do.

books.title: Flying Home
books.summary: Every year the migratory koonj visit Kheechan for five months and the the village feeds and takes care of them. Learn to count days, weeks and months with little Raju as he waits for the bird to arrive.

books.title: Me, Myself & I
books.summary: A simple book about knowing oneself and by extension knowing the others around you.

books.title: Amara and the Magic Tree
books.summary: Amara was walking in a park and came across a tree that needed water. (This story was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and the Development of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: Where Do They Go?
books.summary: In this book, find out where everyone goes!

books.title: Lenin's Guests
books.summary: Lenin makes juice for two unexpected guests on a hot summer day. Maybe you can help him serve them.

books.title: Thangwang and Bhalluka
books.summary: Thangwang the baby, and Bhalluka the bear, loved to talk to each other. Gaaa! Grrrr! Read this to see if you can understand them!

books.title: I Am Not a Cat
books.summary: Is that Aaliya or is she a lion? Join Bir, Aaliya and their friends as they play a new game.

books.title: Kanchha, the Rhino
books.summary: This is the story of a little rhino who lives in a big grassland. He loves to explore, but one day he strays too far from his mother and gets lost. Read on to find out how he gets out of trouble.

books.title: I Will Help You
books.summary: When Mama Heron needs help, Lungile comes to her rescue.

books.title: Then and Now
books.summary: It’s drizzling, and Appa tells Chiltari a story of the city of his childhood. And then father and son step out to discover a city where past meets present.

books.title: The Lost Laugh
books.summary: Spotty the Hyena has lost his laugh. How did this happen? Where could it be? And can the other animals help him find it?

books.title: What Dashu Did
books.summary: Nabinchand is shaken as he walks into school today. He had been attacked by unknown dacoits last evening. This causes a big commotion at school as the boys surround him with their own theories and conspiracies. All the boys except Dashu. Dashu remains alone and walks with a sly grin and an all-knowing expression. Does he know something the rest of us don't? What mischief is he upto this time?

books.title: Eidgah
books.summary: It is Eid again. The air is swollen with hope and excitement for the festivities to begin. The young children can only think about their visit to the Eidgah. Little Hamid lives with his grandmother and is armed only with three paisa for himself as he sets out with his friends who are boastful of the riches they possess. While his friends endlessly buy sweets, toys and tease Hamid for his inability to do so, Hamid must make a choice for himself.

books.title: LIGHTS... CAMERA...  ACTION! The life and times of Dadasaheb Phalke
categories: LIGHTS... CAMERA...  ACTION! The life and times of Dadasaheb Phalke
books.summary: “Watch people move in the magic photographs! A picture two miles long! Only three annas!” This is how a magician named Dadasaheb Phalke invited people in the street to come and watch his first film. Other actors in this amazing story about the genius of Dadasaheb Phalke, the Father of Indian Cinema, include a cook who played a woman and the first film editor in Indian cinema who happened to be a woman and his wife! If you are a fan of films, you are sure to be fascinated by this script of his life and the making of the first ever Indian film. It has all the ingredients of blockbuster!

books.title: Starry Skies
books.summary: We’ve all seen stars in the night sky. But where do they come from? Let’s find out!

books.title: Monkey and the Drought
books.summary: A drought leads some monkeys to live in a far off land called Tirlok. But the monkeys of Tirlok  don't like these new visitors.  What happens next?

books.title: Teju's Shadow
books.summary: Teju is worried. Something keeps following him! What could it be?

books.title: Petros and his Dog
books.summary: A sweet friendship between a boy and a dog.

books.title: Muchkund and his Sweet Tooth
books.summary: In this tale, Muchkund and his bright gang of ghosts have a clever way of dealing with forest offenders

books.title: The Goat That Ate the Spinach
categories: The Goat That Ate the Spinach
books.summary: A story about naughty boys and a kind grandmother.

books.title: Pommy and Tommy
books.summary:
Everyone in Pommy’s family loves
animals. Everyone except Pommy!
Until one day she meets a dog who
changes her mind.

books.title: I'm Not Scared
books.summary: Archana is scared of the subway. Her Dadaji helps her confront her fears by turning them into something magical! A play about the wonderful relationship between a grandfather and his granddaughter and the magical power of imagination.

books.title: An Ode to Cricket
books.summary: An ode for all cricket fans, small and big.

books.title: At the River
books.summary: Akash goes to the river with Ma and Dada. There is so much water! Akash is scared. But nobody else is afraid of the water at all. Does Akash lose his fear of the water?

books.title: Happy Akai
books.summary: Akai needs new shoes. Will she get them?

books.title: Pari's Polio Ravivar
books.summary: Little Pari goes with her mother Seema to get Polio drops. Krishna  Bua and the other ASHA didis help the villagers and make 'Polio Ravivar' a huge success.

books.title: I Have So Many Friends
books.summary: Akash has many friends. Four-legged, moving on wheels, green coloured, those that show him the magic of words...Who are all these friends?

books.title: Why Hyenas Limp
books.summary: Find out the story behind the hyena's limp.

books.title: Maya the Warrior
books.summary: Maya doesn’t feel like she belongs. She doesn’t fit in with the girls or the boys in her class. Follow her on a journey of self discovery. A book about learning to love yourself.

books.title: Bountong's New Hat
books.summary:
Woooosh! Woooosh! That’s the sound of the wind as Bountong rides across a field wearing his new hat. Accompanied by his buffalo,
Bountong has an adventurous day with a hat that has a long tail, horns and eyes.

books.title: Fossils: Tales of Long Ago
books.summary: Fossils can answer many questions about our past—about beasts that are extinct, early humans, forests that have become deserts. Learn about fossils from this book.

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Bo?
categories: Hope Where are you for Bo
books.summary: The schools are closed and Bo from Asia is staying with his Aunt because his parents are doctors who are at the hospital fighting the crisis. He is worried for them. What does he do?

books.title: Black Hats White Hats
books.summary: Who are hackers? What is data and why do they like to steal it? And can they ever be stopped from taking what doesn’t belong to them? Read on to find out!

books.title: The Tunes of Kongthong
books.summary: In Kongthong, one of the most unique villages in Meghalaya, three boys named Kyrpang, Pyndap, and Shemphang head to a nearby waterfall for a day of enjoyment and fun. The boys soon discover a beautiful cave filled with numerous life forms. As they move further into the cave, they become stranded. How will they manage to escape the cave with the night fast approaching? Join Kyrpang and his friends as they utilise their musical names to find a way out.

books.title: Lunch with Dadu
books.summary: Hot Saturday afternoons are curd rice time. Join Timtim, Minu and Binu at their Dadu’s house for a lunch of yummy podis and pickles.

books.title: Ilari's Jaiñsem
books.summary:
In the hilly village of Roibha, it's time for the annual festival. Little Ilari is enchanted by her mother's beautiful jaiñsem. Eager to wear one herself, she sets out to learn more about it from her wise grandmother. 
Join Ilari in her quest as she unravels the do's and don't's of how to wear a jaiñsem.

books.title: Luvi's New Look
books.summary: On one of his walks, Luvi the cat notices an empty beauty parlour and decides to play around with his looks.

books.title: The Dordles  Go Home (Book 3)
books.summary:
Three creatures find alternative sources of fuel to generate enough energy to get home. The final book in a series about the adventures
of the Dordles, who find themselves stuck on a planet where resources are scarce.

books.title: Rabbit Goes on a Quest
books.summary: After narrowly escaping arrows, rabbit goes in search of the King of the forest to warm him about the attacks. Will he be successful?

books.title: The Animal Plot
books.summary: It’s easy to count one dog or five cows, but how about a dozen different animals? Travel to farms in various states of India and figure out how to use tools to understand data.

books.title: The Boat Ride
books.summary: Vikki, the squirrel likes to talk big. His cousin came to visit him and they went on a boat ride. They were having fun when things turned rather adventurous.

books.title: Rabbit Goes to a Party
books.summary: Rabbit puts on a pair of horns to go to a horned party. What happens when the other animals find out?

books.title: Sringeri Srinivas Keeps His Promise
books.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic is over. It’s time for Sringeri Srinivas to cut his hair at last. But just then, some alarming news comes his way. What will Sringeri do?

books.title: Colouring Pencils
books.summary: The new colouring pencils are afraid of being used by Toto. He might be too rough with them and they don't want to get hurt. What happens next?

books.title: Bo's Treasure
books.summary: After his friend brags about his fantastic toy boat, Bo runs home to look for his own treasures. What do you think Bo will find?

books.title: Chameli's Sparkle
books.summary: Chameli loves her golden jewelry. Before long, she loves it more than anything else, even her friends. How will Chameli learn to sparkle without gold?

books.title: Counting Cats
books.summary: How many cats can you count?

books.title: The Golden Boat
books.summary: An allegorical picturesque poem that questions the meaning of human life.

books.title: The Mad Pranks of Dashu
books.summary: It is the last day of school for the year which means it is time for the students to stage their play again! Having sharp memories of the way Dashu messed up their play last year, all the boys are keen to keep an eager Dashu away from their play. What crazy plan does Dashu come up with this time to get his way with everyone around?

books.title: Dreaming Under the Same Sky
books.summary: Parvat, Aman’s home, is sometimes at war, sometimes  at peace. After an attack, Aman is taken to safety by Baadal. Together they embark on a journey to discover what the many meanings of peace could be.

books.title: The Lifelong Question
books.summary: How long do we live for? Whether it’s for hundreds of years or one day — we all share this big planet we call home.

books.title: The Village Leader
books.summary: Than Kyi always wanted to help her village. Read the unconventional journey of she became the only female village leader in all of Kayah State in Myanmar.

books.title: Whose button is this?
books.summary: Tinny Tim sets out on an adventure to return a lost button. Along the way he goes exploring, has a miraculous escape, and makes new friends.

books.title: A Song in Space: Kesarbai Kerkar
categories: A Song in Space: Kesarbai Kerkar
books.summary: Little Kesar loved to sing. She never imagined that when she grew up her voice would travel to distant galaxies. Read this book to find out about legendary singer Kesarbai Kerkar’s fascinating musical journey.

books.title: Friends Become Enemies
books.summary: Will hardworking Hyena ever learn his lesson when it comes to his friend the lazy Hare ?

books.title: The Blob Who Wanted to Be More
categories: The Blob Who Wanted to Be More
books.summary: Blob always wanted to be more than just a blob, so she set out on an adventure. Along the way, she made new friends, learned new things and came closer to her true self. Read this early reader book and go on an endless adventure with the blob.

books.title: Pumpkin Crush
books.summary: Who is Pumpkin-Crush? What does it do? Read on to find what the poet instructs you to do around Pumpkin-Crush!

books.title: Mrs Penguin's Perfect Palace
books.summary: Mrs. Penguin is tired of living amidst garbage. The family is out on the beach, trying to build a palace! Will she have her perfect palace?

books.title: A Leaf Goes on a Trip
categories: A Leaf Goes on a Trip
books.summary:
A leaf flew in the wind. It went far and wide. In the end, it landed in Kabeer’s home. What did
Kabeer do with the leaf?

books.title: Thuli's Special Secret
books.summary: Thuli has the cookies. Special has her eye on the cookies. What’s their secret?

books.title: Naagu and Nunu's Problem
categories: THE PROBLEM OF NAAGU AND NUNU
books.summary: Naagu and Nunu don't feel like going to school. Why? How will they feel at the end of the story? Read more to find out.

books.title: Where is Yellow?
books.summary: A beautiful picture is being painted for all children in the world. Every tube of paint in the palette is excited to be a part of it – except for yellow. He decides to escape, leaving the painting unfinished. What will the painter do?

books.title: The Water Cycle
books.summary: There is no water in Mr. Cloud and he is sad. Find out why!

books.title: Chasing the Rain
books.summary: Sometimes the monsoon arrives a little early. Sometimes, a little late. But climate change is making rainfall more and more difficult to predict, and even dangerous. Meet the meteorologists, physicists, farmers and other experts whose lives are dedicated to studying rainfall and its impact on our lands.

books.title: Post Office
books.summary: Meet Amal. He is a dreamer and his mind wanders beyond the clouds and mountain ranges. No barrier can stop his imagination or curious spirit. Extremely sick and unwell, he is unable to leave his house and can only look at the world through a single open window. Through this window, Amal meets and learns all the quirky things in the world, leads a life richer than anyone that's outside and waits and waits for a letter from the King.

books.title: Sun, Moon and Water
books.summary: A Dhopadhola myth about why the Sun and the Moon stay in the sky.

books.title: We Are Making a Book
books.summary: Chew, cut, roll, stitch — these creatures are busy making a book!

books.title: The Ok Om Bok Festival
books.summary: It's a special day in Nhay's neighbourhood. Every house is decorated with flowers and ribbons for the Ok Om Bok festival. Everyone is preparing offerings. How can Nhay help?

books.title: Catch the Moustache Thief
books.summary: Read on Sukumar Ray's brilliant poem on the fun consequences of the boss losing his moustache. Has it really been stolen?

books.title: Crushed Louse
books.summary: Two young men accept a louse's hospitality. What happens next?

books.title: Chunu & Munu: Let's Sing and Dance for Nature!
books.summary: Chunu and Munu look around them. Everything in nature is singing and dancing. They also want to sing and dance!

books.title: Searching for the Spirit of Spring
books.summary: Nkanyezi can’t wait for the Spring festival, but the people of Ndlovu have lost their spirit of celebration. She must go in search of the spirit of Spring. What will she find?

books.title: Where is my Pet?
books.summary: Nia always has trouble finding her pet! She tries painting it different colours so that she can find it more easily, but it always seems to hide from her. What do you think Nia does?

books.title: The Jackal’s Loss
categories: Panderan dà Kulu / Thekua O Kaincha
books.summary:
A clever hare helps his friend, the tortoise. 
Read on to see how they tricked the jackal.

books.title: Mum Said
contributors: ជឿន  ប្រុស
books.summary: Mum inspires her kids to do many different things. Will they be able to help Grandpa Ro?

books.title: Secret Owner
books.summary: A bag has been stolen but nobody admits to stealing it. How will the Arachchi official find the real thief?

books.title: We like Different Things
books.summary: Yangjee and Lucky find they like different things. Can they still be best friends?

books.title: Share it Fair!
books.summary: A math story about the importance of sharing it fairly, even when it difficult to share equally.

books.title: I'm the Colour of Honey
books.summary: Is that your teacher? Is that your Aunty? Amanda is fed up with these questions and wishes that she looked just like her Mummy and Daddy. But maybe they are more alike than she realises!

books.title: Kato Clever and the Big Trouble
categories: Kato Clever and the Big Trouble
books.summary: Kato, the squirrel’s family lived in a garden. One day, some people came there with machines to cut down the trees. How did Kato and his friends save themselves from this Big Trouble? Find out in this charming tale.

books.title: A New Visitor
books.summary: All the animals are excited that someone new has arrived in the forest. Who do you think it is?

books.title: A Fish and a Gift
books.summary: Yusuf waits on the beach while Papa pushes out his boat. Surfers, turtles and sharks come from the sea. What will Papa bring back for Yusuf?

books.title: Plasto
books.summary: Plasto, the plastic monster, eats whatever it sees in sight! It is getting bigger and bigger, destroying everything on the way. Can Plasto be stopped? A story about what to do with our plastic problem.

books.title: Jasu Loves Football
books.summary: Jasu loves football. She loves kicking the ball, hard! But she doesn't have her own ball. Jasu comes up with a plan.

books.title: Hide and Seek
books.summary: Little boy wonders what would happen if he were to bloom like the champa flower on a champa shrub. Would mother be able to find him? When the mornings would be filled with the perfume of the champa flower, or in the evenings, it would drop in front of the mother’s feet, would she recognise him?

books.title: Is Dedo Really Mad?
books.summary: The people of Ogorme think that Dedo is mad, u until she achieves something they couldn't.

books.title: Cool Cool Ice Gola
books.summary: Cool, colourful, yummy ice gola. Look, Ice Gola Uncle is here. These children are having such fun!

books.title: The Rooster That Crowed Too Soon
books.summary: The Red Rooster tell everyone he is brave and unafraid. Find out what happens when a hawk comes amidst them.

books.title: Surki and Tirki
books.summary: Surki and Tirki are the best of friends. But when a new girl joins school, will it change their friendship?

books.title: Yapo Saves The Day
books.summary: Yapo loves to play soccer! But he does not like to pass the ball to his teammates. How will Yapo discover that winning is not only about scoring?

books.title: Happy as a Hen
books.summary: Ma-Cluck and K-Chick have come to Earth to see the wonderful life that hens lead here. When Ra Ra Rooster takes them to the place of Absolute Happiness, the group realises that it isn’t as happy as they first thought.

books.title: Chikkiri Chakkiri
books.summary: Chikkiri chakkiri, the cat’s playing her flute and the mouse is beating his drum. Put on your dancing shoes and dance to the beat of this playful verse.

books.title: Pontshibobo's tree
books.summary: This story teaches us about true friendship.

books.title: The Very Tired Lioness
books.summary: The lioness is tired. Her sisters and daughters want her to join the hunt. But the sun is calling her. A story about transitions.

books.title: The Hare's Story
books.summary: There is no water in the animal kingdom and so the king called a meeting to find a solution. Everyone shows up, except for the hare. At the meeting, they all agree to dig a well, but not let the hare drink from it. The hare had his own plan. What do you think it was?

books.title: Chatty Pod & Shy Pod in The Talk-a-thon
categories: Chatty Pod & Shy Pod in The Talk-a-thon
books.summary: Shy Pod is too shy to talk to anyone. But Chatty Pod, who is the most talkative Pod in Podville decides to make Shy Pod not so shy any more. Read on to find out how Chatty Pod does it.

books.title: Zandi and Birdy Monster
books.summary: Zandi has a friend that no one else can see. His name is Birdy Monster. They mix up magic potions, play pretend and go on adventures together.

books.title: PLOP falls the mango
books.summary: A mango falls down from a tree. Plop! What happens next? Join the pigeon, the monkey, the lion and many other animals in this tranquil story, and find out for yourself.

books.title: We Love Celebrations!
books.summary: The children see many changes that took place in their village. They decide it is time to celebrate all these new changes. How will they celebrate? Who will participate in this celebration?

books.title: Treasure in the caves
books.summary: Why are our fingers perfectly designed to fit in our nostrils? Why do we like to explore the two dark caves on our noses? Let's dig a little deeper in this hysterical poem.

books.title: Shongololo
books.summary: Pula and Pule discover something magical about the train that takes grown ups to work and back everyday.  Is it just their imagination or does the train have a secret life?

books.title: When a Huro Sings
