books.summary: Huros are the only apes living in India. The Garo Hills in Meghalaya is one of their homes. Every morning, huros sing songs for the forest,  the wildlife, and the people of Garo. It’s magical! Come, see what happens when a huro sings!

books.title: Azizi, the Doll
books.summary: Read the story of my doll names Azizi and how I love to take care of him.

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Gaby?
categories: Hope Where are you for Gaby
books.summary: The schools are closed and Gaby from Latin America is disturbed. Her siblings are crying and parents are fighting. How does grandfather's call help?

books.title: Hope, Where are you for Alessandro?
books.summary: The schools are closed and Alessandro from Europe has been learning from home. He doesn't feel like himself. What does he do?

books.title: E C George Sudarshan: The Man Who Loved Physics
categories: E C George Sudarshan: The Man Who Loved Physics
books.summary: Physicist E C George Sudarshan made one of the greatest scientific discoveries in the 20th century. It helped answer fascinating questions about atoms, the tiny particles that make up our universe.

books.title: Who Is Incharge of the Payment?
categories: Who Is incharge of the Payment?
books.summary: Every year in rains villagers have problems travelling. Lalu Chacha and other villagers demand a pakka road for their village. A road project gets approved under MGNREGA work but will the villagers be paid on time?

books.title: Tone's Big Drop
books.summary: Tone the raindrop is wondering what’s way down there on the ground. She and her friend Nyunyu go on a journey to find out.

books.title: I Don't Know
books.summary: Appu wakes up in the morning feeling happy. But as the morning turns into afternoon, then evening, then night, Appu’s feelings keep changing. He is bored, angry, scared…Appu does not know why. Do you?

books.title: How about you?
books.summary: You don’t need to be alike to be friends. When two very different children meet an unusual creature, it’s a chance to ask, How About You?

books.title: What Can Our Hands Do?
books.summary: What can our hands do? Can we play games with our hands? Read on to find out.

books.title: The Tortoiseshell Beetle
books.summary: Sudha Ma’am knows that Rohith struggles inside the four walls of the school. So the two of them go for a walk by the lake. They meet a tortoiseshell beetle who, just like the boy, walks its own path.

books.title: One Summer Afternoon
books.summary: Children in the village grow up in close proximity with other living beings. Read this touching story of how they learn some important life lessons.

books.title: Who is The Next Ruler?
books.summary: Who will be the king of animals after King Leopard dies?

books.title: How colours came together in the sky
books.summary: A girl teaches her younger sister about how rainbows come to be in the sky.

books.title: Sentence Street
books.summary: Hold hands with the punctuation marks to go to the world of reading and writing.

books.title: The Cottonwool Doctor
books.summary: Margaret was clever and curious. Margaret had big dreams. But 200 years ago, a girl could not become a doctor. So she cut off her hair and she put on a boy’s clothes. From then on, no one knew that Margaret was a girl. She became James Barry.

books.title: Shapes on the Shore
books.summary: From the verandah of their Thatha’s house, Maya and her cousins can see strange things on the seashore. Are they slithering sea monsters? Or magnificent sandcastles for crabs? Read to find out.

books.title: Shhhhh!
books.summary: Shh! Baby is asleep! Why is everyone making so much noise?

books.title: Why Birds Sing at Dawn
books.summary: Drought has struck Happy-Land, and Mama Birdie goes in search of the magic rain worm. Can anyone sing her back home?

books.title: Hats
books.summary: Funky Monkey has come to the jungle with a big box of beautiful, colourful hats. Who will get one? Who won't?

books.title: Eyad's Pigeons
books.summary:
Eyad loves pigeons. He loves the way they coo every morning and their many colours and patterns.
Join Eyad and his dada as they learn about pigeons.

books.title: Africa Unity Race
books.summary: The story is about two young people who run across Africa to spread the message of unity. On the way, others join the race.

books.title: Adventure Around South Africa
books.summary: Teaches the 9 provinces of South Africa and their capital cities. (It was originally created at a storybook development workshop with 22 educators, in February 2019, in partnership with the British Council and the Department of Basic Education, South Africa).

books.title: What's at the Park?
books.summary: Zoey loves finding things in the park. One day, she gets a big surprise.

books.title: Pendo, Our Cow
books.summary: This is the story of Ndalo and his cow, Pendo.

books.title: Neo finds her pig
books.summary: Neo loses her pig in an accident. What happens after that?

books.title: Loving Pod and Grumpy Pod in The Puppy Surprise
categories: Loving Pod and Grumpy Pod in The Puppy Surprise
books.summary: Poor Grumpy Pod is lonely. Loving Pod comes to his rescue with a lovely surprise that makes Grumpy Pod laugh. Read on to find out what the surprise is.

books.title: What Did You Bring?
books.summary: Aai tells Manu to bring her some curry leaves from the garden. What does Manu see there? Does she find the curry leaves?

books.title: A father's lesson
books.summary: What do you think of the advice from Abula's father?

books.title: Mr Motaung's thirds
books.summary: A story about thirds, and lunch.

books.title: Growing Stars
books.summary: Can stars grow on earth? Jo can’t wait to find out.

books.title: Let's go
books.summary: Let's go and test our senses!

books.title: Khutso's Strange Dream
books.summary: Khutso has a dream. He wakes up in a sweat! What did he dream about?

books.title: Heela's Dream
books.summary: Heela got promoted to class 6th and her Father bought her a gift... What was the Gift? Why did Heela get upset when she saw the Gift? How did the gift inspire her afterwards? Read to find out.

books.title: What Is Your Emergency?
books.summary: Lalu Chacha falls sick on his son's wedding day. He has to reach the Primary Healthcare Center (PHC) to get treatment. Will Lalu Chacha be back before the wedding starts?

books.title: Leech!
books.summary:
Leech! Leech! Leech! 
Have you heard of the leech?

books.title: Unathi and the Dirty, Smelly Beast
books.summary: Something is following Unathi…

books.title: 'M'e Maneo's Pumpkin
books.summary: 'M'e Maneo plants a pumpkin seed which grows into a huge pumpkin. In the Summer, the pumpkin has a big surprise for the people in the valley.

books.title: Fana and her animals
books.summary: Fana loves animals. She spends time with them, feeding them, and playing with them.

books.title: Drivers in a Hurry
books.summary: Four young boys and girls use bottles, old newspapers, and used books to create vehicles for their game. The game begins. They are driving carelessly. Suddenly, a CRASH!

books.title: Wally the Wave
books.summary: Wally the happy, cheerful, wave enjoys his time with all the people who come to play with him. But once they leave, he experiences some very big emotions. How does Wally deal with them? Read to find out!

books.title: Ban's Journey in Music
books.summary: Music courses through the veins of Wahkhen village. Children begin to form a connection with music at a young age, however, a young boy named Ban has some trouble doing that. This is the story of Ban, seeking to find his footing in, and connection with music. This is a tale of discovering inspiration in the most unexpected, and the most everyday experiences.

books.title: Eagle's needle
books.summary: Hen loses Eagle's family heirloom.

books.title: Scatter Chatter [1]
books.summary: Dive deep into the nonsense world of imagination where the mind is set free and one can dance to off-beat rhythm!

books.title: Diengsong
books.summary:
What do you do when you have 2000+ steps that connect your home to the world? 
You hop, skip, and jump! Join Hep-hep as she climbs and counts the steps of Diensong.

books.title: Opposites
books.summary: Let’s go on a fun trip to the Garo Hills through this book of opposites!

books.title: What's That Noise?
books.summary: On a sleepy Sunday afternoon, the residents of Band Baajaa Colony hear strange sounds outside. Is it a cat or a bird? A kettle or a whistle? Read to find out what they discover.

books.title: Soar On, Kite!
books.summary: It’s harvest season and all the kids in the village gather in the field to fly their kites.  Magnificent kites shaped as elephants, butterflies, and cats take to the sky. But there is one kite that feels different. It looks plain and simple, but it holds an incredible secret.

books.title: Koria the Crow
books.summary: Koria the crow is unhappy with her plain black feathers and wishes to be colorful like the peacock and the parrot. Since she cannot change her feathers, Koria asks the goldsmith to make her a pair of earrings. Do you think the earrings will make her feel beautiful?

books.title: Busy Busy Sun
books.summary: Story about sun and the shadow it casts.

books.title: Falcon Superheroes
books.summary: Tyrso village is brimming with activity. The arrival of the migratory Amur Falcons has divided the boys in the village. While there are those who want to hurt them, the Falcon Superheroes are determined to save the birds. Will the Superheroes save the day or will help come from an unexpected source?

books.title: Rainbows in Windows
books.summary: Read this sensitively woven story about two siblings and their community navigating the distress of COVID-19.

books.title: Tin Trong, the Little Bus
books.summary: Tin Trong, the little bus, makes many long journeys. He goes up and down the hills through bright sunlight, dust, and dirt. One day, Tin Trong gets sick. How will he get better and carry his passengers again?

books.title: Myntdu
books.summary:
A nymph named Myntdu is charmed by a river in a small village in the Jaiñtia Hills. The river and the village both become her namesake, Myntdu and Mihmyntdu. They all live in harmony with each other. When illness spreads, it threatens not just the well-being of the inhabitants, but the peaceful bond between nature and humanity. 
Can they come together to fight this illness?

books.title: Elephant and Chameleon
books.summary: A king sets a difficult task, but the reward is to marry the princess. Who will succeed Elephant or Chameleon ?

books.title: Katiiti’s Song
books.summary: Every day, Katiiti’s mother calls her with a beautiful song. One day, a crafty gorilla tries to sing as sweetly as her mother.

books.title: Ramya's Stars
books.summary: Where did Ramya's diamond earrings come from? Find out in this bright little story.

books.title: Anku's Happy Sunday!
books.summary: Anku lives in a hilly Garhwali village. On Sundays, Anku does many fun activities. What are these activities? Let's read and find out.

books.title: The Lesson
books.summary: I do not like that Uncle at all. He stares and tries to get too close to me. Look inside to know what I did.

books.title: Scatter Chatter [2]
books.summary: Once in Ray's nonsense world, nothing's forgiven, nothing's sane. Read on to find how one can free oneself in this make-believe world.

books.title: Dogs versus Cats
books.summary: Dogs Versus Cats is the story of an uncommon friendship between a dog and a cat. But what happens when the cat is invited to live inside a nice, warm house--and the dog must still live outside?

books.title: Mogau's Gift
books.summary: A child born with a full set of teeth? He surely is a miracle! Follow his adventure-filled story and find out where Mogau’s gifts take him.

books.title: Munni, the Lamb
books.summary: Mother Goat has given birth to two new kid goats! What do they do?

books.title: My Mother Planted
books.summary: Mother and father are planting gardens. The family works together to plant and harvest.

books.title: Anansi and Wisdom
books.summary: Will Anansi share his pot of wisdom with everyone?

books.title: Phila in the Sacred Forest
books.summary: Phila, who lives near the Sacred Forest, goes stomping through the forest and loses one of her shiny boots. In her search for the missing boot, she finds more than what she’s looking for.

books.title: Tina and the Stars
books.summary: Tina loves how the stars shine. She wants pluck them from the sky. How will Tina do it?

books.title: The Archer
books.summary: Aung Ngeain did not start out as a champion. Follow her journey to learn how she became one of the best archers in Myanmar and the world.

books.title: Thunder and Lightning
books.summary: Thunder and her son, Lightning, lived on earth amongst people. Due to her destructive, naughty son the king sent them to live in the sky away from people.

books.title: Tamara Starts School
books.summary: Tamara wanted nothing but to go to school just like her sisters and brothers. Will she be able to?

books.title: Rhino Charge
books.summary: Ringo, a baby rhinoceros lives in the serene grasslands of Kaziranga National Park along the mighty river Brahmaputra. He is very shy and everybody laughs at him. How will he make new friends?

books.title: Hyena and Raven
books.summary: Hyena wants to know what the white mark is at the back of Raven’s neck. On hearing that it is meat, he also wants to be able to fly into the clouds to get this 'meat'. He succeeds in flying, but it doesn't last and he falls to earth.

books.title: Wiggle Jiggle
books.summary: Wiggle jiggle wriggle with the wiggly worm, on a fun adventure that is full of surprises.

books.title: Aai Is the Best
books.summary: Sargam and Sameer always say, “Our Aai is the best.” But do you know why?

books.title: Friendly Pod and Naughty Pod in The Doodle Party
categories: Friendly Pod and Naughty Pod in The Doodle Party
books.summary: Join your friends, Friendly Pod and Naughty Pod and see how Naughty Pod learns to doodle. Naughty Pod is always spoiling Friendly Pod’s doodles. One day, Friendly Pod teaches her a lesson and also makes sure she stops being so naughty. Find out how.

books.title: One Earth: Planetary Health for All
books.summary: Scientists and artists from India, Switzerland and Uganda share their hopes for better planetary health for us and the Earth’s denizens. This book was created as part of Trialogue Days – Planetary Health from Different Perspectives: Mind the Gap which was held in Bengaluru in 2024.

books.title: Dashu the Crazy!
books.summary: Meet Dashu, the cleverest prankster you will ever come across. With his wild eyes and a head full of messy curls, Dashu can never stay quiet and keep to himself! He entangles himself in a series of witty pranks that earn him the name of ‘The Crazy One’.

books.title: There Must be a Rainbow
books.summary: In this delightful tale of hope, Jabulile’s dream of helping people comes true after a terrible storm hits the Valley.

books.title: Auntie Boi's Gift
books.summary: Auntie Boi has sent a present from Kenya. Kopano and Rea go to town to pick it up. What a journey!

books.title: Good Night, Monu
books.summary: Monu is off to bed—but not before he wishes the world “Good Night”. But what’s that lurking in the shadows? Could it be a monster, or three? Open this book with caution.

books.title: Bei Rym-aw
books.summary: The Chad Sukra festival is here! Waka and her squirrel friend Kiru are excited to be part of the celebrations. But, after a fateful encounter with Bei Rym-aw herself, they start to realise a heartbreaking truth–humans are harming the environment. What will the two do to make the festival a symbol of hope again?

books.title: Sonth Is Here
books.summary: Ghazal loves winter and snow but when spring arrives in the valley of Kashmir, so do colour, music and the sun. A joyous celebration of everything the season of spring, Sonth, evokes.

books.title: Cuckoo Wants To Sing
books.summary: Cuckoo has lost his song. He tries to find his voice throughout the seasons, as flowers bloom and rains come. Will he ever sing again?

books.title: Saboo and Jojo
books.summary: Jojo and Saboo make a lovely pair!

books.title: The Adventures of Mboza and her Rooster
books.summary: During her school holidays, Mboza and her parents go to visit her Grandma. When they arrive, Grandma offers Mboza a rooster as a gift, but she must chase and catch it first. Do you think Mboza will catch the rooster?

books.title: Dancing
books.summary: A girl loves to dance. Not everybody is happy about it. Does that make her sad?

books.title: How Do I Grow from My Mistakes?
categories: How Do I Grow from My Mistakes?
books.summary: Anku and Rohan are busy with the school Annual Day preparations. They both make some mistakes while trying to finish their work. What do you do when you make a mistake or hurt people?

books.title: I Feel Safe When..
books.summary: Anku, Soni, Ritu, Rohan, and Sunil feel scared sometimes but they also feel safe a lot of times. Find out who makes them feel safe and how?

books.title: Who's that Baby?
books.summary: A new baby has come to play. Who could it be?

books.title: Come Back Soon, Mira
books.summary: Mira is leaving for boarding school tomorrow. Arav will miss his older sister who is so much fun to be around. Can he make her some memories to take along?

books.title: The Sea
books.summary:
On a very hot day, a child goes to the sea,
where she discovers a game she can play with
the waves.

books.title: I Need a Violin
books.summary: A dragonfly wants a violin but does not know how to make one. His friend the butterfly helps him get a violin.

books.title: Amazing Daisy
books.summary: Daisy, the little chicken always wanted to fly, but all the other farm animals make fun of her practicing. Until one say something amazing happens.

books.title: Dira and Chaku
books.summary: Dira has a fight with his brother. But, when he sees his brother stuck in a tree and an angry elephant snarling below, he has to make a choice. Can Dira save his brother? Does he want to?

books.title: Bani
books.summary: Bani can float in her sleep and reach the most amazing amusing places. Would you like to float along?

books.title: Why Fly Pesters Cow
books.summary: A tiny animal with an irritating buzz!

books.title: All About Claws
books.summary: Animals have claws of all kinds, and they use them in many different ways. Dig in.

books.title: First Place
books.summary: Rabbit just transferred to a new school and hopes to make new friends. He thinks that if he wins first place in everything, then everyone will like him. Do you think Rabbit’s plan will work?

books.title: Kilbe
books.summary: Kilbe is a question. Can love and purity bond with human frailty and shortcomings? Through an immersive use of tribal onomatopoeia in the Garo language and thoughtful illustrations, Kilbe explores the birth of  a creature born of unconditional love, their friendship with Due, and their encounter with Tongte Gongge, a misunderstood creature with inverted feet.

books.title: Exploration Day!
books.summary: Dadi tells the children something new about their village. They explore their village and meet some people who tell them more about their work.

books.title: Ali
books.summary: When Ali saw water dripping from the tap, he put a pot under the tap. What does he do with the pot next? Read more to find out.

books.title: Hyena and Tortoise
books.summary: How the tortoise got a hard shell, and the hyena got patches on his back.

books.title: Grandpa's Worry
books.summary: Something troubles grandpa so much, the worries enter his dreams! Read more to understand what worries him.

books.title: All by Myself
books.summary: Grown-ups think I can't do anything at all. But I CAN get dressed all by myself!

books.title: Khasi Garments
books.summary: Let us explore some Khasi garments from Meghalaya, through this book which is part of The Garment Series.

books.title: We Are Months
books.summary: Let's take a look at the twelve months of the year through the eyes of the children from the Jaiñtia Hills.

books.title: Shepherd and his Best Friend
books.summary: A young shepherd is saved from danger by his fury best friend. What danger was he facing? Read and find out!

books.title: River or a string of clouds?
categories: RIVER OR A STRING OF CLOUDS?
River or a string of clouds
books.summary: Rivers are where raindrops are stored and rivers are a string of clouds.  Rivers are where fish breathe and on whose banks, farms flourish. A book in verse about the many meanings of a river.

books.title: Parna's Calf
books.summary: What happens when a boy takes his cattle out and a calf is born? Let's find out!

books.title: Holidays with Grandmother
books.summary: Two children are excited as they prepare to visit grandmother in her village. They enjoy life in the village so much that they don't want to leave.

books.title: The kingfisher and the sea
books.summary: Why does the kingfisher bird refuse to leave the river bank?

books.title: Punishment
books.summary: What is the punishment for a boy who ate too much fruit?

books.title: Baby's First Family Photo
books.summary: Baby’s family is excited about their first family photo. What will Mama, Papa, Big Sister, Baby and Gogo wear?

books.title: Ou Ou Wants to Have Friends
books.summary: Ou Ou likes to sing, dance and play. But he does not like his sharp porcupine spines because no one wants to play with him. A little mouse sees that Ou Ou is a good friend and his spines are not scary. Will the other animals see it too?

books.title: I would have liked it if...
categories: I would have liked it if...
books.summary: There are things you like. And things you don’t. That’s the way it is in Megh’s family. But what’s more important is the love that the family shares with each other.

books.title: The Magic in Pottery
books.summary: In a village called Siju, runs the Simsang river. The silt and clay formed in the embankments of this river help make the strongest pots in Garo Hills. Aski, a young girl who is curious about the daily activities of her grandmother, embarks on a journey of not just discovering the magic in crafting pottery, but also acquires the knowledge that is passed down from her ancestors.

books.title: Sam's Treasures
books.summary: What treasures did Sam find in the park?

books.title: Picnic and Pine Needles
books.summary: Join siblings Bih, Deng, and Hep on their sngi saitjaiñ picnic to Upper Shillong for some pine needle collecting and a heartwarming time bonding with their family.

books.title: Koni Juj: The Egg Fight
books.summary: It is the day of the egg fight during the Rongali Bihu festival in Assam. Mamoni wakes up early and chooses different eggs to take to the fight. But will she win the most number of eggs to become the champion of the koni juj?

books.title: Gulli-danda
books.summary: Gulli-danda is the king of all games, is simple with no rules or bets or bats or nets. Steeped in the rural scene of India, it is free of any division and discrimination. As the narrator comes back to his hometown as an established engineer, yearning for a game of gulli-danda, somehow his status and wealth has crept up between him and his childhood friends from the village, taking away the wild essence and freedom from his beloved gulli-danda.

books.title: The Cat's Lost Bread
books.summary: Three cats always make sure they have three pieces of delicious sweet bread for dinner. But one day they find that a piece of their sweet bread has gone missing. The next day, the same thing happens! Can you help them find the thief?

books.title: The Dividing Lines
books.summary: A poet wakes up to a wonderful dream, one that imagines a world without borders.

books.title: Xay Goes Fishing
books.summary: Xay is going fishing and all his pets want to go with him. But they are too heavy for the little boat! Will he able to take anyone?

books.title: The Rainbow Cloud
books.summary: Born a twin that must be sacrificed, Mkabayi faces a bully and scary ghosts. Will the bond with her sister Mmama save her?

books.title: Don't Laugh, Ramgoru Calf
books.summary: The Ramgoru calves go to every extent possible to not laugh. Read on this poem to discover how!

books.title: Hair
books.summary: Explore how different people like to style their hair.

books.title: How the Tortoise Built Her House
books.summary: Tortoise wants a home to protect herself from the heat and the rain. How will the tortoise build it?

books.title: From Submarines to Sky Raiders - All about Dragonflies and Damselflies
books.summary: Dragonflies have been on the earth much before human beings appeared! Read this account of their incredible life cycle in Ranjit Lal's effervescent style. Sanjay Sarkar's expert brush comes up with illustrations to match!

books.title: Look Up!
books.summary: Look up! There’s so much to see.

books.title: The Pumpkin Chase
books.summary: Oh no, the naughty pumpkin pie thief is running away with Miss Sunflower’s pie! Will you help to catch the crook?

books.title: Sima and Siza
books.summary: Sima wants to be a nurse one day. His favourite game is hospital-hospital. But papa and his friends do not approve. What will change their minds?

books.title: Summertime Adventure
books.summary: It’s summer – come and play with us! Splashes, bubbles and camping adventures are a few of our favourite things.

books.title: Aku and her ice cream
books.summary: Aku is a greedy child who learns a bitter lesson.

books.title: Rain
books.summary: As rain clouds loom over the Khasi Hills, a rhyme echoes among the people. Rain rain come down in mighty torrents...they sing. They sing for the land, for the trees, and for the people.

books.title: Who Took My Shoe?
books.summary: Jabulani has lost his school shoe. He can’t find it anywhere. Where can it be?

books.title: Why Is the Anganwadi Empty?
books.summary: There are very few students attending the Balwadi. Rita who teaches at the Balwadi is worried. Will Seema and other parents be able to help Rita?

books.title: Alex's Super Medicine
books.summary: Alex needs a plan. He doesn’t like medicine, but he wants to feel better. What will he do with the bottle of green medicine?

books.title: The Changemaker Trio Save the River
categories: The Changemaker Trio Save the River
books.summary: Hali, Maya and Ken are back! They want to go for a swim in the river but a strong, disgusting smell welcomes them. What happens next?

books.title: Nature's Webmasters
books.summary: Nature is full of unexpected wonder. Read this fascinating account about the life of spiders in Ranjit Lal's inimitable style. Packed with information and interesting facts about nature's original webmaster, this book will weave a silken web over you!

books.title: Let's Dance with Ainam
books.summary: Ainam, a six-year old, is on a journey to learn the Khasi traditional dance—step by step, from her mother. Learn with Ainam, listen to the story of the dance, and get ready for the Shad Suk Mynsiem festival.

books.title: Market Days
books.summary: How many days are there in a week? For the people of the Jaiñtia Hills, there’s a twist - eight days instead of seven! Welcome to a land where time takes on a whole new rhythm!

books.title: Ledile's Red Balloon
books.summary: Ledile loves her red balloon. One day, the balloon floats across the river. How will she get her balloon back?

books.title: Drum
books.summary: A story about the uses of drums in Uganda among Jopadhola people.

books.title: What Am I?
books.summary: I am very important in your life. I am everywhere and you use me everyday. Can you guess what I am?

books.title: Miss Goat's House
books.summary: Summer has arrived and Miss Goat is feeling very hot. The day keeps getting hotter. Where will Miss Goat find shelter from the heat?

books.title: Wind
books.summary: Story about the power of wind.

books.title: Sumi Budhi and Sugi
books.summary: Every morning Sugi nudges Sumi Budhi awake at daybreak. They spend every waking moment together. Sugi is a goose and Sumi Budhi’s friend. This slice-of-life story looks at the relationships between humans and animals.

books.title: My Friends
books.summary: I have many friends. I like all of them but one of them is really special. Can you guess who?

books.title: A Home Made of Books
books.summary:
A house full of books is one that’s bursting with the magic of stories. Even when
away from home like Dadu, who is in the hospital, books become a reminder of
everything that’s familiar, of the friendship of beloved characters, and of the hope
that families share together.

books.title: The Humanitarian
books.summary: Lahpai Seng Raw never let anything stop her. Read about her amazing courage and ability to work with everyone to bring peace in Myanmar.

books.title: Damayanti the Detective
books.summary: There’s only one thing Damayanti likes more than snacking: being a detective. With her Trusty Never Dusty 3-in-1 Dabba by her side, Damayanti is on the case again. Where could Appa’s handkerchief, Paati’s hairpin and her left sock have gone?

books.title: Chik-chik Girl
books.summary: Mona loves to complain. Sometimes about the tasty khichdi her Amma cooks and sometimes about Dada’s long legs. Meet the chik-chik girl and her family.

books.title: Dudu's Hat
books.summary: Hats off! Dudu and Dumisani have made up a new game. Ssh! Don’t tell Teacher.

books.title: O Rain Come
books.summary:
It’s so hot! Lilato and Mayamiko are bored.
Ndo-ndo!
But what is that sound?

books.title: The Bull Comes Home
books.summary: A child carves a bull from a jackfruit leaf, starting a friendship that blooms like flowers in spring. They share laughter in the warm sun and dreams under the moonlight. As time goes by, the bull slowly fades away and becomes a distant memory. But, as with all things in nature, there’s always a homecoming.

books.title: Mali's Friend
books.summary: Mali likes to play alone. Gogo wants him to play with others. Mali tries, but he just does not enjoy himself. Until Lesedi comes along…

books.title: The Bees
books.summary: When two children poke a beehive, a swarm of bees flies out. Where is the best place to hide?

books.title: The Dordles Save Fuel (Book 2)
books.summary: Three stranded creatures try to save enough fuel to get home. The second in a series of three books about the adventures of The Dordles, who find themselves stuck in a world where resources are scarce.

books.title: Lory Dory
books.summary: Lory Dory was born invisible. No one understands that she is real. Until, one day, she finds a way to show them who she is.

books.title: Amara and Animals
books.summary: Amara loves animals. What happens when people come to visit?

books.title: Baba in a Sari
books.summary: One afternoon, Moli and Baba decide to have some fun. Out comes a heap of saris, dazzling in a riot of colours and patterns, for their fashion show.

books.title: The Green Lizard and the Gecko
books.summary: When a green lizard and a gecko become friends, they learn all about each other's lifestyles. Soon, the two reptiles decide to switch habitats. Will they survive in their new environments?

books.title: Spincy Spider
books.summary: Spincy Spider lived in the thorny bushes. He wanted to be famous. A nice yarn about Spincy and his friends and what it means to be famous.

books.title: Aaba
books.summary: Mama, Mami, Leela and Aaba come over to visit us. Aai makes something Aaba loves. Find out what it is!

books.title: Scatter the Rice Clouds
books.summary: The elders are in their rice fields. Meanwhile, siblings Iba and Bor embark on an adventure when their mischievous cat, Kemnai, leads them to a shed during an approaching storm. Find out what they discover amidst some mishaps and learn about the beauty of creating rice clouds.

books.title: Space Rules
books.summary: 3, 2, 1... Blast off into space, where there are planets to visit, stars to revisit, and some rules that are good to know. Rules that are universal, for space and for our home planet, Earth.

books.title: Lonwabo's Recipes
books.summary: Lonwabo loves helping grandmother grow vegetables to make delicious meals for the family. He dreams of opening a restaurant one day and cooking just like his granny.

books.title: How Ant saved Dove
books.summary: The land is dry and Little Ant is very thirsty. He goes to the river for a drink and is swept away.

books.title: Thoithoi Feels Shy
books.summary: Sometimes, Thoithoi feels shy, especially to raise her hand in class. Today she knows the answer to Ms Leima's question. What will happen next? A story about shyness, but also about friendship of different kinds.

books.title: Devil's scarf
books.summary: A couple promises a gift to the devil on the birth of their child. How will they get out it?

books.title: The Oranges of Daribok
books.summary: Join the fun-loving twins from Tura as they go on an exciting trip to Daribok to pick oranges! The family explores the colorful orchard, they smell the delicious scents, and learn how to enjoy this yummy fruit. Come along and discover the magical world of oranges!

books.title: A Balloon Ride
books.summary: How nice it would be to soar in the sky with a bunch of balloons. Little Yentanna takes off with his balloons. This fantastical poem takes a journey with a child and balloons to the moon.

books.title: Chupuk Chapaak
books.summary: Konkon’s walk to school has many sounds. Walk alongside Konkon, Oimili and their classmates to listen in.

books.title: Mom's Red Coat
books.summary: Mom needs to go away for work. I’ll miss her. Will it help if she leaves her red coat with me?

books.title: The Growing Up Book
books.summary: Dealing with the changes that come with puberty can be confusing and difficult. This engaging and informative book prepares preteens and teens for some of the most complex years of their lives.

books.title: No More No!
books.summary: Pitku and Mommy are always fighting. Pitku is fed up of his mother because she is always saying no. But is Mommy fed up of Pitku too? How will this fight end?

books.title: Mother Hen
books.summary: Mother Hen wants to throw a party for her newly-hatched chicks, but she needs help gathering supplies. Who will help Mother Hen?

books.title: The Rainbow Fish
books.summary:
All of us enjoy watching fish, especially bright and colourful ones, swimming around in tanks that we keep in
our homes. But do the fish enjoy it as much? Let’s listen in on the conversation Raju and the rainbow fish have in this book, and find out.

books.title: Goat, the false king
books.summary: Ever wondered why a goat refuses to move when pulled? Read the story of the Goat King to find out.

books.title: Elephant and the Spirit
books.summary: Who is stronger? Elephant or spirit?

books.title: Row, Row, Row your Boat
books.summary: Visiting Ajja and Ajji in the village is always exciting for Raju, but this time, his grandparents have a special surprise for him. One evening, when they are taking their usual walk along the river, Ajja suggests a boat ride. Why don't you join them?

books.title: What Did You Learn about Your Friends?
categories: What Did You Learn about Your Friends?
books.summary: In art class, Asma madam divides the class into small groups. Rohan, Anku, Sunil, and Ritu work as a group. They find out new things about themselves and their friends. How do you know yourself better because of your friends?

books.title: Happy Hands
books.summary: Larnai black pottery is one of the oldest forms of pottery from the Jaiñtia Hills. When a group of children learn about it in their art class, they learn how happy hands make beautiful art.

books.title: Hamisi's Lucky Day
books.summary: Hamisi goes to buy his uniform and spots a shirt he wants. His father says he doesn't have the money for it. What will happen to Hamisi's wish?

books.title: Neelu and the Phenomenal Printer
books.summary: Neelu loves animals. When he sees an injured horse on the streets of Kolkata, he wants to help the animal. Neelu is introduced to the world of 3D printing where whatever you think of can be printed. Cups, plates, pencils and, in the future, even hooves for a horse! Can technology help injured animals live a better life?

books.title: The Man on the Seat of Justice
categories: The Man on the Seat of Justice
books.summary: Algu Chowdhry and Jumman Sheikh are different from each other in every way one can imagine. Yet both of them are best friends, helping out each other in every way they can. But their friendship is suddenly threatened by a situation neither thought they would find themselves in. Algu is chosen to deliver justice in a panchayat where Jumman is the wrong-doer. Will Algu forego the truth to save his friend? Or will his duty towards justice destroy their friendship?

books.title: What Was That?
books.summary: The jungle is filled with sounds of swaying trees, birds and animals, and insects. But in the dark, these sounds gets magnified. No wonder, Hiren is a little scared when walking back to his camp. What was that noise he heard? Listen carefully and find out for yourself.

books.title: Thipthida Goes to School
books.summary: One day, Thipthida's mother tells her that she will get a surprise for her hard work at school. What could it be?

books.title: Three boxes of wealth
books.summary: A father leaves each of his sons an inheritance that best suits his talents.

books.title: Our Wonderful World
books.summary: God created all kinds of animals and birds. Then he created man who was to be the keeper of the earth. The animals and birds protested. So what did God say? Find out in Our Wonderful World.

books.title: A Curse or a Blessing?
books.summary: What happens when it rains on a dry land after a really long period?

books.title: Selemeng's cats
books.summary: A tale of Selemeng and his cats!

books.title: Snail Speeds Up!
books.summary: The stone snail doesn't want to miss his cousin's birthday party. But, he is so slow! Do you think he can make it in time?

books.title: In the Light of the Rising Sun
books.summary: This is a story about a little girl on her very first day of school. On the morning of her first day, she is happy and excited. Will she remember everything she needs to get ready for school?

books.title: The King of Mkolokolo
books.summary: The King of Mkolokolo offers his crown to anyone who can capture the snake that is tormenting his village. Mighty villagers from across the land take on the challenge. But what happens when a small girl asks for her turn?

books.title: How Tortoise's nose became crooked
books.summary: This story has a strong moral for us that is good advice!

books.title: Cassava and Palm
books.summary: Cassava and Palm argue on who's better!

books.title: The Biggest Pumpkin
books.summary: Musuku harvested a good crop from her fields. She put it in her open barn, and asked Cat to guard it. What will Cat do when a thief arrives?

books.title: Catch that cat!
books.summary: Oh no! A sneaky cat has stolen my sock. Come with me and my dog to help us catch that cat!

books.title: Kham's Precious Little Lamp
books.summary: Kham owns a lamp. At night, it helps Kham around the house. But with the arrival of electricity in Kham’s village, will the lamp be forgotten?

books.title: We All Must Compromise
books.summary: Creature Cafe and People Parlour exist harmoniously till there is a water shortage. People Parlour has been using up all the water! What happens next?

books.title: Let's Go to Gram Sabha
books.summary: The children attend the Gram Sabha and find out the problems of the villagers. The Sarpanch manages to solve the problem with his team of Panchs and villagers.

books.title: Sara's Canoe
books.summary: What happens when Sara tries to accommodate everyone in her canoe?

books.title: My First Pair of Shoes
books.summary: Do you remember your first pair of shoes? Read this story of a young girl who is excited about her shoes.

books.title: This Is How I Draw
books.summary: How many momos make one illustrator? How do you become a fly on the wall? Can you count a galaxy of thoughts? How is this all related to drawing a picture book? Curious? Some of India’s favourite illustrators reveal how they draw books, just for you. Are you ready?

books.title: Red Rice
books.summary: Over a pot of red rice, Bei and Dap unfold the many secrets behind red rice. Join them on this heartwarming tale as a secret of the red rice helps Dap bond with his village.

books.title: Little Tara's Big Fire
books.summary: Stories light up a fire inside Tara. But not everyone likes her stories. The fire inside her slowly dims. Will she find her fire again?

books.title: Kimbe in Balpakram
books.summary: ‘Kimbe in Balpakram’ is a tale woven from the threads of Garo lore, whispered around crackling fires in homes in the warm glow of the hearth's light. Kimbe, a wisp of a spirit newly arrived in the mystical Balpakram, embarks on a captivating journey. Along the way, she encounters familiar characters and names from her grandmother’s stories, like the mysterious Matchu Boldak Karam, the enigmatic Chidimmak, and the unknown Dal·gipa Nalsa.

books.title: Baboon chief
books.summary: What happens when you mindlessly follow someone? Find out!

books.title: The Crown
books.summary: A young boy sees that many beautiful birds have a crown. What will he do to get his own?

books.title: The Root Bridge
books.summary: The living root bridges of Meghalaya take decades to build. This is the story of a small root who aspires to be a part of one of Meghalaya's mighty root bridges.

books.title: A Day at the Museum
books.summary: Nalini is excited about going to the museum for the first time and exploring it with her friends. There are so many wonderful things to see! Read this book to find out what Nalini takes back for her little brother Ved, after a day at the museum.

books.title: Clever Jackal and foolish Crow
books.summary: How does the hungry jackal get the cheese from the crow?

books.title: Mai Jingjing
books.summary: A group of children gather amidst the bamboo groves to sing the age old song centered around cicadas. Mai jingjing...mai jingjing..ambi mikki echoes throughout the groves.

books.title: The Stone Giants
books.summary: The stone giants have always stood tall and mysterious in Eilad’s neighborhood. One day, the curious boy decides to unravel their mystery with the help of his mother. Through the tale, he goes on a  journey filled with interesting characters and discovers the hidden secrets about the stones.

books.title: Look Again!
books.summary: When Putti and Akka are coming back from the park, Putti sees a dog with ponytails! She also sees a scary monster! Look into this book to see if you can see what she saw. And if you can’t see what the sisters can see, look again at the pictures!

books.title: My Home
books.summary: Welcome to my Home!

books.title: Mr. Maseleni
books.summary: The Mwese people were good farmers and lived a happy life. They grew all types of grains and nuts. The animals were also happy becuase there was always plenty of food. But one year there was very little rain and the crops were scarce. So the animals began eating whatever food they could find in the village. The villagers did not like this and started to chase them away. What do you think they will do to get out of this problem?

books.title: The Story of Help Us Green
categories: The Story of Help Us Green
books.summary: Ankit Aggarwal and Bholu from Aaj Ka Jungle talk about Ankit's company 'Help us Green'. What does it do? Find out in this interesting interview.

books.title: My Big Sister Can See Dragons
categories: My Big Sister can see Dragons
books.summary: Everybody has an older sister or brother who can do things they can't. But one girl has an older sister with a very special ability indeed!

books.title: What's Next?
books.summary: Once the school bell rings, the excitement begins. Grandpa picks Fatima up from school. What adventures will they have?

books.title: Rocket's Day out
books.summary: Launchpad Mihir does not want  Rocket Lila to go off into space.  What if the sky swallows Lila, or the sea?  But Rocket Lila is not worried at all!

books.title: Clever brother
books.summary: Jealousy and Stupidity can be fatal combination!

books.title: The Rabbit under the Tree
books.summary: While the rabbit is sleeping, an apple falls from the tree and the next thing he hears is 'Run, rabbit. Run.' And the pandemonium begins.

books.title: The Koel’s Song
books.summary: Why don’t we ever hear the koel’s sweet song in our cities anymore? City kid Raju finds out the answers to this and many other questions when he chats with a koel on his grandfather’s farm.

books.title: Creature With Two
books.summary: The Izinzawu family encounters a strange creature. How will they react?

books.title: Kabaddi Kabaddi
books.summary: Join team yellow and team pink for an exciting kabaddi match.

books.title: Nokpante
books.summary: Goddess Minima builds a Nokpante for her grandsons and decides to host a housewarming celebration. Seeking a brave human to join her and the other mites, they invite young Noro. Noro becomes the first human to witness and learn about the Nokpante.

books.title: Annoying Mosquito
books.summary: Who is disturbing me just as I'm about to fall asleep?

books.title: So Many Guests
books.summary: One guest…Two guests…Six guests…What is special today in Ovi’s home?

books.title: We Have Grown so Much!
books.summary: Anku, Harsh, and Rohan learn from their mistakes. They get better at their hobbies and talents and grow a lot with support of their friends and family.

books.title: The New Play Area
books.summary: A marshland has formed right in the middle of the slum. What's use and what's abuse? Find out what the newly elected representative had to say about it.

books.title: The Cat and the Fiddle
books.summary: Bobby's left back home as his parents go to town to sell some butter and eggs and bring back groceries in exchange for them. Bobby has his fiddle that he loves to play on, the tabby-cat, the yellow dog and the moolie-cow as his companions. What happens next?

books.title: The Guardians of Bodha
books.summary: There is some bad news – all the villages around Bodha are flooded. But Bodha is safe and sound! What saved this village from disaster? Who are the Guardians of Bodha? A wise man, Gautham, shares the secret in this story.

books.title: Akai's Special Mat
books.summary: Akai has a special mat given to her by her aunt. One day she gets lost. What happens next?

books.title: Berhe and the snake
books.summary: How does the fox get Berhe out of a problem?

books.title: Our Aspirations
books.summary: In the village of Lakshpur children learn about their dreams through the experiences of an old Peepal tree.

books.title: What Can Rohan Do?
books.summary: Rohan is in grade seven. He finds Maths very difficult. He is very sad. His friend and brother help Rohan see the many other things that he can do.

books.title: Missing a Friend
books.summary: Yangjee goes to visit her aunt in the village for a few days, but she forgot to tell her best friend that she would be gone. How will Lucky react when Yangjee returns home?

books.title: Aalepak for Tatya
books.summary: Chingi loves it when Shakil Tatya visits. This time around, they share a meal and shop at the local market, where Chingi finds a little gift for her uncle.

books.title: How Do I Feel
books.summary: Ankita prepares for her history exam with her friend Ritu. During the exam something happens  that makes Anku feel sad.What are the other things Anku feels during the day?

books.title: Maguru Gives Legs
books.summary: Why does the millipede have so many legs when the snake has none?

books.title: Sindiwe and the Fireflies
books.summary: There once was a girl named Sindiwe Magona. She had a special gift for stories. At night, little Sindiwe’s grandmother told her magical stories about ogres and giants, animals of the forests and the little creatures of the veld. This was Sindiwe’s favourite time. See how she grows up to live out her own adventures and she travels over oceans to change the world with her stories.

books.title: That's not Thabi! That's a hippopotamus!
categories: That’s not Thabi!  That’s a hippopotamus!
books.summary: Lucy can’t find her sister Thabi. But everywhere she looks there’s a suspicious hippopotamus. Does the hippo know where Thabi is?

books.title: Little Dams
books.summary: In a large forest, in a faraway land, there were many lakes, ponds and streams. The animals had a lot of water for use. What happened when they did not use water fairly?

books.title: Cilandikonda - I Enjoy
books.summary: What does our protagonist enjoy doing? She lists them for you!

books.title: Lebo and Gogo's Tea Party
books.summary: Lebo is excited to have a day of adventure with Gogo. When Gogo hurts herself, she can’t do anything that Lebo wants to do. What can Gogo and Lebo do to have fun together?

books.title: A Moon Full of Ants
books.summary: A lake with seven shoes, a bowlful of autumn, and a set of teeth that’s home to a unicorn. What a delightful, topsy-turvy world to live in. Here’s your invitation.

books.title: The Flyaway Cradle
books.summary: What do you do with a cradle that flies? Join this bunch of clever children and find out!

books.title: Meeting for the First Time
books.summary: When Yangjee moves to a new home, she meets a quiet girl, Lucky. Can they become friends?

books.title: Abel and his sister's doll
books.summary: A sweet tale of siblings fighting and making up.

books.title: Chicken and Millipede
books.summary: An adorable tale on why chicken and millipedes are enemies.

books.title: The Eating-Joint
books.summary: Rohan decides to get to the root of the cost issues that his father's eating- joint has been facing for long. He realises the importance of not wasting water. What ideas does he come up with to help save the joint?

books.title: How Night Came to Opio's Village
categories: How Night Came to Opio's Village
books.summary: There is no night time in Opio's village. One day he goes hunting and arrives at a place he doesn't know. When night falls there, Opio becomes becomes confused and afraid. Then he discovers the truth and likes night so much that he takes it to his own village.

books.title: Children of Wax
books.summary: What will happen to the children if they are made of wax?

books.title: Where is Bhuri Bakri?
books.summary: Chutki's goats run away in the forest. Her friends come together to help Chutki find the missing goat.

books.title: Mama Antelope's House
books.summary: Someone is in Mama Antelope’s House. Who could it be? All the animals try to open the door but only Baby Antelope knows how.

books.title: Snooze
books.summary: Shhhh, the world’s gone to sleep. Tuck in for a bedtime story.

books.title: Sindi and the Moon
books.summary: Sindi buzzes with colourful songs and dance. Will starting school end all that?

books.title: Ramuramu, the Goat
books.summary: Ramuramu the goat escapes from the farm only to find out that the safest and friendliest place is home.

books.title: Greedy Kiundu
books.summary: Kiundu is a greedy, selfish man. How will he make the best of the two parties going on in the village?

books.title: Elders!
books.summary: When the elders are greedy for the food at home, how will the children react?

books.title: My Special Blankie
books.summary: Lerato’s world is made extra special by Mama and a colourful blankie. What is your special thing?

books.title: Refiloe and the Washed Chickens
books.summary: Refiloe's sister is getting married. Refiloe's chickens are very dirty and she decides to wash them for the wedding. The chickens do not like being washed. Refiloe cannot find her chickens when it is time for the wedding, and everyone is in for a big surprise.

books.title: The Best Nest
books.summary: Two birds go on a quest to find the best nest ever.

books.title: Palesa Can Walk!
books.summary: One-year-old Palesa spends the night before her birthday wide-eyed with excitement. She can’t wait to find out what each of her friends will bring her. But what will be the biggest surprise of all?

books.title: Douangkeo Wants to Be a Magician
books.summary: Douangkeo wants to be a magician! She practices magic tricks and performs for her dog. Can you guess what Douangkeo needs to wear to look like a magician?

books.title: Aku, the Sun Maker
books.summary: A dejected girl finds an unlikely friend, bringing joy to the village.

books.title: Garo Garments
books.summary: Let us explore some Garo Garments from Meghalaya through this book which is part of The Garment Series.

books.title: Maddy Moona's Menagerie!
books.summary: It’s Maddy Moona’s birthday and she really wants a pet! But which silly animal will picky Maddy get?

books.title: Jaiñtia Garments
books.summary: Let us explore some Jaiñtia  Garments from Meghalaya, through this book which is part of The Garment Series.

books.title: Peace for Grumble Wings
books.summary: This is a story about a little moth called Grumble Wings who loved to grumble. The more he grumbled, the more unhappy he became. One day the wind decides to help Grumble Wings find a solution for his grumbling by introducing him to Eri, a silkworm. Will Grumble Wings find his peace?

books.title: Bhujar
books.summary: Rini and her new pet dog Bhujar are best friends-they play together every day. One day, when Rini is walking home from school, a kidnapper tries to force Rini into his car. Can Bhujar help her now?

books.title: The Box
books.summary: Dad comes home with a box. Boring. Until Max and Andi’s friends come to play… What will they do with the box?

books.title: Melody March
books.summary:
Get ready for a musical ride where instruments come alive with each note! As the Melody Maiden takes the lead, all the instruments join the show. With notes from the Illep and powerful beats from the Dama, see how they make every day sunnier. 
Jump in, feel the rhythm, and enjoy the melody march!

books.title: Baby Mongoose Goes Looking For a Frog

books.title: Rain, Rain

books.title: The Changemaker Trio Help Cut Paani
categories: The Changemaker Trio Help Cut Paani
books.summary: Hali, Kenn and Maya decide to go for lunch where they come across a concept called 'Cutting Paani'. What does it mean?

books.title: Akadeli's Lucky day
books.summary: At what point does your day filled with a series of misadventures get better? Does it at all?

books.title: Crocodile and Dog
books.summary: Dog finds some eggs on the river shore, and takes them home. What will mother crocodile say when she finds out?

books.title: Ostrich and Lioness
books.summary: Will you friend take your children away? Ostrich is in for a shock!

books.title: The Akkad Bakkad Cricket Song
books.summary: It’s Sunday. It’s a fun day. Mummy and her friends have come together for a thrilling game of cricket.

books.title: Yellow
books.summary: Linlin wonders why her Bei’s hands are yellow. She tails her mother to find out the answer, when she suddenly encounters Ma Lakadong, a magical turmeric! Does Linlin find the answer? Come join her adventure!

books.title: Magozwe Finds a Home
books.summary: A boy from the streets finds a home.

books.title: Joanna's Grannies
books.summary: Joanna has two grannies. They are very different but they both love her the same.

books.title: Look out, Luthando!
books.summary: Luthando is very good at listening and very good at smelling, but he’s not so good at looking where he is going. He walks into puddles and bumps his head. What could be the problem?

books.title: Akoro's Banana Business
books.summary:
Akoro's garden yields amazing bananas. 
Will he be able sell them and make a business out of it? Find out!

books.title: Ruby Red, Rosy Red
books.summary:
Raju is a city kid who gets most of his fruit out of juice cartons and jam bottles. One day, he gets a chance to visit his grandfather's orchard, where all the trees are full of fruit.
Join him on his exciting journey of discovery inside this book!

books.title: Nang.pa Bachi
books.summary: Two groups of lively children play a sing-song game. With silly questions and playful tunes, they create a world of laughter and imagination. The fun never ends as they wonder, "Who will be the next pot-bellied little sister?"

books.title: How Do You Sleep?
books.summary: Can you sleep with one eye open? Can you sleep in a tree? Pula has a bed, but he wants to know how other creatures sleep.

books.title: Pia Goes to Chandni Chowk
books.summary: Nini’s favourite memories of growing up in Chandni Chowk are those of delicious creamy and fluffy mithai. But Nini can’t go all the way to the old city any more. So Pia brings Chandni Chowk home!

books.title: How Do Actions Change Me?
books.summary: Rohan cooks yummy rajma chawal but Veer makes fun of him. Anku tries a new hairstyle on Soni but she faces some challenges. Who helps you when you're confused and worried?

books.title: There You Are! - A Spotting Book
categories: There You Are! - A Spotting Book
books.summary:
Madhu is off to the library. Can you spot her
as she travels across the city? Bonus points
for finding her friends as well.

books.title: Goat and Hyena's knife
books.summary: Goat borrowed Hyena's knife and lost it? How do their fates look?

books.title: Matthew is up!
books.summary: Matthew wakes up with the sun. But he is the only one!

books.title: सोंश्याचे लांब कान

books.title: Nozibele and the three hairs
books.summary: Three girls gathering wood decide to freshen up by the river. One of them forgets her beads. What adventure awaits her when she goes back to pick up the beads?

books.title: Jhōr Khlō
books.summary: Come! Let us learn about the different types of wild plants that are found in the Jaiñtia Hills!

books.title: Karabo's Question
books.summary: Little Karabo watches all the grown-ups in her family, and wonders, ‘What do I do? What do I know?’

books.title: Cutting Paani and the Crown
books.summary: Simba is up for the crown. On the way to the council, the fact that resources are limited, strikes him. He unveils his plan #CuttingPaani

books.title: Owen, the Wise
books.summary: Everyone knows books keep ignorts at bay. Off goes Owen, on a literary journey to vanquish ignorance.

books.title: My Family and I
books.summary: A story about a little boy's adventures with an unusual family!

books.title: Nilu and Zubeida
books.summary: It’s the last day of the mela. Nilu and Zubeida had plans to feast on jalebis, imarti and popcorn. But Nilu is nowhere to be seen. Did she really leave Zubi without saying goodbye?

books.summary: One fine Spring day, the flow of water from the handpump at the old lady's mansion was less and eventually, by Summer, the pump ran dry. What had happened?

books.summary: Urma and Urgen are playing outside when it starts to rain. They come up with a new, messy game. What happens when their parents come home?

books.title: This Land Is My School: Dadaji Khobragade, the Rice Man of India
categories: This Land Is My School: Dadaji Khobragade the Rice Man of India
books.summary: When Dadaji Khobragade was a young boy, he heard Babasaheb Ambedkar give his call to action. The land became Dadaji’s school, teaching him patience, compassion and love. But above all, inspiring him to innovate and dream big.

books.title: It's Going to Rain!
books.summary: 3, 2, 1… A countdown to rain!

books.title: When Things Go Round and Round
books.summary: Chintu is fascinated by everything that goes round and round, kind of like the Earth. Take a round of this book along with Chintu and his friends.

books.title: A Khasi Kitchen
books.summary: Let us explore a Khasi kitchen from Meghalaya through this book which is part of The Kitchen Series.

books.title: The Pangolin Protectors
books.summary: In the forests of Central India, pangolin poachers have been arrested. Forest officials and the Wildlife Conservation Trust team (including conservation dogs) get together to lead the pangolin to the perfect home.

books.title: The Sausage Dog
books.summary: Thembsie really wants a dog, but she can’t have one. So Thembsie comes up with a plan of her own.

books.title: Sun Mother
books.summary: In the winter, sisters Dolmo and Palmo and all the animals are cold. Will Sun Mother hear their pleas for help?

books.title: Zibu and Zizo
books.summary: Zibu and Zizo are twin brothers. They are similar, but different. Being different is not bad, it’s great.

books.title: When Things Go Round and Round
categories: When Things Go Round and Round
books.summary: Chintu is fascinated by everything that goes round and round, kind of like the Earth. Take a round of this book along with Chintu and his friends.

books.title: An Orphan
books.summary: Afeefah is a baby rhino whose mother was killed by poachers. Read the story and find out more about her experiences.

books.title: A Garo Kitchen
books.summary: Let us explore a Garo kitchen from Meghalaya through this book which is part of The Kitchen Series.

books.title: Lost in Ultapani
categories: Holtugaon Forest Division of Manas Biosphere reserve
books.summary: In a state of being lost, an unexpected friendship leads the way through the darkness. Explore the rich flora and fauna of Ultapani forest as baby elephant finds his way back to his family.

books.title: A Jaiñtia Kitchen
books.summary: Let us explore a Jaiñtia kitchen from Meghalaya through this book which is part of The Kitchen Series.

Bulbuls, betel nuts, and a young boy daydreaming.
A fifty-year-old mighty betel nut tree writes a short poem about her friends in Shnongpdeng, Meghalaya.

books.summary: Bahati is looking for something everywhere. But she can't remember what she's looking for!

books.summary: In the morning, when everyone in the house was busy, a fly decided to get busy too. She buzzed into the courtyard and … uh oh! What a muddle!

books.title: Ira's Monsoon Feast
books.summary: It’s time for a feast! Pull on your raincoats, grab your umbrellas and join Ira and her family as they go on a foraging and harvesting walk.

books.title: Piku and His Magical Pishi
books.summary: Is Piku’s Pishi made up of magic? After all, Pishi can turn into different people. Piku discovers the world of theatre and finds himself making a few friends too!

books.title: Bumbb: The Magical Cylinder
books.summary:
Amita and Ninad are curious. Their neighbour Vilas doesn’t visit the forest to collect firewood as often as he used to. And his wife Varsha doesn’t spend all her time in front of the chulha to heat water. Their children say that a magical
cylinder gives the neighbours hot water in no time. Could it be true?

books.title: Fifi and Teddy
books.summary: Fifi has a brown teddy bear that she loves very much. But where is Teddy?

books.summary: In the village of Uttarey, little Dolma patiently awaits the arrival of snowfall so that she can enjoy the delicious snow ice-cream. Does she get to taste the winter treat? Read this little poem to find out.

books.summary:
When fluffy clouds make different shapes in the sky, children gather to sing a merry song. What do you sing when you see shapes in the clouds? 
Apjon! Apjon!

books.title: Keep It Up, Number 6!

books.summary: Bulbuli and Maina are a little scared of Number 6. What with the rooster’s magnificent ability to chase  every single being on the farm, his awe-inspiring looks and loud clucks. But the siblings discover that even  the most fearsome of creatures can surprise us!

categories: conservation of cultural and natural site
books.summary: A fierce battle seems imminent as Tumurak, the towering hill by the edge of Pumlen Lake, mocks Nungpak Thabi, the smaller hill. Who do you think will win? Read more to find out.

books.title: Where Is Goggayya?
books.summary: Amma, Ajja and Atte always call Goggayya when Putti is up to some mischief. But what does Goggayya look like? Where does Goggayya hide? Putti wants to know.

books.title: Space Sambar
books.summary:
How did the dragon breathe fire? Maybe it had something to do with a very spicy sambar on 
a very hot planet?

books.title: Yapom

A lonely Yapom lives high up on a tree. One day, she meets a little boy. Their time together unfolds the journey of the yapom and her
longing for companionship and friendship.

He cannot dance as well as her. What if he is an embarrassment? What if this joyous occasion is not joyous at all? Join little Passang as he navigates his way through the anxiety and excitement.

books.title: Trring Trring
books.summary: Two friends, a string phone, and an important call. Dial in.

books.title: Langpang Boy
books.summary: The story is an imaginative creation of the author based on the belief of the Tangkhul Naga tribe of Manipur that Langpang is a gift from God for humankind to live and thrive together.

books.summary:
Lungdai is frustrated! The hornbill bird keeps taking away all the fruits from his Pipi’s garden. They belong to his Pipi!
In his quest to chase away the bird, Lungdai learns an important lesson about love, devotion, and what it means to live in a community.

books.title: Charcoal
books.summary: With their parents away in the fields and left in charge of their napping Asu, Khumtsa and Xuivi have a mischievous idea in mind.

books.title: Nelson the Magician
books.summary:
It is time for Nelson’s first ever magic show.
Ajji Majji La Tarajji, what kind of magician
is he going to be?

books.title: The Little Prince
books.summary: Stranded in a desert, a pilot meets a stranger. The little prince is a visitor from another planet, and is full of questions and adventures. This internationally renowned classic tells a story of friendship and courage.

books.title: The Fabrics of Our Identity
books.summary: A journey through North-east India showcased by traditional garments worn by men and women from the region.

books.title: Sorted!: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle

books.title: The Fishing Trip
books.summary:
When Thoni wanted to eat her mother’s special fish curry, she and her friends decided to go on a fishing adventure. But once they reach
the river, there were no fish! With things going against their plan, help comes from an unexpected source. Will Thoni and her friends be
able to enjoy the fish curry? Read this story to find out.

Delighted by her interest, Haokha Nongkha gives his daughter a gourd of honey to share with her friends on their journey. However, he forgets to tell Wangdengnu a small detail... that the gourd was magical.

books.title: Khuavang
books.summary: Dari’s day at her school takes an eerie turn when a strange silence falls over the classroom, causing everyone to freeze.

books.title: The Heart of our Home

books.title: We brought the river home
books.summary: It has been a harsh summer. Geetu misses the sound of water. The hand pumps, the well and the pond are dry. The women in the village have to walk a long way to bring water for their families. Can they find a way for the river to come back home?

books.title: Axone

books.title: Nana and I

books.summary: Once upon a time, a village was lush with trees and full of animals and birds. Then, something changed. The rains and the animals stopped visiting. Read to find out how the rain clouds returned.

books.title: Nyeke Monyu

books.title: Sweet Dreams

books.title: स्कूल का पहला दिन

books.title: दीदी का रंग बिरंगा खज़ाना
books.summary: कचरे के ढ़ेर से घिरे हुए बच्चे मौज मस्ती कैसे करें? लेकिन एक दिन कहीं से दीदी आईं और बच्चों के जीवन में रंग लाई।किताबें जो उनकी दोस्त हो गईं।

books.title: आलू-मालू-कालू

एक दिन मालू को बगीचे में से आलू लाने थे। 
उसकी मदद किसने करी? कालू ने! 
पढ़िये मालू और कालू की आलू वाली कहानी!

श्रींगेरी श्रीनिवास के खेतों में बढ़िया मीठे केले उगते थे। 
पर कोई भी उन्हें खाना नहीं चाहता था। 
इस मीठी कहानी को पढ़ कर पता लगाइये कि श्रींगेरी ने केलों का क्या किया।

books.title: टक टक

books.title: मेरा घर
books.summary: मेरे घर ज़रूर आना!

books.title: आम का पेड़
books.summary: इस नन्ही लड़की को बड़े से आम के पेड़ पर छुपने में बहुत आनंद आता है।  ज़रा सोचिये कि उसे आख़िर में कौन ढूँढ़ लाता है?

books.title: लापता पानी का मामला
categories: The Case of the Missing Water
books.summary: जब रंज के गाँव का तालाब सूख जाता है वह लापता पानी को ढूँढ़ने के मिशन पर निकल पड़ती है। आईये जासूस रंज के साथ मिलकर इस लापता पानी के मामले को सुलझाते हैं।

books.title: भीमा गधा
books.summary: भीमा की एक समस्या है। सुबह-सुबह उसकी नींद नहीं खुलती। एक नन्ही दोस्त उसकी मदद करती है। क्या आप जानना चाहेंगे कि भीमा की नींद कैसे खुली?

books.title: कबाड़ी वाला
books.summary: चीनू को अपने पिताजी का हाथ बँटाना अच्छा लगता है। वे कबाड़ी वाले का काम करते हैं और उन्हें बहुत किस्म का सामान मिलता है। कभी-कभी यह चीनू के बहुत काम आता है।

books.title: गुल्ली का ग़ज़ब पिटारा
books.summary: गुल्ली के पास है एक ग़ज़ब का बक्सा, जिसमें से निकल कर आती हैं, तरह-तरह की चीज़ें। पर गुल्ली इन सब चीज़ों का क्या करता है? चलो, पता लगाएँ! और फिर शायद तुम भी बनाना चाहो अपना ऐसा ही ख़ास बक्सा।

books.title: रोटी गई, रोटी आई
books.summary: पढ़िए भौंकू की रोटी का मज़ेदार सफ़रनामा!

books.title: छुट्टी
books.summary: छुट्टियाँ तो अनमोल होती हैं ! ऐसी ही कभी न थमने वाली छुट्टियों की मज़ेदार दास्तान एक अनोखी कविता के रूप में।

books.title: चूहा सिकंदर, घर के अंदर
books.summary: एक चूहा घर में दाखिल होता है। फिर वहाँ अफरातफरी मच जाती है। पेश है बच्चों के लिए जोश से भरी यह कहानी।

books.title: लाल बरसाती
books.summary: मनु के पास नई बरसाती है। वह उसे पहनने के लिए मचल रहा है, लेकिन बारिश है कि आती ही नहीं है!

books.title: लालची चूहे जी
books.summary: लालच बुरी बला है पर यह चूहे जी को कौन समझाए?

books.title: अम्मा घर कब लौटेगी?
books.summary: रोजा की माँ सुबह सवेरे काम पर चली जाती है। वो वादा करती है कि रात को सोने के समय तक आ जाएगी। रोजा पूरे दिन अम्मा के बिना क्या करेगी?

books.title: एक किताब पुचकू के लिए
books.summary: पुचकू सारी किताबें पढ़ चुकी है, इसलिए अब उसके पास पढ़ने के लिए कोई किताब नहीं बची है। तभी उसे पुस्तकालय की अलमारी के ऊपर के खाने में और बहुत सी किताबें नज़र आती हैं। मगर पुचकू है छोटी और अलमारी है ऊँची। वह उन प्यारी किताबों तक पहुँचेगी कैसे?

books.title: नन्हे मददगार
books.summary: घर को रंगना है बेहद मज़ेदार! पर फाटक को कौन-सा रंग दें?

books.title: वह हँस दिया
books.summary: क्‍या आपको दौड़ लगाने में मज़ा आता है? हमारी कहानी के हिरण को भी यह बहुत भाता है।

books.title: उड़ने वाला ऑटो
books.summary: दिल्ली की सड़कों की भीड़-भाड़ में फँसे हुए एक ऑटोरिक्शा को एक दिन कुछ अनोखा अनुभव हुआ। उसी ऑटो के चालक और सवारी के साथ सैर कीजिए और जादू का मज़ा लीजिए।

books.title: गोनू झा की भैंस
books.summary: भरे दरबार में गोनू झा ने ऐसा क्या बोला की सभी दरबारी और मिथिला नरेश को गुस्सा आ गया?

books.title: बंटी और बबली
books.summary: बंटी को साबुन बिलकुल भी नहीं भाता। इसलिए, वह नहाना नहीं चाहती। एक रात उसने एक सपना देखा। उसके बाद क्या हुआ?

books.title: मंच का डर
books.summary: चंपा को गाना अच्छा लगता है। लेकिन वह मंच पर गाने से घबराती है। क्या वह अपने स्कूल के वार्षिकोत्सव में इतने सारे लोगों के सामने गाना गा पाएगी?

books.title: हर दिन  एक कहानी
books.summary: सोने से पहले कहानियाँ सुनना किसे अच्छा नहीं लगता | आईये सुनें एक और नन्ही कहानी |

books.title: रंग
books.summary: सफेद भालू को रंग बेहद पसंद हैं, हर बार उसे एक नया रंग अच्छा लगने लगाता है। चलो, भालू के साथ-साथ रंगों की इंद्रधनुशी दुनिया को जानें।

books.title: जंगल का स्कूल
books.summary: जंगल में स्कूल खुलते ही सभी जानवर बड़े उत्साह से वहाँ जाते हैं। आगे क्या हुआ जानने के लिए पढ़िए जंगल का स्कूल।

books.title: कहानियों का शहर
books.summary: एक नन्ही लड़की और दीदी के शहर में कहानियों की बाढ़ आ गई। उनका शहर ‘कहानियों का शहर’ कैसे बना? यह भी एक कहानी है...

books.title: मैना ने सूरज को कैसे खाया?
categories: How the Myna Ate the Sun
Maina ne Sooraj ko Kaise Khaaya
books.summary: एक भूखी मैना अपने प्रिय भोजन सूरज को खाना चाहती है! लेकिन सूरज को भला कैसे खाया जा सकता है? चलिए, इस सुन्दर सी किताब में इस सवाल का जवाब ढूँढ़ते हैं और जानते हैं खाद्य-श्रृंखलाओं के बारे में।

books.title: नीमा आज क्या खा रही है?
categories: Neema Aaj Kya Khaa Rahi hai?
books.summary: यह है नीमा जिसे खाना बहुत ही पसंद है। रसीली लीची, मोटे-मोटे जामुन, खट्टी इमली, सुंदर हरी पालक – सब कुछ इसे पसंद है। आईये नीमा के साथ मिल कर हम भी पूरे साल कुछ न कुछ खाते रहें... चबाते रहें!

books.title: चुन्नु-मुन्नु का नहाना
categories: Bath time for Chunnu and Munnu
books.summary:
पानी, साबुन के बुलबुले और उछल-कूद। 
देखिए तो चुन्नू मुन्नू कैसे मज़े ले रहे हैं !

books.title: मुझे खोज कर दिखाओ!
books.summary: मिया दुनिया में सबसे बढ़िया आँखमिचौली खेलती है। क्या आप उसे ढूँढ़ सकते हैं? आँखमिचौली की एक किताब, जहाँ आपको मिया और उसकी माँ की खरीददारी की सूची में लिखे सामान को ढूँढ़ना है।

books.title: बारिश में क्या गाएँ?
books.summary: सुखिया काका का गाना इतना सुरीला है कि किसी का भी मन मोह ले। फिर दीनू तो हमेशा से ही गाने का शौक़ीन था।दोनों की जोड़ी ख़ूब जमी!

books.title: सैर सपाटा
books.summary:
पाँच दोस्त जब सैर सपाटा करने जाते हैं तो बड़ा मज़ा आता है।
और नए चटपटे खाने के तो क्या कहने!

books.title: मेरे दोस्त
books.summary: मेरे बहुत से दोस्त हैं। मुझे वे सभी अच्छे लगते हैं पर उन में से एक सबसे प्यारा है!

books.title: क्या देखती है अनु?
books.summary: अनु ने क्या देखा? उसने अपने आसपास बहुत-सी प्यारी चीज़ों को देखा। क्या आप उनको देख सकते हैं?

books.title: और चीकू भी
books.summary: चीकू आज बहुत व्यस्त है। आइए उसके साथ मिलकर जानें क्यों?

books.title: अम्माची की गज़ब मशीनें
books.summary: किसे पता था कि नारियल की बरफ़ी बनाना भी इतना मज़ेदार हो सकता है? नयी-नयी चीज़ें ईज़ाद करने वाली अम्माची और सूरज ने मिलकर नारियल की बरफ़ी बनाने के लिए बिलकुल अनोखे ढंग से एक नहीं बल्कि छह-छह सरल मशीनें काम मे लीं।

books.title: मैं बहुत कुछ बना सकता हूँ !
categories: Main bahut kuch bana sakta hoon!
books.summary:
बच्चे कई सुन्दर चीज़ें खुद बना सकते हैं। वे क्या क्या हो सकती हैं? 
यह किताब आओ बढ़ें श्रृंखला की चार किताबों में से एक है।

books.title: एक सफ़र, एक खेल
books.summary: नीना का परिवार कोलकाता से दिल्ली रहने जा रहा है, और वह इस बात से ख़ुश नहीं है। क्या उसके माता-पिता रेलगाड़ी के सफ़र में उसका मन बहला पाएंगे?

books.title: कल मिलेंगे!
books.summary:
क्या आपने कभी किसी से कल मिलने का वादा किया है?
इस लड़के के सभी दोस्त तो वादे के पक्के हैं!

books.title: “मेरी मछली!” “नहीं, मेरी मछली!”
books.summary:
तीन दोस्तों और तीन चालाक मछलियों की 
एक मज़ेदार कहानी!

books.title: मेरा परिवार
books.summary:
मेरा परिवार बहुत बड़ा है।
आइए, सबसे मिलते हैं।

books.title: मसाला चाय
books.summary: बुलबुली ने रहस्यमयी बावली घाटी के बारे में कितनी तरह की बातें सुनी थी।सब लोग बावली घाटी की बातें तो करते थे पर कोई भी वहाँ गया नहीं था। क्या बुलबुली की बावली घाटी की रोमांच भरी यात्रा तोताराम के साथ पूरी होगी? यह भेद जानने के लिये पढ़िये ‘मसाला चाय’ जिसकी हर चुस्की में आपको मज़ा आयेगा !

books.title: मेहनत का मंत्र
categories: The Magic Powder - A Folktale from Myanmar
books.summary:
बहुत समय पहले, इरावदी के तट पर थूज़ा अपने पति थेंगी के साथ रहती थी।दोनों का जीवन सुख-चैन से कट रहा था किंतु एक समस्या थी।थूज़ा अपना सारा समय मिट्टी से सोना बनाने की विधि ढूँढने में बिताता था।क्या वह सफल हुआ?
इस रोचक मयन्मारी लोककथा में पढ़िये।

books.title: मधुमक्खी और हाथी
books.summary: एक हाथी, एक छोटी सी मधुमक्खी का घर ढूँढ़ने में उसकी मदद कर रहा है। क्या घोंसला या गुफा उसका घर है? वह कहाँ रहती है?

books.title: अक्कू हुई गुस्सा
books.summary: आज अक्कू का दिन बहुत बुरा बीता। और उसे बहुत, बहुत, बहुत गुस्सा आ रहा है। यह किताब पढ़ें और जानें कि अक्कू का गुस्सा कैसे ठंडा हुआ और जब आप को बहुत, बहुत गुस्सा आए तब क्या करें।

books.title: अम्मा जब  स्कूल गयीं
books.summary: मीरा की अम्मा एक दिन उसके स्कूल गयीं पर वहाँ कोई नहीं था, मीरा, उसके मित्र, शिक्षक और यहाँ तक कि बड़ी दीदी भी। वे सब कहाँ गायब हो गए थे?

books.title: हमारा पुस्तकालय
books.summary: क्या आपको कार पसन्द हैं या डायनासोर या उनके बारे में पढ़ना अच्छा लगता है? क्या आपका मन कुछ जानने का करता है या आपके पास कोई सुझाव है? क्या आपको अच्छा लगेगा अगर इनके बारे में आपको कोई पढ़कर सुनाए? या आप किसी कोने में अकेले बैठकर पढ़ना चाहते हैं? आइए, हमारे पुस्तकालय में आपका स्वागत है!

books.title: निराली दादी
books.summary: मिलिए हमारी निराली दादी से।इन्हें चीज़ें उछालना बहुत अच्छा लगता है!

books.title: डरपोक रेलगाड़ी
books.summary:
क्या आप नयी जगहें जाने और अकेले घूमने से डरते हैं? नहीं ना, पर यह नया नवेला इंजन तो बहुत ही डरपोक है। अब अगर इंजन डरेगा तो रेलगाड़ी कैसे चलेगी? 
आईये, देखें कि इस इंजन का डर कैसे दूर हुआ और रेलगाड़ी कैसे चली!

books.title: श्रुति का अनोखा उपाय
books.summary: श्रुति पानी में पौधे लगाना चाहती है, पर क्या वो सच में ऐसा कर पाएगी? आइये पढ़कर पता लगाते हैं।

books.title: सतरंगा सांबर
books.summary: भव्या और उसकी पाटी आज क्या खाएंगे? अरे वही जो भव्या की मन पसंद चीज़ है – सतरंगा सांबर! तो चलिए पाटी और भव्या के सतरंगी सांबर का स्वाद आप भी उठाइए!

books.title: टप-टप-टपक
books.summary:
जंगल में बारिश के बाद यह आवाज़ कैसी?
टप-टप-टपक!

books.title: चिपको चिपको वृक्ष बचाओ
books.summary: ऊँचे पहाड़ों की यह कहानी बतलाती है कि हौंसला हो तो क्या कुछ नहीं हो सकता। एक भोटिया लड़की दिची, अपने प्यारे पेड़ों को बचाने के लिए चिपको आंदोलन का सहारा लेती है। उनके गाँव में हर कोई जानता है कि जीवन की सब ज़रूरी चीज़ें पेड़ों से आती हैं। अलकनन्दा नदी के हिमालय क्षेत्र में पेड़ों के भारी कटाव से १९७० के दशक में बहुत बा़ढ आई। इसने पेड़ों से लिपट कर उन्हें काटने से बचाने के आंदोलन को जन्म दिया। इस दिल को छू लेने वाली कहानी को पढ़िए और देखिए कि एकता की ताकत क्या होती है।

books.title: मोटा राजा दुबला कुत्ता
books.summary: मोटे राजा के साथ दुबले कुत्ते के पीछे भागिए!

books.title: पापा की मूँछें
books.summary: अनु को अपने पापा की क्या चीज़ सबसे अच्छी लगती है? उनकी मूँछें! असल में, अनु को मूँछ वाले सारे लोग अच्छे लगते हैं। अनु ने मूँछ देखी नहीं कि उसके मन में न जाने क्या-क्या मज़ेदार कल्पनाएँ उमड़ने लगती हैं।

books.title: टिंग पिंग!
books.summary: यह नन्हा बच्चा सोना चाहता है, पर सो नहीं पा रहा। आईये, देखें कि इसे क्या परेशान कर रहा है?

books.title: ऊपर देखो!
books.summary: चिड़ियाँ और चमगादड़! पतंग और जहाज़! आप इस अनोखी दुनिया की कितनी खोज कर सकते हैं? तो तैयार हो जाइए, इस निराली पुस्तक के साथ कुछ निराली बातों का पता लगाने के लिए!

books.title: सालाना बाल-कटाई दिवस
books.summary: श्रींगेरी श्रीनिवास के बहुत लम्बे बाल थे। वह सालाना बाल-कटाई दिवस पर उन्हें कटवाना चाहता था। परन्तु किसी के पास व़क्त नहीं था। आप सपने में भी नहीं सोच सकते कि उस दिन श्रींगेरी की मदद किसने की! पढ़िये और मज़ा लीजिये!

books.title: अमीना कहाँ है?
books.summary: सभी लोग सोच रहे थे कि रविवार की दोपहर को आख़िर अमीना क्या कर रही है। आख़िरकार, नारियल का खोल, रंग, बटन और समाचार पत्र कहाँ गए?

books.title: लड़की जो हँसती जाती
categories: The Girl Who Could Not Stop Laughing
books.summary:
टी. सुंदरी, रोज़ ही मुसीबत में फँस जाती है, क्योंकि ज़्यादातर चीज़ें उसे हँसा देती हैं। वह अपना मुँह बंद ही नहीं रख पाती। टी. सुंदरी जानना चाहती है कि क्या यह कोई समस्या है या यूँ ही 
हर समय हँसना आम बात है।

books.title: थोड़ा सा और
books.summary: बहादुर खरगोशों ने बदमाश भेड़िए को कैसे मज़ा चखाया? पढ़िए उसी की रोमांचक कहानी!

books.title: चाँद का तोहफ़ा
books.summary:
क्या आपको गरमी के दिनों में टोपी पहनना अच्छा लगता है? 
इस प्यारी-सी कहानी में पढ़ें कि टोपी पहनना और 
किसको पसंद है।

books.title: ख़ुश-ख़ुश मुर्गियाँ
books.summary: माँ-कुटकुट और चुन्नू-चूज़ा धरती पर मुर्गियों का ख़ुशनुमा जीवन देखने आए हैं। और जब ता ता मुर्गा उन्हें ‘परम सुख’ नाम की जगह ले जाता है, तो वे महसूस करते हैं कि वहाँ तो उतना सुख नहीं है जितना कि उन्होंने पहले सोचा था।

books.title: गप्पू नाच नहीं सकती
books.summary: कक्षा के सभी बच्चे जानते हैं कि गप्पू नाच नहीं सकती। जब बच्चे अपना बायाँ हाथ उठाते हैं तो वह दाहिना हाथ उठाती है। क्या कोमल मैम गप्पू को नाचने देंगी? विलोम की धारणा का प्रयोग करते हुए नाच से मिलने वाले आनंद के बारे में एक छोटी सी कहानी।

books.title: कौए के रिश्तेदार
books.summary: कौआ खूबसूरत नहीं है। ना कोयल के जैसी मीठी आवाज़, ना मोर जैसी कला है उसके पास। पर उसमें एक ऐसा गुण है जिस से हम सब सीख ले सकते हैं। किताब पढ़िये और ढूँढ़ निकालिये।

books.title: हँसना मना है
books.summary: शांति बड़ी चुलबुली लड़की है और किसी ने उसे कभी भी उदास होते नहीं देखा था। पर एक दिन वह बिलकुल चुप-चाप रही। आखिर उसे हुआ क्या था?

books.title: चाँद और सूरज
books.summary: क्या आपको पता है चाँद और सूरज क्या-क्या झोल करतें है?

books.title: मेरे पलंग के नीचे
